• If the xHC resources required by the enabled endpoints are available: • Add the resources allocated to the endpoint to the Resource Required variable. • If the endpoint is periodic: • Evaluate the bandwidth requirements define by the Endpoint Context. • Add bandwidth allocated to the endpoint from the Bandwidth Required variable. • If the Resource Required is less than or equal to the Resource Available: • If the Bandwidth Required is less than or equal to the Bandwidth Available: // The resource and bandwidth allocations will allow a successful completion, so update Endpoint Context(s). • Subtract the Bandwidth Required from the Bandwidth Available. • For each Endpoint Context designated by a Drop Context flag = '1': • Set the EP State field to Disabled14. • For each Endpoint Context designated by a Add Context flag = '1': • Copy all fields of the Input Endpoint Context to the Output Endpoint Context. Note that this action passes ownership of the Transfer Ring or Stream Context Array/Transfer Rings from software to the xHC. If the Output Endpoint Context had previously pointed to a Transfer Ring or a Stream Context Array, software is responsible for performing any garbage collection necessary for recovering them. • Set the Output EP State field to Running. • Load the xHC Enqueue and Dequeue Pointers with the value of the TR Dequeue Pointer field from the Endpoint Context. • If all Endpoints are Disabled: • Set the Slot State in the Output Slot Context to Addressed. • Set the Context Entries field in the Output Slot Context to ‘1’. • else // An Endpoint is Enabled • Set the Slot State in the Output Slot Context to Configured. • Set the Context Entries field in the Output Slot Context to the index of the last valid Endpoint Context in its Output Device Context structure. • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). • else15 // The Bandwidth Required is greater than the Bandwidth Available • If the Bandwidth Error is encountered in the primary Bandwidth Domain: 14Note, if both the Add and Drop flags are set for an Endpoint Context, the xHC is not expected to write out the intermediate Disabled state to the Output Device Context. The only requirement is that the Endpoint Context is correct when the Command Completion Event is generated. 15It is not required that the following checks for Primary and Secondary Bandwidth availability occur in this order. An xHCI implementation may check for Secondary Bandwidth availability first.

commit d6759133e9815ef807b17dc752aff8c3771b7444
Author: Julius Werner <jwerner@chromium.org>
Date:   Tue Jun 24 17:14:42 2014 +0300

    usb: xhci: Correct last context entry calculation for Configure Endpoint
    
    The current XHCI driver recalculates the Context Entries field in the
    Slot Context on every add_endpoint() and drop_endpoint() call. In the
    case of drop_endpoint(), it seems to assume that the add_flags will
    always contain every endpoint for the new configuration, which is not
    necessarily correct if you don't make assumptions about how the USB core
    uses the add_endpoint/drop_endpoint interface (add_flags only contains
    endpoints that are new additions in the new configuration).
    
    Furthermore, EP0_FLAG is not consistently set in add_flags throughout
    the lifetime of a device. This means that when all endpoints are
    dropped, the Context Entries field can be set to 0 (which is invalid and
    may cause a Parameter Error) or -1 (which is interpreted as 31 and
    causes the driver to keep using the old, incorrect value).
    
    The only surefire way to set this field right is to also take all
    existing endpoints into account, and to force the value to 1 (meaning
    only EP0 is active) if no other endpoint is found. This patch implements
    that as a single step in the final check_bandwidth() call and removes
    the intermediary calculations from add_endpoint() and drop_endpoint().
    
    Signed-off-by: Julius Werner <jwerner@chromium.org>
    Signed-off-by: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
    Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

背景（何时 / 谁修 / 为什么是它）

2014 年 6 月，Chromium OS 的 Julius Werner 提交、Mathias Nyman 与 Greg Kroah-Hartman 签收。Context Entries 是 Slot Context 里「本槽最后一个有效端点上下文的索引」——§4.6.6 执行算法（p110）规定每次 Configure Endpoint 后由 xHC 收束：全 Disabled 落 '1'，否则落最后有效索引；p111 还规定Add 旗标指到的 DCI 超过该值即 Parameter Error。这个字段的内核侧计算，从环扩张时代起就散落在xhci_add_endpoint()/xhci_drop_endpoint() 里增量维护。

要解决的问题（症状 + 机制）

症状：某些「全部端点被 drop」的配置切换（如切到 Alternate Interface 0）后，Configure Endpoint 命令被 xHC 以 Parameter Error 拒绝，或驱动继续沿用旧值。机制（message 原文）：drop_endpoint() 的增量计算「似乎假定 add_flags 总含新配置的全部端点」——实际 add_flags 只含新配置里新增的端点；且 EP0_FLAG 在设备生命周期里并非恒置。两个假设任一不成立，全 drop 时 Context Entries 就被算成 0（非法值——p111 Parameter Error 判据「Add 的 DCI > Context Entries」直接命中）或 -1（按 LAST_CTX 宏解读为 31，导致继续使用旧的错误值）。

代码逻辑（补丁前 → 后行为对照）

把两处增量维护整块删除（add/drop 各一块），改为 xhci_check_bandwidth() 发命令前的终点一步重算：i 自 31 下探，取第一个「ring 存活且未被 Drop」或「Add 旗标置位」的端点写 LAST_CTX(i)；全不命中则 i==1 兜底——LAST_CTX(1) 即「只剩 EP0」。补丁前：每步增量的两处假设任一不成立就写坏值；补丁后：终点一次算清，且 i==1 分支正是规范 p110「全 Disabled → Context Entries=\'1\'」的内核直译。与贴码对读：下方补丁对读段琥珀高亮行（Fix up 注释行）即修复循环所在——本补丁已在基线 d9008e061539 内，贴码即补丁后形态；分帧走读见 ch4606p（scene=43）。

3078int xhci_check_bandwidth(struct usb_hcd *hcd, struct usb_device *udev)


3079{


3080	int i;


3081	int ret = 0;


3082	struct xhci_hcd *xhci;


3083	struct xhci_virt_device	*virt_dev;


3084	struct xhci_input_control_ctx *ctrl_ctx;


3085	struct xhci_slot_ctx *slot_ctx;


3086	struct xhci_command *command;


3087


3088	ret = xhci_check_args(hcd, udev, NULL, 0, true, __func__);


3089	if (ret <= 0)


3090		return ret;


3091	xhci = hcd_to_xhci(hcd);


3092	if ((xhci->xhc_state & XHCI_STATE_DYING) ||


3093		(xhci->xhc_state & XHCI_STATE_REMOVING))


3094		return -ENODEV;


3095


3096	xhci_dbg(xhci, "%s called for udev %p\n", __func__, udev);


3097	virt_dev = xhci->devs[udev->slot_id];


3098


3099	command = xhci_alloc_command(xhci, true, GFP_KERNEL);


3100	if (!command)


3101		return -ENOMEM;


3102


3103	command->in_ctx = virt_dev->in_ctx;


3104


3105	/* See section 4.6.6 - A0 = 1; A1 = D0 = D1 = 0 */


3106	ctrl_ctx = xhci_get_input_control_ctx(command->in_ctx);


3107	if (!ctrl_ctx) {


3108		xhci_warn(xhci, "%s: Could not get input context, bad type.\n",


3109				__func__);


3110		ret = -ENOMEM;


3111		goto command_cleanup;


3112	}


3113	ctrl_ctx->add_flags |= cpu_to_le32(SLOT_FLAG);


3114	ctrl_ctx->add_flags &= cpu_to_le32(~EP0_FLAG);


3115	ctrl_ctx->drop_flags &= cpu_to_le32(~(SLOT_FLAG | EP0_FLAG));


3116


3117	/* Don't issue the command if there's no endpoints to update. */


3118	if (ctrl_ctx->add_flags == cpu_to_le32(SLOT_FLAG) &&


3119	    ctrl_ctx->drop_flags == 0) {


3120		ret = 0;


3121		goto command_cleanup;


3122	}


3123	/* Fix up Context Entries field. Minimum value is EP0 == BIT(1). */


3124	slot_ctx = xhci_get_slot_ctx(xhci, virt_dev->in_ctx);


3125	for (i = 31; i >= 1; i--) {


3126		__le32 le32 = cpu_to_le32(BIT(i));


3127


3128		if ((virt_dev->eps[i-1].ring && !(ctrl_ctx->drop_flags & le32))


3129		    || (ctrl_ctx->add_flags & le32) || i == 1) {


3130			slot_ctx->dev_info &= cpu_to_le32(~LAST_CTX_MASK);


3131			slot_ctx->dev_info |= cpu_to_le32(LAST_CTX(i));


3132			break;


3133		}


3134	}


3135


3136	ret = xhci_configure_endpoint(xhci, udev, command,


3137			false, false);


3138	if (ret)


3139		/* Callee should call reset_bandwidth() */


3140		goto command_cleanup;


3141


3142	/* Free any rings that were dropped, but not changed. */


3143	for (i = 1; i < 31; i++) {


3144		if ((le32_to_cpu(ctrl_ctx->drop_flags) & (1 << (i + 1))) &&


3145		    !(le32_to_cpu(ctrl_ctx->add_flags) & (1 << (i + 1)))) {


3146			xhci_free_endpoint_ring(xhci, virt_dev, i);


3147			xhci_check_bw_drop_ep_streams(xhci, virt_dev, i);


3148		}


3149	}


3150	xhci_zero_in_ctx(xhci, virt_dev);


3151	/*


3152	 * Install any rings for completely new endpoints or changed endpoints,


3153	 * and free any old rings from changed endpoints.


3154	 */


3155	for (i = 1; i < 31; i++) {


3156		if (!virt_dev->eps[i].new_ring)


3157			continue;


3158		/* Only free the old ring if it exists.


3159		 * It may not if this is the first add of an endpoint.


3160		 */


3161		if (virt_dev->eps[i].ring) {


3162			xhci_free_endpoint_ring(xhci, virt_dev, i);


3163		}


3164		xhci_check_bw_drop_ep_streams(xhci, virt_dev, i);


3165		virt_dev->eps[i].ring = virt_dev->eps[i].new_ring;


3166		virt_dev->eps[i].new_ring = NULL;


3167		xhci_debugfs_create_endpoint(xhci, virt_dev, i);


3168	}


3169command_cleanup:


3170	kfree(command->completion);


3171	kfree(command);


3172


3173	return ret;


3174}

4.6.7Evaluate Context核心命令p112-p114

规范引文（机制主线）

Evaluate Context The Evaluate Context Command is issued by software to inform the xHC that specific fields in the Device Context data structures have been modified. There are several cases where parameters associated with a Slot Context or the Default Control Endpoint Context are initially unknown, which shall be updated after the slot has entered the Addressed state. for example, the Max Packet Size of the control endpoint may be determined only after software reads the Device Descriptor from the device through the control endpoint. The Device
评估上下文（Evaluate Context） 软件发出 Evaluate Context 命令（评估上下文命令），以通知 xHC：设备上下文数据结构中的特定字段已被修改。有多种情形下，与槽上下文（Slot Context）或默认控制端点上下文（Default Control Endpoint Context）相关联的参数最初是未知的，必须在槽进入 Addressed 状态之后予以更新。例如，控制端点的 Max Packet Size 可能只有在软件通过该控制端点从设备读出设备描述符（Device Descriptor）之后才能确定。必须读取设备描述符以判定该设备是否为集线器，等等。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1296-L1303（p112）
Descriptor shall be read to determine whether a device is a hub or not, etc. When an Evaluate Context Command is processed by the xHC it shall only affect the parameters identified by the respective context. Refer to the Evaluate Context Command Usage sub-sections in section 4.5.2 and 6.2.2.3 for
例如，控制端点的 Max Packet Size 可能只有在软件通过该控制端点从设备读出设备描述符（Device Descriptor）之后才能确定。必须读取设备描述符以判定该设备是否为集线器，等等。 xHC 处理 Evaluate Context 命令时，该命令必须只影响相应上下文所标识的参数。受影响的具体上下文字段的更多信息，参见第 4.5.2 节与第 6.2.2.3 节中的 Evaluate Context 命令用法（Evaluate Context Command Usage）小节。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1304-L1307（p112）
If the Slot State is Disabled when an Evaluate Context Command is received, the xHC shall generate a Slot Not Enabled Error Event on the Event Ring. Upon successful completion of an Evaluate Context Command, the xHC shall begin executing with the updated context parameters.
若收到 Evaluate Context 命令时槽状态（Slot State）为 Disabled，xHC 必须在事件环上生成一个 Slot Not Enabled Error 事件。 Evaluate Context 命令成功完成后，xHC 必须开始以更新后的上下文参数执行。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1314-L1317（p112）
The xHC shall consider an Endpoint Context invalid if the DCI of an Add Context flag = ‘1’ is greater than the value of Context Entries.
若某个 Add Context 标志 = ‘1’ 所对应的 DCI 大于 Context Entries 的值，则 xHC 必须认为该端点上下文无效。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1417-L1418（p114）

2192		ret = -EINVAL;


2193		break;


2194	case COMP_INCOMPATIBLE_DEVICE_ERROR:


2195		dev_warn(&udev->dev,


2196			"ERROR: Incompatible device for evaluate context command.\n");


2197		ret = -ENODEV;


2198		break;


2199	case COMP_MAX_EXIT_LATENCY_TOO_LARGE_ERROR:


2200		/* Max Exit Latency too large error */


2201		dev_warn(&udev->dev, "WARN: Max Exit Latency too large\n");


2202		ret = -EINVAL;


2203		break;


2204	case COMP_SUCCESS:


2205		xhci_dbg_trace(xhci, trace_xhci_dbg_context_change,


2206				"Successful evaluate context command");


2207		ret = 0;


2208		break;


2209	default:


2210		xhci_err(xhci, "ERROR: unexpected command completion code 0x%x.\n",


2211			*cmd_status);


2212		ret = -EINVAL;


2213		break;


2214	}


2215	return ret;


2216}

流程图 · 4.6.7 Evaluate Context 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L1326-L1332 + L1338-L1355
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue an Evaluate Context Command, system software shall perform the following operations: • Allocate and initialize an Input Context data structure for the command. • Insert an Evaluate Context Command on the Command Ring
要发出 Evaluate Context 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 为该命令分配并初始化一个输入上下文数据结构。 - 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Evaluate Context 命令 - TRB Type = Evaluate Context 命令（参见表 6-91）。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1326-L1332（p112）
• TRB Type = Evaluate Context Command (refer to Table 6-91). • The Add Context flags shall be initialized to indicate the IDs of the Contexts affected by the command. Refer to sections 6.2.2.3 and 6.2.3.3 for the specific Context fields that shall be evaluated. • Set all Drop Context flags to ‘0’. • Slot ID = ID of the target Device Slot. • Input Context Pointer = The base address of the Input Context data structure. • Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. • Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
- TRB Type = Evaluate Context 命令（参见表 6-91）。 - Add Context 标志必须初始化为指明受该命令影响的各上下文（Context）的 ID。必须评估的具体上下文字段参见第 6.2.2.3 节与第 6.2.3.3 节。 - 将所有 Drop Context 标志置为 ‘0’。 - Slot ID = 目标设备槽（Device Slot）的 ID。 - Input Context Pointer = 输入上下文数据结构的基址。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器（Host Controller Doorbell），DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1338-L1355（p113）
流程图 · 4.6.7 Evaluate Context 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L1356-L1409
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When an Evaluate Context Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring. • TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91). • Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Evaluate Context Command TRB. • Slot ID = The value of the command’s Slot ID. • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). • If the Device Slot identified by the Slot ID fields has been previously enabled by an Enable Slot Command: • Retrieve the Output Device Context of the selected Device Slot. • If the Output Slot State is equal to Default, Addressed or Configured: • For each Context designated by an Add Context flag = '1': • Evaluate the parameter settings defined by the selected Contexts. • If the Context parameters are not valid: • Completion Code = Parameter Error. • If the Max Exit Latency is non-zero: • Calculate the Isoch Scheduling Delay. • If the Max Exit Latency + Isoch Scheduling Delay does not allow an Isoch endpoint to be scheduled: • Completion Code = Max Exit Latency Too Large Error. • If Completion Code = Success: • For each Endpoint Context designated by a Add Context flag = '1': • Update Output Device Context parameters. • else // The Output Slot State is not equal to Default, Addressed or Configured • Completion Code = Context State Error. • else // The slot has not been enabled by an Enable Slot Command • Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error. • Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. • Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag.
当 xHC 执行 Evaluate Context 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 在事件环上插入一个命令完成事件。 - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Evaluate Context 命令 TRB 的地址。 - Slot ID = 该命令的 Slot ID 字段值。 - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - 若由 Slot ID 字段所标识的设备槽此前已被某个 Enable Slot 命令启用： - 取回所选设备槽的输出设备上下文（Output Device Context）。 - 若输出槽状态（Output Slot State）等于 Default、Addressed 或 Configured： - 对每个由 Add Context 标志 = ‘1’ 指定的上下文： - 评估所选上下文定义的参数设置。 - 若上下文参数无效： - Completion Code = Parameter Error。 - 若 Max Exit Latency 非零： - 计算 Isoch Scheduling Delay。 - 若 Max Exit Latency + Isoch Scheduling Delay 导致无法调度某个等时（Isoch）端点： - Completion Code = Max Exit Latency Too Large Error。 - 若 Completion Code = Success： - 对每个由 Add Context 标志 = ‘1’ 指定的端点上下文： - 更新输出设备上下文参数。 - else // 输出槽状态不等于 Default、Addressed 或 Configured - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - else // 该槽尚未被 Enable Slot 命令启用 - Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1356-L1409（p113）
4.6.8Reset Endpoint核心命令p114-p118

规范引文（机制主线）

The Reset Endpoint Command is issued by software to recover from a halted condition on an endpoint.
软件发出 Reset Endpoint 命令（复位端点命令），以从端点的 halt（停机）状态中恢复。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1436-L1437（p114）
When a Transfer Ring or Stream is halted; the associated endpoint is removed from the xHC’s Pipe Schedule, the Doorbell Register for that pipe is disabled, the state of the associated Endpoint Context is set to Halted, and any subsequent packets received for the endpoint will be silently dropped.
当传输环（Transfer Ring）或流（Stream）halt 时：相关端点会被移出 xHC 的 Pipe Schedule（管道调度表），该管道的门铃寄存器被禁用，相关端点上下文的状态被置为 Halted，且此后为该端点收到的任何包都会被静默丢弃。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1441-L1444（p114）
After the command completes, the Transfer Ring will be reinstated on the xHC’s Pipe Schedule the next time its doorbell is rung.
命令完成后，下次该传输环的门铃被振铃时，传输环会重新加入 xHC 的 Pipe Schedule。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1486-L1487（p115）
Note: The Reset Endpoint Command may only be issued to endpoints in the Halted state. If software wishes to reset the Data Toggle or Sequence Number of an endpoint that isn't in the Halted state, then software may issue a Configure Endpoint Command with the Drop and Add bits set for the target endpoint that is in the Stopped state or Running but Idle state.
注：Reset Endpoint 命令只能发给处于 Halted 状态的端点。若软件希望复位一个不处于 Halted 状态的端点的数据翻转位或 Sequence Number，则软件可以对处于 Stopped 状态或 Running 但 Idle 状态的目标端点发出一条将其 Drop 与 Add 位置位的 Configure Endpoint 命令。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1620-L1624（p117）

流程图 · 4.6.8 复位端点时 xHC 执行的操作 · 依据 spec-46.txt L1448-L1466 + L1473-L1485
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
The xHC shall perform the following operations when Resetting an endpoint: • If the endpoint is not in the Halted state when an Reset Endpoint Command is executed: • The xHC shall reject the command and generate a Command Completion Event with the Completion Code set to Context State Error. • else • If the Transfer State Preserve (TSP) flag is ‘0’: • Reset the Data Toggle for USB2 devices or the Sequence Number for USB3 devices. • Reset any USB2 split transaction state associated with the endpoint. • Invalidate any xHC TDs that may be cached, forcing xHC to fetch Transfer TRBs from memory when the pipe transitions from the Stopped to Running state. • else // TSP = ‘1’
复位端点时，xHC 必须执行以下操作： - 若执行 Reset Endpoint 命令时端点不处于 Halted 状态： - xHC 必须拒绝该命令，并生成 Completion Code 置为 Context State Error 的命令完成事件。 - else - 若 Transfer State Preserve（TSP）标志为 ‘0’： - 复位 USB2 设备的数据翻转位（Data Toggle）或 USB3 设备的 Sequence Number（序列号）。 - 复位与该端点相关联的任何 USB2 拆分事务（split transaction）状态。 - 使任何可能被缓存的 xHC TD 失效，迫使 xHC 在管道从 Stopped 迁移到 Running 状态时从内存取传输 TRB。 - else // TSP = ‘1’
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1448-L1466（p114）
• The USB2 Data Toggle or the USB3 Sequence Number for the pipe shall be preserved. • Maintain any USB2 split transaction state associated with the endpoint. • The endpoint shall continue execution by retrying the last transaction the next time the doorbell is rung, if no other commands have been issued to the endpoint. • Set the Endpoint Context EP State field to Stopped. • Enable the Doorbell Register for the pipe. • Generate a Command Completion Event with the Completion Code set to Success.
- 该管道的 USB2 数据翻转位或 USB3 Sequence Number 必须被保留。 - 维护与该端点相关联的任何 USB2 拆分事务状态。 - 若未向该端点发出过其他命令，则端点在下次门铃振铃时应通过重试最后一个事务来继续执行。 - 将端点上下文（Endpoint Context）的 EP State 字段置为 Stopped。 - 启用该管道的门铃寄存器。 - 生成 Completion Code 置为 Success 的命令完成事件。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1473-L1485（p115）
流程图 · 4.6.8 “复位一根管道”软件序列（reset a pipe） · 依据 spec-46.txt L1503-L1525
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
Note: Software shall execute the following sequence to “reset a pipe”, that is, clear the xHC endpoint halt condition, reset the host-side Data Toggle/Sequence Number, clear a stall on the device, and reset the device-side Data Toggle/Sequence Number. Also, if the device was behind a TT, the TT buffer would also need to be cleared. • Reset Endpoint Command (TSP = ‘0’). • If the device was behind a TT and it is a Control or Bulk endpoint: • Issue a ClearFeature(CLEAR_TT_BUFFER) request to the hub. • If not a Control endpoint: • Issue a ClearFeature(ENDPOINT_HALT) request to device. • Issue a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command, clear the endpoint state and reference the TRB to start. • Ring Doorbell to restart the pipe. The Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command resets the state of the endpoint so that the xHC starts transferring data at the beginning of the TRB referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer (rather than at the location associated with the previous packet that caused the halt) when the doorbell is
注：软件必须执行以下序列来“复位一条管道”（reset a pipe），即：清除 xHC 侧的端点 halt 状态、复位主机侧的数据翻转位/Sequence Number、清除设备侧的 STALL（停滞），并复位设备侧的数据翻转位/Sequence Number。此外，若设备位于某个 TT（事务翻译器）之后，则还需清除 TT 缓冲（TT buffer）。 - Reset Endpoint 命令（TSP = ‘0’）。 - 若设备位于某个 TT 之后，且为 Control 或 Bulk 端点： - 向集线器发出 ClearFeature(CLEAR_TT_BUFFER) 请求。 - 若不是 Control 端点： - 向设备发出 ClearFeature(ENDPOINT_HALT) 请求。 - 发出一条 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，清除端点状态并引用要从头开始的 TRB。 - 振铃门铃以重启该管道。 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令会复位端点的状态，使得门铃振铃时 xHC 从 TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用 TRB 的起始处开始传输数据（而不是从导致 halt 的前一个包所关联的位置开始）。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1503-L1525（p115）
Soft Retry A Soft Retry may effectively be used to recover from a USB Transaction Error that was due to a temporary error condition (for example, electrical interference caused by a cell phone transmitting too close to a USB cable). Often the delay introduced between software detecting the error and attempting a Soft Retry is enough to let the temporary condition clear and allow a successful transfer. Section 4.10.2.3 describes how the xHC shall halt an endpoint with a USB Transaction Error after CErr retries have been performed. The USB device is not aware that the xHC has halted the endpoint, and will be waiting for another retry, so a Soft Retry may be used to perform additional retries and recover from an error which has caused the xHC to halt an endpoint. Software performs a Soft Retry with the following operations: 1. Issue a Reset Endpoint Command with the TSP flag set to ‘1’. This causes the endpoint to advance from the Halted to the Stopped state, but does not change the state of the Data Toggle or Sequence Number, and allows the xHC to continue the retry process another CErr times. 2. Ring the doorbell for the endpoint to initiate up to another CErr retries. To support Soft Retry, the state of a partially completed TRB transfer (for example, if 1K of a 4K TRB has been moved) shall be maintained by a Reset Endpoint Command if TSP = ‘1’. Note: Soft Retry attempts shall not be performed on Isoch endpoints. Any attempt to do so may result in undefined behavior.
4.6.8.1 软重试（Soft Retry） 软重试（Soft Retry）可以有效地用于从因暂时性错误条件（例如，手机在距 USB 线缆过近处发射所引起的电气干扰）导致的 USB 事务错误（Transaction Error）中恢复。通常，软件检测到错误与尝试软重试之间引入的延迟就足以让该暂时性条件消退并使传输成功。 第 4.10.2.3 节描述了在执行 CErr 次重试之后，xHC 必须如何因 USB 事务错误而 halt 一个端点。USB 设备并不知道 xHC 已 halt 该端点，而会继续等待下一次重试，因此可以使用软重试来执行额外的重试，并从导致 xHC halt 端点的错误中恢复。 软件通过以下操作执行软重试： 1. 发出一条 TSP 标志置为 ‘1’ 的 Reset Endpoint 命令。这会使端点从 Halted 迁移到 Stopped 状态，但不改变数据翻转位或 Sequence Number 的状态，并允许 xHC 将重试过程再继续 CErr 次。 2. 振铃该端点的门铃，以发起至多另外 CErr 次重试。 为支持软重试，当 TSP = ‘1’ 时，Reset Endpoint 命令必须维持部分完成的 TRB 传输的状态（例如，若某个 4K TRB 中已有 1K 被搬移）。 注：不得对等时端点执行软重试尝试。任何此类尝试都可能导致未定义行为。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1626-L1650（p117）
4.6.9Stop Endpoint核心命令p118-p125

规范引文（机制主线）

The Stop Endpoint Command is issued by software to stop the xHC execution of the TDs on an endpoint. An endpoint may be stopped by software so that it can temporarily take ownership of Transfer Ring TDs that had previously been passed to the xHC, or to stop USB activity prior to powering down the xHC.
软件发出 Stop Endpoint 命令（停止端点命令），以停止 xHC 对某端点上各 TD 的执行。软件停止端点，可能是为了暂时接管此前已交给 xHC 的传输环 TD，或者是为了在 xHC 断电之前停止 USB 活动。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1666-L1669（p118）
While the endpoint is stopped, software may add, delete, or otherwise rearrange TDs on an associated Transfer Ring. For example, this command allows software to insert “high-priority” TDs at the Dequeue Pointer so they will be executed immediately when the ring is restarted, or to “abort” one or more TDs by removing them from the ring.
端点处于停止状态期间，软件可以在相关传输环上添加、删除或以其他方式重排 TD。例如，本命令允许软件在 Dequeue Pointer 处插入“高优先级”TD，使环重启时它们立即被执行；或者通过把一个或多个 TD 从环上移除来“中止”（abort）它们。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1670-L1674（p118）
The Stop Endpoint Command is expected to stop endpoint activity as soon as possible, which may mean that it stops in the middle of a TRB. When the endpoint stops, it saves the value of the TR Dequeue Pointer and DCS fields (and possibly other “Opaque” state) in the Endpoint/Stream Context so that it can pick up where it left off the next time its doorbell is rung, for example, if the endpoint stopped after moving the first 1KB of data in a 4KB TRB, then transfer related state maintained by the xHC will allow it to transfer the remaining 3KB of data when the doorbell is rung. If a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command is issued while an endpoint is in the Stopped state, the transfer related state of the endpoint will be dumped when the Output Endpoint/Stream Context TR Dequeue Pointer and DCS fields are overwritten. The next time the doorbell is rung, the endpoint shall start execution at the beginning of the TRB referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer.
Stop Endpoint 命令被期望尽快停止端点活动，这可能意味着它停在某个 TRB 的中间。端点停止时，它会把 TR Dequeue Pointer 与 DCS 字段的值（以及可能的其他“不透明”（Opaque）状态）保存到端点/流上下文（Stream Context）中，以便下次门铃振铃时能从上次停下的地方继续。例如，若端点在搬移完某个 4KB TRB 中的前 1KB 数据后停止，那么 xHC 维护的传输相关状态会使它在门铃振铃时继续传输剩余的 3KB 数据。若在端点处于 Stopped 状态期间发出了一条 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，那么当输出端点/流上下文的 TR Dequeue Pointer 与 DCS 字段被覆写时，该端点的传输相关状态将被丢弃。下次门铃振铃时，端点必须从 TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用 TRB 的起始处开始执行。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1675-L1687（p118）
The xHC shall generate a Stopped Transfer Event every time a Transfer Ring is stopped with a Stop Endpoint Command. This operation is referred to as Force Stopped Event (FSE). The forced Stopped Transfer Event explicitly indicates to software that the selected Transfer Ring has stopped. If a Transfer Ring is empty when a Stop Endpoint Command is issued, a Stopped Transfer Event shall be generated on the Event Ring indicated by the Slot Context Interrupter Target field.
每次用 Stop Endpoint 命令停止一个传输环时，xHC 都必须生成一个 Stopped Transfer Event。该操作称为 Force Stopped Event（FSE）。被强制的 Stopped Transfer Event 向软件明确指示所选传输环已停止。若发出 Stop Endpoint 命令时传输环为空，则必须在由槽上下文 Interrupter Target 字段所指示的事件环上生成一个 Stopped Transfer Event。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1859-L1865（p121）

2933	}


2934out:


2935	xhci_free_command(xhci, command);


2936


2937	return ret;


2938}

规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

流程图 · 4.6.9 Stop Endpoint 执行时机三场景 · 依据 spec-46.txt L1721-L1748
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
Depending on the timing of the execution of the Stop Endpoint command relative to the execution of the TDs on the ring, one of three of scenarios may result: • If the command is executed between TDs, then the xHC shall perform a Force Stopped Event (FSE) operation by generating a Transfer Event for the endpoint with Condition Code = Stopped - Invalid Length, TRB Pointer = current Dequeue Pointer value, and TRB Transfer Length = 0, then generate a Success Command Completion Event for the command. • If SPC = '1' and the command is executed, after a Short Packet condition has been detected, but before the end of the TD has been reached, (that is, the TD is in progress for the pipe), then a Transfer Event TRB with its Completion Code set to Stopped - Short Packet and its TRB Transfer Length set to the value of the EDTLA shall be forced for the interrupted TRB, irrespective of whether its IOC or ISP flags are set. This Transfer Event TRB will precede the Command Completion Event TRB for the command, and is referred to as a Stopped Transfer Event. • If a TD is in progress for the pipe when the command is executed, and a Short Packet condition has not been detected or SPC = ‘0’ and a Short Packet condition has been detected, then a Transfer Event TRB with its Completion Code set to Stopped, TRB Pointer = current Dequeue Pointer value, and TRB Transfer Length set to the residual bytes to transfer, shall be forced for the interrupted TRB, irrespective of whether its IOC or ISP flags are set. This Transfer Event TRB will precede the Command Completion Event TRB for the command, and is also referred to as a Stopped Transfer Event.
根据 Stop Endpoint 命令的执行相对于环上各 TD 执行的时序，可能出现三种情形之一： - 若命令在各 TD 之间执行，则 xHC 必须执行强制停止事件（Force Stopped Event，FSE）操作——为该端点生成一个 Condition Code = Stopped - Invalid Length、TRB Pointer = 当前 Dequeue Pointer 值、TRB Transfer Length = 0 的传输事件（Transfer Event），然后为本命令生成一个 Success 命令完成事件。 - 若 SPC = ‘1’ 且命令在检测到短包（Short Packet）条件之后、到达 TD 末尾之前执行（即该 TD 正在该管道上进行中），则会为被中断的 TRB 强制生成一个 Completion Code = Stopped - Short Packet、TRB Transfer Length = EDTLA 值的传输事件 TRB，无论其 IOC 或 ISP 标志是否置位。该传输事件 TRB 先于本命令的命令完成事件 TRB，称为 Stopped Transfer Event（停止传输事件）。 - 若命令执行时该管道上有一个 TD 正在进行中，且未检测到短包条件，或 SPC = ‘0’ 且已检测到短包条件，则会为被中断的 TRB 强制生成一个 Completion Code = Stopped、TRB Pointer = 当前 Dequeue Pointer 值、TRB Transfer Length = 待传输残余字节数的传输事件 TRB，无论其 IOC 或 ISP 标志是否置位。该传输事件 TRB 先于本命令的命令完成事件 TRB，也称为 Stopped Transfer Event。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1721-L1748（p120）
Note that when an endpoint is stopped, the xHC maintains the state necessary to restart the last active Transfer Ring where it left off, however software may not want to do this. The options are discussed below:
注意，端点停止时，xHC 会维持从上次停下的地方重启上一个活动传输环所需的状态，但软件可能并不想这样做。可选方案讨论如下：
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1751-L1753（p119）
流程图 · 4.6.9 端点停止后软件的三种后续 · 依据 spec-46.txt L1760-L1782
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
1. Temporarily Stop Transfer Ring Activity - If the intent of software in issuing the Stop Endpoint Command was just to temporarily stop activity on the Transfer Ring, then software may restart the stopped ring where it left off by simply ringing its doorbell. 2. Aborting a Transfer - If, because of a timeout or other reason, software issued the Stop Endpoint Command to abort the current TD. Then the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command may be used to force the xHC to dump any internal state that it has for the ring and restart activity at the new Transfer Ring location specified by the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command. 3. Modifying the order of execution of TDs on a Transfer Ring - It may be necessary for software to place a “high priority” TD on a ring, by inserting a TD ahead of any pending TDs. To safely modify the order of execution of TDs on a ring, software shall first stop the endpoint. When an endpoint is stopped, software may examine the Event Ring to determine the current state of TDs on the associated Transfer Ring(s). If the xHC stopped in the middle of a TD, then that TD may not be modified by software, however any other TDs on the ring may be. If the xHC stopped between TDs, then it may modify any TD on the transfer ring. After the TDs are inserted, removed, or rearranged to the satisfaction of software, it may ring the doorbell to restart operation on the ring.
1. 暂时停止传输环活动——若软件发出 Stop Endpoint 命令的意图只是暂时停止传输环上的活动，那么软件只需振铃其门铃，即可让被停止的环从停下的地方重启。 2. 中止一个传输——若软件因超时或其他原因发出 Stop Endpoint 命令以中止当前 TD，则之后可以使用 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，迫使 xHC 丢弃它为该环保存的任何内部状态，并在 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令指定的新传输环位置重启活动。 3. 修改传输环上 TD 的执行顺序——软件可能需要在环上放置一个“高优先级”TD，即把一个 TD 插到任何挂起（pending）TD 之前。为安全地修改环上 TD 的执行顺序，软件必须先停止端点。端点停止后，软件可以检查事件环，以确定相关传输环上各 TD 的当前状态。若 xHC 停在某个 TD 的中间，则该 TD 不可被软件修改，但环上的任何其他 TD 均可修改。若 xHC 停在各 TD 之间，则它可以修改传输环上的任何 TD。在 TD 被插入、删除或重排到软件满意之后，它可以振铃门铃以重启环上的操作。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1760-L1782（p120）
流程图 · 4.6.9 停止端点时 xHC 执行的操作 · 依据 spec-46.txt L1792-L1816
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
The xHC shall perform the following operations when Stopping an endpoint: • The xHC shall stop the USB activity for the pipe. • If a USB IN or OUT transaction is in-flight, it shall be completed. • ERDYs shall be ignored on the pipe for that endpoint. • If LS, FS, or HS, then polling of the pipe shall cease. • If an SS pipe is waiting for an ERDY, the xHC shall clear the flow control condition and cease waiting for the ERDY. A Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command clears any transfer related state associated with an endpoint. If an SS pipe was waiting for an ERDY when the endpoint was stopped, then if the endpoint transfer state was not cleared by a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command, the xHC shall reissue an IN or OUT for the pipe when the ring is restarted. • The current endpoint Service Opportunity (SO) shall be terminated. • Stop the Transfer Ring activity for the pipe. Refer to Table 4-2 for Stop conditions and Actions. • Remove the endpoint from the xHC’s Pipe Schedule. • Generate a Command Completion Event.
停止端点时，xHC 必须执行以下操作： - xHC 必须停止该管道的 USB 活动。 - 若有一个 USB IN 或 OUT 事务在途（in-flight），则必须让它完成。 - 该端点管道上的 ERDY 必须被忽略。 - 若为 LS、FS 或 HS，则必须停止对该管道的轮询。 - 若一个 SS 管道正在等待 ERDY，则 xHC 必须清除该流控条件并停止等待 ERDY。 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令会清除与端点相关联的任何传输相关状态。若端点被停止时某个 SS 管道正在等待 ERDY，而该端点的传输状态又未被 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令清除，则环重启时 xHC 必须为该管道重新发出一次 IN 或 OUT。 - 当前的端点服务机会（Service Opportunity，SO）必须被终止。 - 停止该管道的传输环活动。停止条件与动作参见表 4-2。 - 将该端点移出 xHC 的 Pipe Schedule。 - 生成一个命令完成事件。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1792-L1816（p120）

16A “Transfer” TRB is a Normal, Setup Stage, Data Stage, Status Stage, or Isoch TRB. Note, this row identifies the case where the endpoint has stopped on a TRB (that is not the last TRB of a TD), where all the data associated with the TRB has already been transferred.
17This condition is interpreted identically to a “Transfer TRB (Incomplete)”, where 0 bytes have been transferred.
18 ISSE - If SPC = ‘1’, and a Short Packet condition has been detected, and the end of the TD has not been reached, then the xHC shall perform an Intermediate Short Stopped Event (ISSE) operation, generating a Transfer Event for the endpoint with Condition Code = Stopped - Short Packet, TRB Pointer = current Dequeue Pointer value, and TRB Transfer Length = EDTLA.
19In this case the xHC is expected to complete the TD normally (for example, generate a Transfer Event with CC = Success if the IOC flag is set and the transfer was successful) and then perform a Force Stopped Event (FSE) operation.

流程图 · 4.6.9 Stop Endpoint 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2038-L2041 + L2056-L2068
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Stop Endpoint Command system software shall perform the following operations. Insert a Stop Endpoint Command on the Command Ring and initialize the following fields:
要发出 Stop Endpoint 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作。 在命令环上插入一个 Stop Endpoint 命令，并初始化以下字段：
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2038-L2041（p123）
• TRB Type = Stop Endpoint Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Endpoint ID = ID of the target endpoint. o Slot ID = ID of the target Device Slot. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
- TRB Type = Stop Endpoint 命令（参见表 6-91）。 - Endpoint ID = 目标端点的 ID。 - Slot ID = 目标设备槽的 ID。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2056-L2068（p124）
流程图 · 4.6.9 Stop Endpoint 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2069-L2104 + L2106-L2119 + L2126-L2165
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Stop Endpoint Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations. If the Stop Endpoint Command interrupted the execution of a TD, then insert a Transfer Event on the Event Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Transfer Event. o Slot ID = The value of the command’s Slot ID. o Endpoint ID = The value of the command’s Endpoint ID. o If the TRB referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer is an Event Data TRB: • ED = ‘1’. • Parameter Component (TRB Pointer) = 64 bits of Event Data TRB Parameter component. • Length = The value of the Event Data Transfer Length Accumulator (EDTLA). Refer to section 4.11.5.2 for a description of EDTLA. o else // The TRB referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer is not an Event Data TRB • ED = ‘0’. • TRB Pointer = The address of the TRB interrupted by the command. • Length = The number of bytes remaining to be moved for the interrupted TRB. o Completion Code = Stopped (refer to Table 6-90). o Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag.
当 xHC 执行 Stop Endpoint 命令时，它必须执行以下操作。 若 Stop Endpoint 命令中断了某个 TD 的执行，则在事件环上插入一个 Transfer Event，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Transfer Event。 - Slot ID = 该命令的 Slot ID 字段值。 - Endpoint ID = 该命令的 Endpoint ID 字段值。 - 若 TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用的 TRB 是 Event Data TRB： - ED = ‘1’。 - Parameter Component（TRB Pointer）= Event Data TRB 的 64 位 Parameter 分量。 - Length = 事件数据传输长度累加器（Event Data Transfer Length Accumulator，EDTLA）的值。EDTLA 的描述参见第 4.11.5.2 节。 - else // TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用的 TRB 不是 Event Data TRB - ED = ‘0’。 - TRB Pointer = 被本命令中断的 TRB 的地址。 - Length = 被中断 TRB 尚待搬移的字节数。 - Completion Code = Stopped（参见表 6-90）。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2069-L2104（p124）
Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Command Completion Event. o Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Stop Endpoint Command TRB. o Slot ID = The value of the command’s Slot ID. o If the Device Slot identified by the Slot ID has been previously enabled by an Enable Slot Command: • Retrieve the Device Context of the selected Device Slot.
- Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。 - 在事件环上插入一个命令完成事件，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Command Completion Event。 - Command TRB Pointer = Stop Endpoint 命令 TRB 的地址。 - Slot ID = 该命令的 Slot ID 字段值。 - 若由 Slot ID 所标识的设备槽此前已被某个 Enable Slot 命令启用： - 取回所选设备槽的设备上下文。 - 若槽状态被置为 Default、Configured 或 Addressed：若端点状态（EP State）字段等于 Running： - 按上文所述停止该管道的 USB 活动。 - 按上文所述停止该管道的传输环活动。 - 把 Dequeue Pointer 值写入输出端点或流上下文的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段。 - 把 CCS 值写入输出端点或流上下文的 Dequeue Cycle State（DCS）字段。 - 将该端点移出 xHC 的 Pipe Schedule。 - 将端点状态（EP State）字段置为 Stopped。 - Completion Code = Success。 - else // 端点状态（EP State）字段不等于 Running - Completion Code = Context State Error。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2106-L2119（p124）
• If the Slot State is set to Default, Configured, or Addressed: • If the Endpoint State (EP State) field equals Running: • Stop the USB activity for the pipe as described above. • Stop the Transfer Ring activity for the pipe as described above. • Write Dequeue Pointer value to the Output Endpoint or Stream Context TR Dequeue Pointer field. • Write CCS value to the Output Endpoint or Stream Context Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) field. • Removed the endpoint from the xHC’s Pipe Schedule. • Set the Endpoint State (EP State) field to Stopped. • Completion Code = Success. • else // The Endpoint State (EP State) field is not Running • Completion Code = Context State Error. • else // The Slot State is not set to Default, Configured, or Addressed o Completion Code = Context State Error. • else // The slot has not been enabled by an Enable Slot Command o Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error • Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. • Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag. Note: The xHC resources and bandwidth associated with an endpoint are not released by the Stop Endpoint Command. Note: The xHC shall wait for any partially completed USB2 split transactions to finish before completing the Stop Endpoint Command.
- 取回所选设备槽的设备上下文。 - 若槽状态被置为 Default、Configured 或 Addressed：若端点状态（EP State）字段等于 Running： - 按上文所述停止该管道的 USB 活动。 - 按上文所述停止该管道的传输环活动。 - 把 Dequeue Pointer 值写入输出端点或流上下文的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段。 - 把 CCS 值写入输出端点或流上下文的 Dequeue Cycle State（DCS）字段。 - 将该端点移出 xHC 的 Pipe Schedule。 - 将端点状态（EP State）字段置为 Stopped。 - Completion Code = Success。 - else // 端点状态（EP State）字段不等于 Running - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - else // 槽状态未置为 Default、Configured 或 Addressed - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - else // 该槽尚未被 Enable Slot 命令启用 - Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。 注：与端点相关联的 xHC 资源和带宽不会因 Stop Endpoint 命令而释放。 注：在完成 Stop Endpoint 命令之前，xHC 必须等待任何部分完成的 USB2 拆分事务先行完成。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2126-L2165（p125）
上游 commit 1174d44906d517ddb4f98bbe58a44d4554d0ef90 · 2021-01-29 · Mathias Nyman（Intel） · drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c 1 文件 +13/-0 · hunks @@ -983,6 +983,7 @@ / @@ -1029,6 +1030,18 @@（均在 xhci_handle_cmd_stop_ep）

完整补丁 · git show 逐字

commit 1174d44906d517ddb4f98bbe58a44d4554d0ef90
Author: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
Date:   Fri Jan 29 15:00:40 2021 +0200

    xhci: handle stop endpoint command completion with endpoint in running state.
    
    Handle race where a stop endpoint command fails with "context state error"
    as hardware hasn't actually started the ring yet after a previous urb
    cancellation completed and restarted the endpoint.
    Flushing the doorbell write that restart the endpoint reduced these cases,
    but didn't completely resolve them.
    
    Check if the ring is running in the stop endpoint completion handler, and
    issue a new stop endpoint command in this case.
    
    Signed-off-by: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
    Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210129130044.206855-24-mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com
    Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
index 3ba91580e222..307ccd40ccac 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
@@ -983,6 +983,7 @@ static void xhci_handle_cmd_stop_ep(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, int slot_id,
 	struct xhci_ep_ctx *ep_ctx;
 	struct xhci_td *td = NULL;
 	enum xhci_ep_reset_type reset_type;
+	struct xhci_command *command;
 
 	if (unlikely(TRB_TO_SUSPEND_PORT(le32_to_cpu(trb->generic.field[3])))) {
 		if (!xhci->devs[slot_id])
@@ -1029,6 +1030,18 @@ static void xhci_handle_cmd_stop_ep(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, int slot_id,
 			/* reset ep, reset handler cleans up cancelled tds */
 			xhci_handle_halted_endpoint(xhci, ep, 0, td, reset_type);
 			xhci_stop_watchdog_timer_in_irq(xhci, ep);
+			return;
+		case EP_STATE_RUNNING:
+			/* Race, HW handled stop ep cmd before ep was running */
+			command = xhci_alloc_command(xhci, false, GFP_ATOMIC);
+			if (!command)
+				xhci_stop_watchdog_timer_in_irq(xhci, ep);
+
+			mod_timer(&ep->stop_cmd_timer,
+				  jiffies + XHCI_STOP_EP_CMD_TIMEOUT * HZ);
+			xhci_queue_stop_endpoint(xhci, command, slot_id, ep_index, 0);
+			xhci_ring_cmd_db(xhci);
+
 			return;
 		default:
 			break;

背景（何时 / 谁修 / 为什么是它）

2021 年 1 月，Intel Mathias Nyman 提交（halted endpoint 修复系列之一，lore 20210129130044.206855-24）。场景：上一轮 URB 取消完成并重启端点后，硬件可能尚未真正开始跑环；此时软件再发 Stop Endpoint，完成码报 "context state error" 假失败——重启用的门铃写已做 flush，降低了概率但未根除（message 原文）。对应 §4.6.9 停止链的完成处理面：本卡贴码的 sync 包装只受理 Running 并等完成，完成态里的竞态归完成处理器管。

要解决的问题（症状 + 机制）

症状：取消风暴场景下 Stop Endpoint 假失败残留——完成码 Context State Error 但环实际已在跑，端点停在「半停」态。机制：完成处理器的 COMP_CONTEXT_STATE_ERROR 分支此前只按「真的没停下来」处理；规范 p122 竞态 Note（L1881-1887）明确 Context State Error 可能来自 Busy 端点的异步翻转——本补丁修的正是其反向形态：EP 实际 Running、命令却报错=竞态败给了取消重启。

代码逻辑（补丁前 → 后行为对照）

EP_STATE_RUNNING case 补竞态分支（+11）：原地 GFP_ATOMIC 分配命令、重挂 stop_cmd_timer、重发 Stop Endpoint 命令、重敲命令环门铃；halted case 补 return; 止住串入。补丁后：假失败当场自愈，端点必达 Stopped。与贴码对读：下方补丁对读段琥珀行（race 注释/重发命令）即本修复块——本补丁已在基线 d9008e061539 内（后续 42b758137601 加 100ms 重试上限与 fallthrough，语义同源）；本卡贴码 det:24 热行（完成侧无处理注释）即修复前的入口；分帧走读见 ch4609p（scene=44）。

1194static void xhci_handle_cmd_stop_ep(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, int slot_id,


1195				    union xhci_trb *trb, u32 comp_code)


1196{


1197	unsigned int ep_index;


1198	struct xhci_virt_ep *ep;


1199	struct xhci_ep_ctx *ep_ctx;


1200	struct xhci_td *td = NULL;


1201	enum xhci_ep_reset_type reset_type;


1202	struct xhci_command *command;


1203	int err;


1204


1205	if (unlikely(TRB_TO_SUSPEND_PORT(le32_to_cpu(trb->generic.field[3])))) {


1206		if (!xhci->devs[slot_id])


1207			xhci_warn(xhci, "Stop endpoint command completion for disabled slot %u\n",


1208				  slot_id);


1209		return;


1210	}


1211


1212	ep_index = TRB_TO_EP_INDEX(le32_to_cpu(trb->generic.field[3]));


1213	ep = xhci_get_virt_ep(xhci, slot_id, ep_index);


1214	if (!ep)


1215		return;


1216


1217	ep_ctx = xhci_get_ep_ctx(xhci, ep->vdev->out_ctx, ep_index);


1218


1219	trace_xhci_handle_cmd_stop_ep(ep_ctx);


1220


1221	if (comp_code == COMP_CONTEXT_STATE_ERROR) {


1222	/*


1223	 * If stop endpoint command raced with a halting endpoint we need to


1224	 * reset the host side endpoint first.


1225	 * If the TD we halted on isn't cancelled the TD should be given back


1226	 * with a proper error code, and the ring dequeue moved past the TD.


1227	 * If streams case we can't find hw_deq, or the TD we halted on so do a


1228	 * soft reset.


1229	 *


1230	 * Proper error code is unknown here, it would be -EPIPE if device side


1231	 * of enadpoit halted (aka STALL), and -EPROTO if not (transaction error)


1232	 * We use -EPROTO, if device is stalled it should return a stall error on


1233	 * next transfer, which then will return -EPIPE, and device side stall is


1234	 * noted and cleared by class driver.


1235	 */


1236		switch (GET_EP_CTX_STATE(ep_ctx)) {


1237		case EP_STATE_HALTED:


1238			xhci_dbg(xhci, "Stop ep completion raced with stall\n");


1239			/*


1240			 * If the halt happened before Stop Endpoint failed, its transfer event


1241			 * should have already been handled and Reset Endpoint should be pending.


1242			 */


1243			if (ep->ep_state & EP_HALTED)


1244				goto reset_done;


1245


1246			if (ep->ep_state & EP_HAS_STREAMS) {


1247				reset_type = EP_SOFT_RESET;


1248			} else {


1249				reset_type = EP_HARD_RESET;


1250				td = find_halted_td(xhci, ep);


1251				if (td)


1252					td->status = -EPROTO;


1253			}


1254			/* reset ep, reset handler cleans up cancelled tds */


1255			err = xhci_handle_halted_endpoint(xhci, ep, td, reset_type);


1256			xhci_dbg(xhci, "Stop ep completion resetting ep, status %d\n", err);


1257			if (err)


1258				break;


1259reset_done:


1260			/* Reset EP handler will clean up cancelled TDs */


1261			ep->ep_state &= ~EP_STOP_CMD_PENDING;


1262			return;


1263		case EP_STATE_STOPPED:


1264			/*


1265			 * Per xHCI 4.6.9, Stop Endpoint command on a Stopped


1266			 * EP is a Context State Error, and EP stays Stopped.


1267			 *


1268			 * But maybe it failed on Halted, and somebody ran Reset


1269			 * Endpoint later. EP state is now Stopped and EP_HALTED


1270			 * still set because Reset EP handler will run after us.


1271			 */


1272			if (ep->ep_state & EP_HALTED)


1273				break;


1274			/*


1275			 * On some HCs EP state remains Stopped for some tens of


1276			 * us to a few ms or more after a doorbell ring, and any


1277			 * new Stop Endpoint fails without aborting the restart.


1278			 * This handler may run quickly enough to still see this


1279			 * Stopped state, but it will soon change to Running.


1280			 *


1281			 * Assume this bug on unexpected Stop Endpoint failures.


1282			 * Keep retrying until the EP starts and stops again or


1283			 * up to a timeout (a defective HC may never start, or a


1284			 * driver bug may cause stopping an already stopped EP).


1285			 */


1286			if (time_is_before_jiffies(ep->stop_time + msecs_to_jiffies(100)))


1287				break;


1288			fallthrough;


1289		case EP_STATE_RUNNING:


1290			/* Race, HW handled stop ep cmd before ep was running */


1291			xhci_dbg(xhci, "Stop ep completion ctx error, ctx_state %d\n",


1292					GET_EP_CTX_STATE(ep_ctx));


1293


1294			command = xhci_alloc_command(xhci, false, GFP_ATOMIC);


1295			if (!command) {


1296				ep->ep_state &= ~EP_STOP_CMD_PENDING;


1297				return;


1298			}


1299			xhci_queue_stop_endpoint(xhci, command, slot_id, ep_index, 0);


1300			xhci_ring_cmd_db(xhci);


1301


1302			return;


1303		default:


1304			break;


1305		}


1306	}


1307


1308	/* link is inactive or disconnected, ep is not running and shouldn't be restarted */


1309	if (ep->vdev->rhub_port->link_inactive || !ep->vdev->rhub_port->connected)


1310		ep->ep_state |= EP_DROP_PENDING;


1311


1312	/* will queue a set TR deq if stopped on a cancelled, uncleared TD */


1313	xhci_invalidate_cancelled_tds(xhci, ep);


1314	ep->ep_state &= ~EP_STOP_CMD_PENDING;


1315


1316	/* Otherwise ring the doorbell(s) to restart queued transfers */


1317	xhci_giveback_invalidated_tds(xhci, ep);


1318	xhci_ring_doorbell_for_active_rings(xhci, slot_id, ep_index);


1319}
补丁分帧动画 · 三幕走读 → 背景现场 → diff 逐行走读 → 规范收尾（对照 §4.6.9 p122 竞态 Note）
4.6.10Set TR Dequeue Pointer核心命令p125-p128

规范引文（机制主线）

The Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command is issued by software to modify the TR Dequeue Pointer field of an Endpoint or Stream Context.
软件发出 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令（设置 TR 出队指针命令），以修改端点或流上下文（Stream Context）的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2168-L2169（p125）
The Slot ID and Endpoint ID fields of the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command TRB identify the USB device, and the endpoint of that device, that is the target of the command. If Streams are enabled for the endpoint, the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command TRB Stream ID field identifies the Stream Context that shall be modified.
Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令 TRB 的 Slot ID 与 Endpoint ID 字段标识作为该命令目标的 USB 设备以及该设备上的相应端点。若该端点已启用流（Stream），则 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令 TRB 的 Stream ID 字段标识将被修改的流上下文。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2170-L2174（p125）
This command may be executed only if the target endpoint is in the Error or Stopped state.
只有当目标端点处于 Error 或 Stopped 状态时，才可执行此命令。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2175-L2176（p125）
Note: If, when the Transfer Ring was stopped a TD was only partially executed, then any remaining TRBs in that TD shall not be executed when the endpoints’ TR Dequeue Pointer is updated by the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command.
注：若传输环（Transfer Ring）停止时某 TD 仅被部分执行，则当 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令更新端点的 TR Dequeue Pointer 时，该 TD 中剩余的 TRB 不得被执行。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2213-L2215（p126）
Note: Consider the case where there are multiple TDs posted for pipe for a single data transfer and an error condition on one TD means that the data transfer is terminated, and that the subsequent TDs associated with the data transfer are now invalid. The xHC may have read ahead on the Transfer Ring and cached the subsequent TDs. To ensure that xHC frees any cached information associated with a pipe in a timely manner (so that it can reuse the cache space for other pipes), software shall issue a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command for the pipe when the data transfer is terminated, vs. waiting for the next data transfer to be ready before issuing the command.
注：考虑如下情形：单次数据传输为某管道投递了多个 TD，而其中一个 TD 上的错误条件意味着该数据传输被终止，与该数据传输相关联的后续 TD 现已无效。xHC 可能已在传输环上预读并缓存了这些后续 TD。为确保 xHC 及时释放与某管道相关联的任何缓存信息（以便将缓存空间复用于其他管道），软件必须在数据传输终止时即为该管道发出 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，而不是等到下一次数据传输就绪后才发出该命令。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2330-L2338（p128）
Note: If software issues a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command that points to a TRB that had previously been partially completed TD, the xHC shall treat that TRB as the first TRB of the TD. that is, any prior state associated with a partially completed TRB is lost.
注：若软件发出的 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令指向一个先前属于某部分完成 TD 的 TRB，则 xHC 必须将该 TRB 视为该 TD 的第一个 TRB，即与部分完成 TRB 相关联的任何先前状态都会丢失。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2339-L2342（p128）

1431static void xhci_handle_cmd_set_deq(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, int slot_id,


1432		union xhci_trb *trb, u32 cmd_comp_code)


1433{


1434	unsigned int ep_index;


1435	unsigned int stream_id;


1436	struct xhci_ring *ep_ring;


1437	struct xhci_virt_ep *ep;


1438	struct xhci_ep_ctx *ep_ctx;


1439	struct xhci_slot_ctx *slot_ctx;


1440	struct xhci_stream_ctx *stream_ctx;


1441	struct xhci_td *td, *tmp_td;


1442


1443	ep_index = TRB_TO_EP_INDEX(le32_to_cpu(trb->generic.field[3]));


1444	stream_id = TRB_TO_STREAM_ID(le32_to_cpu(trb->generic.field[2]));


1445	ep = xhci_get_virt_ep(xhci, slot_id, ep_index);


1446	if (!ep)


1447		return;


1448


1449	ep_ring = xhci_virt_ep_to_ring(xhci, ep, stream_id);


1450	if (!ep_ring) {


1451		xhci_warn(xhci, "WARN Set TR deq ptr command for freed stream ID %u\n",


1452				stream_id);


1453		/* XXX: Harmless??? */


1454		goto cleanup;


1455	}


1456


1457	ep_ctx = xhci_get_ep_ctx(xhci, ep->vdev->out_ctx, ep_index);


1458	slot_ctx = xhci_get_slot_ctx(xhci, ep->vdev->out_ctx);


1459	trace_xhci_handle_cmd_set_deq(slot_ctx);


1460	trace_xhci_handle_cmd_set_deq_ep(ep_ctx);


1461


1462	if (ep->ep_state & EP_HAS_STREAMS) {


1463		stream_ctx = &ep->stream_info->stream_ctx_array[stream_id];


1464		trace_xhci_handle_cmd_set_deq_stream(ep->stream_info, stream_id);


1465	}


1466


1467	if (cmd_comp_code != COMP_SUCCESS) {


1468		unsigned int ep_state;


1469		unsigned int slot_state;


1470


1471		switch (cmd_comp_code) {


1472		case COMP_TRB_ERROR:


1473			xhci_warn(xhci, "WARN Set TR Deq Ptr cmd invalid because of stream ID configuration\n");


1474			break;


1475		case COMP_CONTEXT_STATE_ERROR:


1476			xhci_warn(xhci, "WARN Set TR Deq Ptr cmd failed due to incorrect slot or ep state.\n");


1477			ep_state = GET_EP_CTX_STATE(ep_ctx);


1478			slot_state = le32_to_cpu(slot_ctx->dev_state);


1479			slot_state = GET_SLOT_STATE(slot_state);


1480			xhci_dbg_trace(xhci, trace_xhci_dbg_cancel_urb,


1481					"Slot state = %u, EP state = %u",


1482					slot_state, ep_state);


1483			break;


1484		case COMP_SLOT_NOT_ENABLED_ERROR:


1485			xhci_warn(xhci, "WARN Set TR Deq Ptr cmd failed because slot %u was not enabled.\n",


1486					slot_id);


1487			break;


1488		default:


1489			xhci_warn(xhci, "WARN Set TR Deq Ptr cmd with unknown completion code of %u.\n",


1490					cmd_comp_code);


1491			break;


1492		}


1493		/* OK what do we do now?  The endpoint state is hosed, and we


1494		 * should never get to this point if the synchronization between


1495		 * queueing, and endpoint state are correct.  This might happen


1496		 * if the device gets disconnected after we've finished


1497		 * cancelling URBs, which might not be an error...


1498		 */


1499	} else {


1500		u64 deq;


1501		/* 4.6.10 deq ptr is written to the stream ctx for streams */


1502		if (ep->ep_state & EP_HAS_STREAMS) {


1503			deq = le64_to_cpu(stream_ctx->stream_ring) & TR_DEQ_PTR_MASK;


1504


1505			/*


1506			 * Cadence xHCI controllers store some endpoint state


1507			 * information within Rsvd0 fields of Stream Endpoint


1508			 * context. This field is not cleared during Set TR


1509			 * Dequeue Pointer command which causes XDMA to skip

1511			 * pipe.


1512			 * To fix this issue driver must clear Rsvd0 field.


1513			 */


1514			if (xhci->quirks & XHCI_CDNS_SCTX_QUIRK) {


1515				stream_ctx->reserved[0] = 0;


1516				stream_ctx->reserved[1] = 0;


1517			}


1518		} else {


1519			deq = le64_to_cpu(ep_ctx->deq) & TR_DEQ_PTR_MASK;


1520		}


1521		xhci_dbg_trace(xhci, trace_xhci_dbg_cancel_urb,


1522			"Successful Set TR Deq Ptr cmd, deq = @%08llx", deq);


1523		if (xhci_trb_virt_to_dma(ep->queued_deq_seg,


1524					 ep->queued_deq_ptr) == deq) {


1525			/* Update the ring's dequeue segment and dequeue pointer


1526			 * to reflect the new position.


1527			 */


1528			ep_ring->deq_seg = ep->queued_deq_seg;


1529			ep_ring->dequeue = ep->queued_deq_ptr;


1530		} else {


1531			xhci_warn(xhci, "Mismatch between completed Set TR Deq Ptr command & xHCI internal state.\n");


1532			xhci_warn(xhci, "ep deq seg = %p, deq ptr = %p\n",


1533				  ep->queued_deq_seg, ep->queued_deq_ptr);


1534		}


1535	}


1536	/* HW cached TDs cleared from cache, give them back */


1537	list_for_each_entry_safe(td, tmp_td, &ep->cancelled_td_list,


1538				 cancelled_td_list) {


1539		ep_ring = xhci_urb_to_transfer_ring(xhci, td->urb);


1540		if (td->cancel_status == TD_CLEARING_CACHE) {


1541			td->cancel_status = TD_CLEARED;


1542			xhci_dbg(xhci, "%s: Giveback cancelled URB %p TD\n",


1543				 __func__, td->urb);


1544			xhci_td_cleanup(xhci, td, ep_ring, td->status);


1545		} else {


1546			xhci_dbg(xhci, "%s: Keep cancelled URB %p TD as cancel_status is %d\n",


1547				 __func__, td->urb, td->cancel_status);


1548		}


1549	}


1550cleanup:


1551	ep->ep_state &= ~SET_DEQ_PENDING;


1552	ep->queued_deq_seg = NULL;


1553	ep->queued_deq_ptr = NULL;


1554


1555	/* Check for deferred or newly cancelled TDs */


1556	if (!list_empty(&ep->cancelled_td_list)) {


1557		xhci_dbg(xhci, "%s: Pending TDs to clear, continuing with invalidation\n",


1558			 __func__);


1559		xhci_invalidate_cancelled_tds(xhci, ep);


1560		/* Try to restart the endpoint if all is done */


1561		xhci_ring_doorbell_for_active_rings(xhci, slot_id, ep_index);


1562		/* Start giving back any TDs invalidated above */


1563		xhci_giveback_invalidated_tds(xhci, ep);


1564	} else {


1565		/* Restart any rings with pending URBs */


1566		xhci_dbg(xhci, "%s: All TDs cleared, ring doorbell\n", __func__);


1567		xhci_ring_doorbell_for_active_rings(xhci, slot_id, ep_index);


1568	}


1569}

规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

The xHC shall perform the following operations when setting a ring address:
设置环地址时，xHC 必须执行以下操作：
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2181-L2182（p125）
流程图 · 4.6.10 设置环地址时 xHC 执行的操作 · 依据 spec-46.txt L2181-L2209（引文窗 L2188-L2209，导语句 L2181-L2182）
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
• If the endpoint is not in the Error or Stopped state when the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command is executed: o The xHC shall reject the command and generate a Command Completion Event with the Completion Code set to Context State Error. • else // The endpoint is in the Error or Stopped state o Set the Dequeue Pointer to the value of the New TR Dequeue Pointer field in the Set TR Dequeue Pointer TRB. o Invalidate any xHC TDs that may be cached, forcing xHC to fetch Transfer TRBs from memory when the pipe transitions from the Stopped to the Running state. • Copy the value of the New TR Dequeue Pointer field in the Set TR Dequeue Pointer TRB to the TR Dequeue Pointer field of the target Endpoint or Stream Context. o Clear any prior transfer state, for example, setting the EDTLA to 0, clearing any partially completed USB2 split transactions, etc.
- 执行 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令时，若端点不处于 Error 或 Stopped 状态： - xHC 必须拒绝该命令，并生成一个 Completion Code 置为 Context State Error 的命令完成事件。 - else // 端点处于 Error 或 Stopped 状态 - 将出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）设置为 Set TR Dequeue Pointer TRB 中 New TR Dequeue Pointer 字段的值。 - 使任何可能已被缓存的 xHC TD 失效，强制 xHC 在管道从 Stopped 状态转换到 Running 状态时从内存重新获取传输 TRB（Transfer TRB）。 - 将 Set TR Dequeue Pointer TRB 中 New TR Dequeue Pointer 字段的值复制到目标端点上下文或流上下文的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段。 - 清除任何先前的传输状态，例如将 EDTLA 置 0、清除任何部分完成的 USB2 拆分事务等。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2188-L2209（p126）
流程图 · 4.6.10 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2220-L2243 + L2250-L2252
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command system software shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command on the Command Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Endpoint ID = ID of the target endpoint. o Stream ID = ID of the target Stream Context or ‘0’ if MaxPStreams = ‘0’. o Slot ID = ID of the target Device Slot. o New TR Dequeue Pointer = The new TR Dequeue Pointer field value for the target endpoint. o Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) = The state of the xHCI CCS flag for the TRB pointed to by the TR Dequeue Pointer field. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag.
要发出 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command（参见表 6-91）。 - Endpoint ID = 目标端点的 ID。 - Stream ID = 目标流上下文的 ID；若 MaxPStreams = ‘0’ 则为 ‘0’。 - Slot ID = 目标设备槽位（Device Slot）的 ID。 - New TR Dequeue Pointer = 目标端点新的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段值。 - Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) = TR Dequeue Pointer 字段所指向 TRB 的 xHCI CCS 标志状态。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2220-L2243（p126）
• Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
- 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2250-L2252（p127）
流程图 · 4.6.10 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2253-L2319 + L2326-L2329
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91). o Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command TRB. o Slot ID = The value of the command’s Slot ID. o If the Device Slot identified by the Slot ID has been enabled by an Enable Slot Command: • Retrieve the Device Context of the selected Device Slot. • If the Slot State is set to Default, Configured, or Addressed: o If the Endpoint State (EP State) field equals Stopped or Error: • If the Stream ID field is non-zero a Stream Context is referenced so perform a Stream ID boundary check as described in section 4.12.2.1: • If the Stream ID is valid: • Copy the value of the New TR Dequeue Pointer field to the TR Dequeue Pointer field of the target Stream Context. • Copy the value of the Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) field to the Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) field of the target Stream Context. • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). • else // The Stream ID is invalid • Completion Code = TRB Error. • else (Stream ID = ‘0’) • If MaxPStreams = ‘0’: • Copy the value of the New TR Dequeue Pointer field to the TR Dequeue Pointer field of the target Endpoint Context. • Copy the value of the Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) field to the Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) field of the target Endpoint Context. • Completion Code = Success. • else // MaxPStreams > ‘0’ • Completion Code = TRB Error. o else // The Endpoint State (EP State) field is not Stopped or Error • Completion Code = Context State Error. • else // The Slot State is not set to Default, Configured, or Addressed • Completion Code = Context State Error. o else // The slot has not been enabled by an Enable Slot Command • Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error
当 xHC 执行 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 在事件环（Event Ring）上插入一个命令完成事件，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令 TRB 的地址。 - Slot ID = 该命令的 Slot ID 字段值。 - 若 Slot ID 所标识的设备槽位已被某个 Enable Slot 命令启用： - 取回所选设备槽位的设备上下文（Device Context）。 - 若槽状态（Slot State）被置为 Default、Configured 或 Addressed： - 若端点状态（Endpoint State，EP State）字段等于 Stopped 或 Error： - 若 Stream ID 字段非零，则引用了一个流上下文，须按第 4.12.2.1 节所述执行 Stream ID 边界检查：• 若 Stream ID 有效： - 将 New TR Dequeue Pointer 字段的值复制到目标流上下文的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段。• 将 Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) 字段的值复制到目标流上下文的 Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) 字段。• Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - else // Stream ID 无效 - Completion Code = TRB Error。 - else（Stream ID = ‘0’）• 若 MaxPStreams = ‘0’：• 将 New TR Dequeue Pointer 字段的值复制到目标端点上下文的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段。• 将 Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) 字段的值复制到目标端点上下文的 Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) 字段。• Completion Code = Success。• else // MaxPStreams > ‘0’ - Completion Code = TRB Error。 - else // 端点状态（Endpoint State，EP State）字段不是 Stopped 或 Error - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - else // 槽状态（Slot State）未被置为 Default、Configured 或 Addressed - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - else // 该槽位尚未被 Enable Slot 命令启用 - Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2253-L2319（p127）
Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. • Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag. Note: Consider the case where there are multiple TDs posted for pipe for a single data transfer and an error condition on one TD means that the data transfer is terminated, and that the subsequent TDs associated with the data transfer are now invalid. The xHC may have read ahead on the Transfer Ring and cached the subsequent TDs. To ensure that xHC frees any cached information associated with a pipe in a timely manner (so that it can reuse the cache space for other pipes), software shall issue a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command for the pipe when the data transfer is terminated, vs. waiting for the next data transfer to be ready before issuing the command. Note: If software issues a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command that points to a TRB that had previously been partially completed TD, the xHC shall treat that TRB as the first TRB of the TD. that is, any prior state associated with a partially completed TRB is lost. Note: The xHC does not maintain knowledge of which Streams are active or non- active. If software issues a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command that targets an active Stream of an endpoint, undefined behavior may occur. Refer to section 4.12 for active vs. non-active Stream Context information)
- 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。 注：考虑如下情形：单次数据传输为某管道投递了多个 TD，而其中一个 TD 上的错误条件意味着该数据传输被终止，与该数据传输相关联的后续 TD 现已无效。xHC 可能已在传输环上预读并缓存了这些后续 TD。为确保 xHC 及时释放与某管道相关联的任何缓存信息（以便将缓存空间复用于其他管道），软件必须在数据传输终止时即为该管道发出 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，而不是等到下一次数据传输就绪后才发出该命令。 注：若软件发出的 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令指向一个先前属于某部分完成 TD 的 TRB，则 xHC 必须将该 TRB 视为该 TD 的第一个 TRB，即与部分完成 TRB 相关联的任何先前状态都会丢失。 注：xHC 不维护哪些流处于活动或非活动状态的信息。若软件发出的 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令以某端点的活动流为目标，可能发生未定义行为。活动与非活动流上下文的信息参见第 4.12 节。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2327-L2346（p128）
上游 commit 0d9f78a92ef5e97d9fe51d9215ebe22f6f0d289d · 2012-06-21 · Sarah Sharp（Intel） · drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c 1 文件 +11/-0 · hunk @@ -885,6 +885,17 @@（update_ring_for_set_deq_completion）· Cc: stable，回移至 3.4+

完整补丁 · git show 逐字

commit 0d9f78a92ef5e97d9fe51d9215ebe22f6f0d289d
Author: Sarah Sharp <sarah.a.sharp@linux.intel.com>
Date:   Thu Jun 21 16:28:30 2012 -0700

    xhci: Fix hang on back-to-back Set TR Deq Ptr commands.
    
    The Microsoft LifeChat 3000 USB headset was causing a very reproducible
    hang whenever it was plugged in.  At first, I thought the host
    controller was producing bad transfer events, because the log was filled
    with errors like:
    
    xhci_hcd 0000:00:14.0: ERROR Transfer event TRB DMA ptr not part of current TD
    
    However, it turned out to be an xHCI driver bug in the ring expansion
    patches.  The bug is triggered When there are two ring segments, and a
    TD that ends just before a link TRB, like so:
    
     ______________                     _____________
    |              |              ---> | setup TRB B |
     ______________               |     _____________
    |              |              |    |  data TRB B |
     ______________               |     _____________
    | setup TRB A  | <-- deq      |    |  data TRB B |
     ______________               |     _____________
    | data TRB A   |              |    |             | <-- enq, deq''
     ______________               |     _____________
    | status TRB A |              |    |             |
     ______________               |     _____________
    |  link TRB    |---------------    |  link TRB   |
     _____________  <--- deq'           _____________
    
    TD A (the first control transfer) stalls on the data phase.  That halts
    the ring.  The xHCI driver moves the hardware dequeue pointer to the
    first TRB after the stalled transfer, which happens to be the link TRB.
    
    Once the Set TR dequeue pointer command completes, the function
    update_ring_for_set_deq_completion runs.  That function is supposed to
    update the xHCI driver's dequeue pointer to match the internal hardware
    dequeue pointer.  On the first call this would work fine, and the
    software dequeue pointer would move to deq'.
    
    However, if the transfer immediately after that stalled (TD B in this
    case), another Set TR Dequeue command would be issued.  That would move
    the hardware dequeue pointer to deq''.  Once that command completed,
    update_ring_for_set_deq_completion would run again.
    
    The original code would unconditionally increment the software dequeue
    pointer, which moved the pointer off the ring segment into la-la-land.
    The while loop would happy increment the dequeue pointer (possibly
    wrapping it) until it matched the hardware pointer value.
    
    The while loop would also access all the memory in between the first
    ring segment and the second ring segment to determine if it was a link
    TRB.  This could cause general protection faults, although it was
    unlikely because the ring segments came from a DMA pool, and would often
    have consecutive memory addresses.
    
    If nothing in that space looked like a link TRB, the deq_seg pointer for
    the ring would remain on the first segment.  Thus, the deq_seg and the
    software dequeue pointer would get out of sync.
    
    When the next transfer event came in after the stalled transfer, the
    xHCI driver code would attempt to convert the software dequeue pointer
    into a DMA address in order to compare the DMA address for the completed
    transfer.  Since the deq_seg and the dequeue pointer were out of sync,
    xhci_trb_virt_to_dma would return NULL.
    
    The transfer event would get ignored, the transfer would eventually
    timeout, and we would mistakenly convert the finished transfer to no-op
    TRBs.  Some kernel driver (maybe xHCI?) would then get stuck in an
    infinite loop in interrupt context, and the whole machine would hang.
    
    This patch should be backported to kernels as old as 3.4, that contain
    the commit b008df60c6369ba0290fa7daa177375407a12e07 "xHCI: count free
    TRBs on transfer ring"
    
    Signed-off-by: Sarah Sharp <sarah.a.sharp@linux.intel.com>
    Cc: Andiry Xu <andiry.xu@amd.com>
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
index 23b4aefd1036..8275645889da 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
@@ -885,6 +885,17 @@ static void update_ring_for_set_deq_completion(struct xhci_hcd *xhci,
 	num_trbs_free_temp = ep_ring->num_trbs_free;
 	dequeue_temp = ep_ring->dequeue;
 
+	/* If we get two back-to-back stalls, and the first stalled transfer
+	 * ends just before a link TRB, the dequeue pointer will be left on
+	 * the link TRB by the code in the while loop.  So we have to update
+	 * the dequeue pointer one segment further, or we'll jump off
+	 * the segment into la-la-land.
+	 */
+	if (last_trb(xhci, ep_ring, ep_ring->deq_seg, ep_ring->dequeue)) {
+		ep_ring->deq_seg = ep_ring->deq_seg->next;
+		ep_ring->dequeue = ep_ring->deq_seg->trbs;
+	}
+
 	while (ep_ring->dequeue != dev->eps[ep_index].queued_deq_ptr) {
 		/* We have more usable TRBs */
 		ep_ring->num_trbs_free++;

背景（何时 / 谁修 / 为什么是它）

2012 年 6 月，Intel Sarah Sharp 提交。Microsoft LifeChat 3000 耳机一插就稳定挂死，日志刷屏 "ERROR Transfer event TRB DMA ptr not part of current TD"。触发面=双段环 + TD 恰好结束在 link TRB 之前：第一次 stall 后 Set TR Deq 把硬件出队指针停在 link TRB 上；紧接着又一次 stall、又一次 Set TR Deq（背靠背）。对应 §4.6.10 换起点链：命令的硬件面职责是改指针+失效缓存（p126），软件侧簿记（命令完成后 sw 出队指针对齐硬件实际位置）是本补丁的战场。

要解决的问题（症状 + 机制）

症状：整机挂死。机制（message 原文）：update_ring_for_set_deq_completion 无条件推进软件出队指针——指针已停在 link TRB（段尾）时一推即越出段外（la-la-land），while 循环在段间内存里狂找匹配（顺带 GPF 隐患），deq_seg 与 dequeue 失同步 → xhci_trb_virt_to_dma 返回 NULL → 后续传输事件被忽略 → 超时转 No-Op → 中断上下文死循环。

代码逻辑（补丁前 → 后行为对照）

while 循环前补 last_trb 段尾守卫（+11）：软件出队指针停在 link TRB 时，先把 deq_seg 前进一段、dequeue 回新段首，while 从正确的段出发找 queued_deq_ptr——越段扫描、失同步、挂死三点全堵。沿革（诚实注记）：该函数已于 2025-03-06 被 856563be98b2 移除（deq_seg/deq_ptr 直接存 queued_deq_seg/queued_deq_ptr，无需再搜），基线不含修复后形态，故本卡无对读段；本支判据=diff 原文（drafts/patch-48.txt）。与贴码对读：本卡贴码 set:27 热行（deq_seg 从 queued_* 取回）即该簿记的现代形态——修复保护的语义延续至今；分帧走读见 ch4610p（scene=45）。

补丁分帧动画 · 三幕走读 → 背景现场 → diff 逐行走读 → 规范收尾 + 函数沿革注记（无对读段：修复函数已退役）
4.6.11Reset Device核心命令p128-p130

规范引文（机制主线）

The Reset Device Command is used by software to inform the xHC that the USB Device associated with a Device Slot has been Reset (by either; setting the Root Hub port PR flag if the device is attached to a Root Hub port, or issuing a SetPortFeature(PORT_RESET) request the external hub port upstream of the device). In the Slot Context of the selected device slot, the reset operation sets the Slot State field to the Default state and the USB Device Address field to ‘0’. The reset operation also disables all endpoints of the slot except for the Default Control Endpoint by setting the Endpoint Context EP State field to Disabled in all enabled Endpoint Contexts. Software should stop
软件使用 Reset Device 命令（复位设备命令）通知 xHC：与某设备槽位相关联的 USB 设备已被复位（途径有二：若设备接入根集线器端口，则设置根集线器端口的 PR 标志；或向该设备上游的外部集线器端口发出 SetPortFeature(PORT_RESET) 请求）。在所选设备槽位的槽上下文（Slot Context）中，复位操作会将 Slot State 字段置为 Default 状态，并将 USB Device Address 字段置为 ‘0’。复位操作还会将所有已启用端点上下文（Endpoint Context）中的 EP State 字段置为 Disabled，从而禁用该槽位中除默认控制端点（Default Control Endpoint）以外的所有端点。软件应在发出 Reset Device 命令之前停止所有端点活动。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2349-L2357（p128）
For all endpoints except the Default Control Endpoint the xHC shall: • Terminate any USB activity (for example, packet transfers). • Disable the endpoints’ Doorbell. • Drop any pending events not already posted to an Event Ring. • Free any bandwidth allocated to the periodic endpoints. • Free any internal resources associated with the endpoint.
对于除默认控制端点以外的所有端点，xHC 必须： - 终止任何 USB 活动（例如包传输）。 - 禁用这些端点的门铃（Doorbell）。 - 丢弃任何尚未投递到事件环上的未决事件。 - 释放分配给周期端点（periodic endpoint）的任何带宽。 - 释放与该端点相关联的任何内部资源。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2359-L2369（p128）
The Reset Device Command forces a Device Slot to the Default state, however the Reset Device Command TRB (section 6.4.3.10) does not reference an Input Context, so there is no Input Context available to use to set the values of the Output Device Context. After the completion of a Reset Device Command the Slot and Endpoint 0 Contexts shall contain values that allow the xHC to issue requests to the Default Control Endpoint of the USB device that has just been reset. Refer to sections 6.2.2.4 and 6.2.3.7 for the respective Slot Context and Endpoint Context field value settings.
Reset Device 命令将设备槽位强制置于 Default 状态，但 Reset Device 命令 TRB（第 6.4.3.10 节）不引用输入上下文（Input Context），因此没有可用于设置输出设备上下文（Output Device Context）各字段值的输入上下文。Reset Device 命令完成后，槽上下文与端点 0 上下文（Endpoint 0 Context）必须包含使 xHC 能够向刚被复位的 USB 设备的默认控制端点发出请求的值。槽上下文与端点上下文各自的字段值设置参见第 6.2.2.4 节与第 6.2.3.7 节。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2447-L2454（p130）

4065		if (ep->ep_state & EP_HAS_STREAMS) {


4066			xhci_warn(xhci, "WARN: endpoint 0x%02x has streams on device reset, freeing streams.\n",


4067					xhci_get_endpoint_address(i));


4068			xhci_free_stream_info(xhci, ep->stream_info);


4069			ep->stream_info = NULL;


4070			ep->ep_state &= ~EP_HAS_STREAMS;


4071		}


4072


4073		if (ep->ring) {


4074			if (ep->sideband)


4075				xhci_sideband_notify_ep_ring_free(ep->sideband, i);


4076			xhci_debugfs_remove_endpoint(xhci, virt_dev, i);


4077			xhci_free_endpoint_ring(xhci, virt_dev, i);


4078		}


4079		if (!list_empty(&virt_dev->eps[i].bw_endpoint_list))


4080			xhci_drop_ep_from_interval_table(xhci,


4081					&virt_dev->eps[i].bw_info,


4082					virt_dev->bw_table,


4083					udev,


4084					&virt_dev->eps[i],


4085					virt_dev->tt_info);


4086		xhci_clear_endpoint_bw_info(&virt_dev->eps[i].bw_info);


4087	}


4088	/* If necessary, update the number of active TTs on this root port */


4089	xhci_update_tt_active_eps(xhci, virt_dev, old_active_eps);


4090	ret = 0;


4091


4092command_cleanup:


4093	for (i = 0; i < EP_CTX_PER_DEV; i++)


4094		virt_dev->eps[i].ep_state &= ~EP_DROP_PENDING;


4095


4096	xhci_free_command(xhci, reset_device_cmd);


4097	return ret;


4098}

流程图 · 4.6.11 Reset Device 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2385-L2400
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Reset Device Command system software shall perform the following operations: • Insert an Reset Device Command on the Command Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Reset Device Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Slot ID = The ID of the Device Slot to reset. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
要发出 Reset Device 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Reset Device 命令，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Reset Device Command（参见表 6-91）。 - Slot ID = 要复位的设备槽位的 ID。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2385-L2400（p129）
流程图 · 4.6.11 Reset Device 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2401-L2437
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Reset Device Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: • If the Device Slot is in the Addressed or Configured state: o Abort any USB transactions to the Device. o Set the Slot State field of Slot Context to the Default state. o Set the Context Entries field of Slot Context to ‘1’. o Set the USB Device Address field of Slot Context to ‘0’. o For each Endpoint Context of the Device Context (except the Default Control Endpoint): • Set the Endpoint Context EP State field to Disabled. • Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring of Interrupter 0 and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91). o Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Reset Device Command TRB. o If the Device Slot was in the Addressed or Configured state: • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). o else // The Device Slot was not in the Addressed or Configured state • Completion Code = Context State Error. o Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag.
当 xHC 执行 Reset Device 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 若设备槽位处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态： - 中止发往该设备的任何 USB 事务。 - 将槽上下文的 Slot State 字段置为 Default 状态。 - 将槽上下文的 Context Entries 字段置为 ‘1’。 - 将槽上下文的 USB Device Address 字段置为 ‘0’。 - 对设备上下文（Device Context）的每个端点上下文（默认控制端点除外）： - 将端点上下文的 EP State 字段置为 Disabled。 - 在中断器 0（Interrupter 0）的事件环上插入一个命令完成事件，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Reset Device 命令 TRB 的地址。 - 若该设备槽位此前处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态： - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - else // 设备槽位此前不处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态 - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2401-L2437（p129）
4.6.12Force Event可选命令p130-p131

规范引文（机制主线）

The Force Event Command is used by a VMM to insert an Event TRB in an Event Ring of a target VM when the VMM is emulating an xHC device to a VM. When a Force Event Command is processed by the xHC it shall insert an Event TRB on the target VFs’ Event Ring and copy the data pointed to by the Force Event Command, except for the Cycle bit, to the target Event TRB. The xHC shall set the Cycle bit to be consistent with the target VFs’ Event Ring.
当 VMM（虚拟机监视器）向虚拟机（VM）模拟一个 xHC 设备时，可使用 Force Event 命令（强制事件命令）向目标 VM 的某个事件环插入一个 Event TRB。 xHC 处理 Force Event 命令时，必须在目标 VF（Virtual Function，虚拟功能）的事件环上插入一个 Event TRB，并将 Force Event 命令所指向的数据（Cycle bit 除外）复制到目标 Event TRB。xHC 必须将 Cycle bit 设置为与目标 VF 的事件环相一致。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2457-L2462（p130）
A Command Completion Event with a TRB Error will be generated if the VF ID of the Force Event Command is not valid. A VF Event Ring Full Error shall be generated if the Target VF’s Event Ring is full.
若 Force Event 命令的 VF ID 无效，则会生成一个带 TRB Error 的命令完成事件。若目标 VF 的事件环已满，则必须生成 VF Event Ring Full Error。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2463-L2465（p130）
Note: When the command completes, the VMM may release the buffer containing the Event TRB pointed to by the Force Event Command. Note: The “forced” event shall be dropped if the target Event Ring is full. Software should reschedule a Force Event Command if an VF Event Ring Full Error is returned.
注：命令完成时，VMM 可以释放包含 Force Event 命令所指向的 Event TRB 的缓冲。 注：若目标事件环已满，被“强制”（forced）的事件必须被丢弃。若返回 VF Event Ring Full Error，软件应重新调度一个 Force Event 命令。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2544-L2548（p131）
