规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

流程图 · 4.6.12 Force Event 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2472-L2496
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Force Event Command system software shall perform the following operations: • Allocate and initialize the VF Event TRB that will be sent to the target VF’s Event Ring. The details of the VF Event TRB initialization will depend on the type of Event that is being forced. o Insert a Force Event Command on the Command Ring of the PF0 and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Force Event Command (refer to Table 6-91). o VF ID = ID of the target VF. o VF Interrupter Target = The ID of the target Interrupter assigned to the VF. Refer to Table 6-72 for more information on this value. o Event TRB Pointer = The address of the VF Event TRB. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
要发出 Force Event 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 分配并初始化将发送到目标 VF 事件环的 VF Event TRB。VF Event TRB 初始化的具体细节取决于被强制的事件的类型。 - 在 PF0 的命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Force Event 命令，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Force Event Command（参见表 6-91）。 - VF ID = 目标 VF 的 ID。 - VF Interrupter Target = 分配给该 VF 的目标中断器（Interrupter）的 ID。该值的更多信息参见表 6-72。 - Event TRB Pointer = VF Event TRB 的地址。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2472-L2496（p130）
流程图 · 4.6.12 Force Event 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2503-L2543
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Force Event Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring and initialize the following fields: • TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91). • Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Force Event Command TRB. • If the VF ID is valid: o If the VF Interrupter Target is in range for the VF: • If the target VF’s Event Ring is not full: o Insert the VF’s Event TRB referenced by the Force Event Command Event TRB Pointer into target VF’s Event Ring specified by the VF ID and the VF Interrupter Target fields: • Copy all fields of the VF Event TRB except the Cycle bit field to the target VF’s Event Ring. • Cycle bit = Target VF’s Event Ring’s PCS flag. • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). • else // The target VF’s Event Ring is full • Completion Code = VF Event Ring Full Error. o else // The VF Interrupter Target is not in range for the VF • Completion Code = TRB Error. o else // The VF ID is not valid • Completion Code = TRB Error. o Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag.
当 xHC 执行 Force Event 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： 在事件环（Event Ring）上插入一个命令完成事件，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Force Event 命令 TRB 的地址。 - 若 VF ID 有效： - 若 VF Interrupter Target 处于该 VF 的有效范围内： - 若目标 VF 的事件环未满： - 将由 Force Event 命令的 Event TRB Pointer 所引用的 VF Event TRB，插入由 VF ID 与 VF Interrupter Target 字段所指定的目标 VF 事件环： - 将 VF Event TRB 中除 Cycle bit 字段以外的所有字段复制到目标 VF 的事件环。 - Cycle bit = 目标 VF 事件环的 PCS 标志。 - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - else // 目标 VF 的事件环已满 - Completion Code = VF Event Ring Full Error。 - else // VF Interrupter Target 不在该 VF 的有效范围内 - Completion Code = TRB Error。 - else // VF ID 无效 - Completion Code = TRB Error。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2503-L2543（p131）
4.6.13Negotiate Bandwidth可选命令p131-p133

规范引文（机制主线）

The Negotiate Bandwidth Command is used by system software to initiate Bandwidth Request Events for periodic endpoints. This command should be used to recover unused USB bandwidth from the system. If the BW Negotiation Capability (BNC) bit in the HCCPARAMS1 register is ‘1’, the xHC shall support this command. This command shall complete with a Success Completion Code if the command is supported, or a TRB Error Completion Code if the command is not supported.
系统软件使用 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令（协商带宽命令）为周期端点发起带宽请求事件（Bandwidth Request Event）。建议使用此命令从系统中回收未使用的 USB 带宽。 若 HCCPARAMS1 寄存器中的 BW Negotiation Capability（BNC）位为 ‘1’，则 xHC 必须支持此命令。 若支持此命令，则该命令必须以 Success 完成码（Completion Code）完成；若不支持，则以 TRB Error 完成码完成。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2551-L2557（p131）
The xHC shall generate Bandwidth Request Events upon the reception of the command to all target periodic endpoints. The command will complete when all Bandwidth Request Events have been generated.
xHC 收到该命令后，必须向所有目标周期端点生成带宽请求事件。当所有带宽请求事件都已生成后，该命令即完成。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2564-L2566（p132）
Note: System software may never issue a Negotiate Bandwidth Command, however if the BNC flag is ‘1’ an unsolicited Bandwidth Request Event may be generated by hardware, for example, if the system software is running in a Virtual Machine and communicating with an xHCI Virtual Function. This condition occurs when system software running in another Virtual Machine issues a Negotiate Bandwidth Command through its xHCI Virtual Function. System software should immediately honor an unsolicited Bandwidth Request Event and free unused USB bandwidth by selecting lower bandwidth alternate configurations or interfaces on the devices that it owns.
注：系统软件可能从不发出 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令，但若 BNC 标志为 ‘1’，硬件可能生成一个非请求的带宽请求事件（unsolicited Bandwidth Request Event），例如当系统软件运行在虚拟机（Virtual Machine）中并通过 xHCI 虚拟功能（Virtual Function）通信时。当运行在另一虚拟机中的系统软件通过其 xHCI 虚拟功能发出 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令时，就会出现这种情况。系统软件应立即响应非请求的带宽请求事件，并在其拥有的设备上选择较低带宽的备用配置（alternate configuration）或备用接口（Alternate Interface），以释放未使用的 USB 带宽。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2655-L2663（p133）

规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

流程图 · 4.6.13 Negotiate Bandwidth 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2572-L2587
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Negotiate Bandwidth Command system software shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Negotiate Bandwidth Command on the Command Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Negotiate Bandwidth Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Slot ID = The ID of the slot that requires the bandwidth negotiation. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
要发出 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Negotiate Bandwidth Command（参见表 6-91）。 - Slot ID = 需要进行带宽协商的槽位的 ID。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2572-L2587（p132）
流程图 · 4.6.13 Negotiate Bandwidth 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2588-L2623 + L2630-L2654
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Negotiate Bandwidth Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: • If the command is supported: o If the Device Slot identified by the Slot ID has been enabled by an Enable Slot Command: o If the Slot ID identifies a slot in the Addressed or Configured state then: • If there are devices that define candidate periodic endpoints for receiving Bandwidth Request Events: • For each device, identify the target Event Ring (specified by the Interrupt Target field of the device’s Slot Context). • If there is space on the device’s target Event Ring: • Insert a Bandwidth Request Event and initialize the following fields: • TRB Type = Bandwidth Request Event (refer to Table 6-91). • Slot ID = ID of the device slot. • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). • Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. • Cycle bit = Device’s target Event Ring’s PCS flag. • else // No space on the device’s target Event Ring • Skip the device. • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90).
当 xHC 执行 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 若支持该命令： - 若 Slot ID 所标识的设备槽位已被某个 Enable Slot 命令启用： - 若 Slot ID 所标识的槽位处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态，则： - 若存在定义了候选周期端点（用于接收带宽请求事件）的设备： - 对每个设备，确定其目标事件环（由该设备槽上下文（Slot Context）的 Interrupt Target 字段指定）。 - 若该设备的目标事件环上有空间： - 插入一个带宽请求事件并初始化以下字段：• TRB Type = Bandwidth Request Event（参见表 6-91）。• Slot ID = 该设备槽位的 ID。• Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。• 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。• Cycle bit = 该设备目标事件环的 PCS 标志。• else // 该设备的目标事件环上没有空间 • 跳过该设备。 - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - else // Slot ID 所标识的槽位不处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态 - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - else // 该槽位尚未被 Enable Slot 命令启用 - Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error - else // 不支持 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令 - Completion Code = TRB Error。 - 在中断器 0 的事件环上插入一个命令完成事件，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Negotiate Bandwidth 命令 TRB 的地址。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2588-L2623（p132）
o else // The Slot ID identifies slot not in the Addressed or Configured state • Completion Code =Context State Error. o else // The slot has not been enabled by an Enable Slot Command • Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error o else // The Negotiate Bandwidth Command is not supported • Completion Code =TRB Error. • Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring of Interrupter 0 and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91). o Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Negotiate Bandwidth Command TRB. o Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag.
- else // Slot ID 所标识的槽位不处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态 - Completion Code = Context State Error。 - else // 该槽位尚未被 Enable Slot 命令启用 - Completion Code = Slot Not Enabled Error - else // 不支持 Negotiate Bandwidth 命令 - Completion Code = TRB Error。 - 在中断器 0 的事件环上插入一个命令完成事件，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Negotiate Bandwidth 命令 TRB 的地址。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2630-L2654（p133）
4.6.14Set Latency Tolerance Value可选命令p133-p135

规范引文（机制主线）

The Set LTV Command provides a simple means for host software to provide a Best Effort Latency Tolerance (BELT) value to the xHC. This command is optional normative, however it shall be supported if the xHC also supports a corresponding host interconnect LTR mechanism.
Set LTV 命令为主机软件提供了一种向 xHC 提供 Best Effort Latency Tolerance（BELT）值的简单手段。此命令为可选规范性，但若 xHC 还支持主机互连上相应的 LTR 机制，则必须支持它。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2673-L2676（p133）
The value of the BELT field in the Set LTV Command TRB shall be treated in exactly the same way as BELT values received from USB3 devices by the xHC. Refer to section 4.13.1.
Set LTV 命令 TRB 中 BELT 字段值的处理方式，必须与 xHC 从 USB3 设备收到的 BELT 值的处理方式完全相同。参见第 4.13.1 节。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2686-L2688（p134）
If the Latency Tolerance Messaging Capability (LTC) bit in the HCCPARAMS1 register is ‘0’, the xHC shall not support this command. Note: If LTC = 0, then this xHC implementation does not translate LTM messages from a device into system LTM messages. However, if enabled in the DNCTRL register (N2 = ‘1’), then LTM Device Notification TPs are received by the xHC shall generate Device Notification Events. Refer to section 4.13.1. This command will complete with a Success Completion Code if the command is supported, or a TRB Error Completion Code if the command is not supported.
若 HCCPARAMS1 寄存器中的 Latency Tolerance Messaging Capability（LTC）位为 ‘0’，则 xHC 不得支持此命令。 注：若 LTC = 0，则该 xHC 实现不会把来自设备的 LTM 消息转换为系统 LTM 消息。但若在 DNCTRL 寄存器中启用（N2 = ‘1’），则 xHC 会接收 LTM 设备通知 TP（Device Notification TP），并必须生成设备通知事件（Device Notification Event）。参见第 4.13.1 节。 若支持此命令，则该命令将以 Success 完成码完成；若不支持，则以 TRB Error 完成码完成。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2691-L2698（p134）

TRB 类型表（内核直译） 基线 xhci.h 枚举切片 · 驱动零使用

drivers/usb/host/xhci.h:1143-1144 · TRB 类型枚举（Table 6-91 内核直译） · d9008e061539
1143/* Set Latency Tolerance Value Command (opt) */


1144#define TRB_SET_LT		20

流程图 · 4.6.14 Set Latency Tolerance Value 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2703-L2719
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Set Latency Tolerance Value Command system software shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Set Latency Tolerance Value Command on the Command Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Set Latency Tolerance Value Command (refer to Table 6-91). o BELT = The Best Effort Latency Tolerance value provided by software. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
要发出 Set Latency Tolerance Value 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Set Latency Tolerance Value 命令，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Set Latency Tolerance Value Command（参见表 6-91）。 - BELT = 软件提供的 Best Effort Latency Tolerance 值。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2703-L2719（p134）
流程图 · 4.6.14 Set Latency Tolerance Value 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2720-L2736 + L2743-L2751
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Set Latency Tolerance Value Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: • Record the value of the BELT field as the host defined LTV. • If the value of the BELT field is less than the “current” LTV maintained by the xHC: o Set the value of the BELT field as the “current” xHC LTV. o Send the host-specific LTM to the host, reporting the new LTV to the system. • Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring of Interrupter 0 and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91).
当 xHC 执行 Set Latency Tolerance Value 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 记录 BELT 字段的值，作为主机定义的 LTV。 - 若 BELT 字段的值小于 xHC 维护的“当前”（current）LTV： - 将 BELT 字段的值设置为 xHC 的“当前”LTV。 - 向主机发送主机特定的 LTM，向系统报告新的 LTV。 - 在中断器 0 的事件环上插入一个命令完成事件，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Set Latency Tolerance Value 命令 TRB 的地址。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2720-L2736（p134）
o Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Set Latency Tolerance Value Command TRB. o Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). o Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag.
- Command TRB Pointer = Set Latency Tolerance Value 命令 TRB 的地址。 - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2743-L2751（p135）
4.6.15Get Port Bandwidth可选命令p135-p138

规范引文（机制主线）

The Get Port Bandwidth Command is issued by software to retrieve the percentage of Total Available Bandwidth on each Root Hub Port of the xHC or on the downstream facing ports of an external USB hub. This information can be used by system software to recommend topology changes to the user if they were unable to enumerate a device due to a Bandwidth Error (Root Hub) or Secondary Bandwidth Error (external hub). This command shall complete with a Success Completion Code if the command is supported, or a TRB Error Completion Code if the command is not supported.
软件发出 Get Port Bandwidth 命令（获取端口带宽命令），以获取 xHC 每个根集线器端口（Root Hub Port）上或外部 USB 集线器下行端口上的总可用带宽（Total Available Bandwidth）百分比。当系统软件因带宽错误（Bandwidth Error，根集线器）或次级带宽错误（Secondary Bandwidth Error，外部集线器）而无法枚举某设备时，可利用此信息向用户建议更改拓扑。 若支持此命令，则该命令必须以 Success 完成码完成；若不支持，则以 TRB Error 完成码完成。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2754-L2761（p135）
The Get Port Bandwidth Command passes a pointer to a Port Bandwidth Context data structure to the xHC. The xHC updates this context with the percentage of Total Available Bandwidth on each port. If a hub is attached to a Root Hub port then the reported bandwidth is available on any unused port of the hub or any port of the hub that is operating at the Device Speed. For the Root Hub the Port Bandwidth Context shall be at least NumPorts+1 bytes in size or for an external hub the Port Bandwidth Context shall be at least bNbrPorts25+1 bytes in size, rounded up to the nearest Dword boundary. The xHC overwrites the Port Bandwidth Context when it executes the Get Port Bandwidth Command, so software does not need to initialize the context data structure before passing it to the xHC.
Get Port Bandwidth 命令向 xHC 传递一个指向端口带宽上下文（Port Bandwidth Context）数据结构的指针。xHC 用每个端口的总可用带宽百分比来更新此上下文。若某根集线器端口接有集线器，则所报告的带宽在该集线器任何未使用的端口上或任何正以 Device Speed 运行的端口上可用。 对于根集线器，端口带宽上下文的大小必须至少为 NumPorts+1 字节；对于外部集线器，端口带宽上下文的大小必须至少为 bNbrPorts25+1 字节，均向上取整到最近的 Dword 边界。 xHC 执行 Get Port Bandwidth 命令时会覆写端口带宽上下文，因此软件在将其传给 xHC 之前无需初始化该上下文数据结构。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2799-L2809（p136）
Note: Software shall consider any port that reports ‘0’ bandwidth available as being unusable. A port that, as far as software is concerned, does not have a device attached may report ‘0’ bandwidth available. For example, a VMM shall report ‘0’ bandwidth for a port if the device attached to it is assigned to another VF.
注：软件必须将任何报告可用带宽为 ‘0’ 的端口视为不可用。在软件看来未接入设备的端口，可能报告可用带宽为 ‘0’。例如，若某端口所接设备已被分配给另一个 VF，VMM 必须将该端口的带宽报告为 ‘0’。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2819-L2822（p136）

规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

流程图 · 4.6.15 Get Port Bandwidth 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2851-L2877
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Get Port Bandwidth Command, system software shall perform the following operations: • Allocate and initialize a Port Bandwidth Context data structure. • Insert a Get Port Bandwidth Command TRB on the Command Ring o TRB Type = Get Port Bandwidth Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Dev Speed = The bus speed of the target device. Refer to the Dev Speed field in Table 6-76 for the encoding. o Hub Slot ID = ‘0’ if referencing Root Hub ports (that is, the Primary Bandwidth Domain) or the value of the respective hub’s Slot ID if referencing the ports of a USB2 hub (that is, a Secondary Bandwidth Domain). Refer to section 4.16.2 for more information on Bandwidth Domains. o Port Bandwidth Context Pointer = The base address of the Port Bandwidth Context data structure. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
要发出 Get Port Bandwidth 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 分配并初始化一个端口带宽上下文数据结构。 - 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Get Port Bandwidth 命令 TRB - TRB Type = Get Port Bandwidth Command（参见表 6-91）。 - Dev Speed = 目标设备的总线速度。编码参见表 6-76 中的 Dev Speed 字段。 - Hub Slot ID = 若引用根集线器端口（即主带宽域（Primary Bandwidth Domain））则为 ‘0’；若引用 USB2 集线器的端口（即次级带宽域（Secondary Bandwidth Domain））则为相应集线器的 Slot ID 值。带宽域（Bandwidth Domain）的更多信息参见第 4.16.2 节。 - Port Bandwidth Context Pointer = 端口带宽上下文数据结构的基地址。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2851-L2877（p137）
流程图 · 4.6.15 Get Port Bandwidth 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2878-L2911 + L2918-L2925
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Get Port Bandwidth Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Command Completion Event TRB on the Event Ring. o TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91). o Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Get Port Bandwidth Command TRB. o Slot ID = ‘0’. o If the Dev Speed field is valid (that is, not equal to Undefined or Reserved): • If the Hub Slot ID field = ‘0’: • Compute Percentage of Total Available Bandwidth for each Root Hub port based on its Speed. Use the value of the Dev Speed field for ports that do not have devices attached. • else • Compute the percentage of Total Available Bandwidth for the ports of the hub specified by the Hub Slot ID based on their Speed. Use the value of the Dev Speed field for ports that do not have devices attached. o Copy the results to the Port Bandwidth Context. o Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). • else // The Dev Speed field is not valid
当 xHC 执行 Get Port Bandwidth 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 在事件环（Event Ring）上插入一个 Command Completion Event TRB。 - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Get Port Bandwidth 命令 TRB 的地址。 - Slot ID = ‘0’。 - 若 Dev Speed 字段有效（即不等于 Undefined 或 Reserved）： - 若 Hub Slot ID 字段 = ‘0’： - 按各根集线器端口自身的 Speed 计算其总可用带宽百分比。对未接入设备的端口，使用 Dev Speed 字段的值。 - else - 按 Speed 计算 Hub Slot ID 所指定集线器各端口的总可用带宽百分比。对未接入设备的端口，使用 Dev Speed 字段的值。 - 将结果复制到端口带宽上下文。 - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - else // Dev Speed 字段无效
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2878-L2911（p137）
Completion Code = TRB Error. • Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. • Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag. Note: If a non-zero Hub Slot ID references a Device Slot whose Slot Context Hub field = ‘0’ or Speed field is not equal to High-speed, may result in undefined behavior by the xHC.
- Completion Code = TRB Error。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。 注：若非零的 Hub Slot ID 所引用的设备槽位，其槽上下文 Hub 字段 = ‘0’ 或 Speed 字段不等于 High-speed，可能导致 xHC 的未定义行为。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2918-L2925（p138）
4.6.16Force Header核心命令p138-p139

规范引文（机制主线）

The Force Header Command is issued by software to send a Link Management (LMP) or Transaction Packet (TP) to a USB device, through a selected Root Hub Port. For instance, it may be used to send a PING TP or a Vendor Device Test LMP.
软件发出 Force Header 命令（强制报头命令），通过选定的根集线器端口向 USB 设备发送链路管理包（Link Management Packet，LMP）或事务包（Transaction Packet，TP）。例如，可用它发送 PING TP 或 Vendor Device Test LMP。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2928-L2931（p138）
Note: Inappropriate or incorrect use of this command may cause the xHC link state machines to get out of sync with those on an attached device. Software shall comprehend the possible side effects of the specific headers that are forced on the USB. If a forced header results in undefined behavior by the device or the xHC (for example, a DPH with no DP), software may have to reset the device, a Root Hub port, the xHC, or all of them to restore normal operating conditions. The xHC is not required to comprehend the content of the header being forced. Depending upon the type of header forced, it is possible for various parameters in the header (such a Data Packet sequence numbers) to be out of sync with the host controller and/or device. In addition, some TPs may result in Device responses which will not be comprehended by the xHC. It may be necessary to reset the xHC to recover from these conditions.
注：不当或错误地使用此命令，可能使 xHC 的链路状态机与所接设备上的链路状态机失去同步。软件必须理解在 USB 上强制发送的特定报头（header）可能产生的副作用。若被强制的报头导致设备或 xHC 出现未定义行为（例如有 DPH 而无 DP），软件可能必须复位设备、某个根集线器端口、xHC 或三者全部，才能恢复正常运行状态。不要求 xHC 理解被强制报头的内容。视被强制报头的类型而定，报头中的各种参数（例如 Data Packet 序列号）有可能与主机控制器和/或设备失去同步。此外，某些 TP 可能引发设备响应，而 xHC 无法理解这些响应。可能需要复位 xHC 才能从这些状况中恢复。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2932-L2945（p138）

流程图 · 4.6.16 Force Header 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2949-L2966 + L2973-L2977
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
To issue a Force Header Command, system software shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Force Header Command TRB on the Command Ring o TRB Type = Force Header Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Root Hub Port Number = The number of the Root Hub Port that defines the target of the Header packet. o Packet Type = The field identifies the SS packet type. Refer to section 8.3.1.2 in the USB3 specification for valid values. o Header Info = The header Type specific data to send to the target device. Refer to section 8 in the USB3 specification for the encoding information. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’.
要发出 Force Header 命令，系统软件必须执行以下操作： - 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Force Header 命令 TRB - TRB Type = Force Header Command（参见表 6-91）。 - Root Hub Port Number = 定义报头（Header）包目标的根集线器端口号。 - Packet Type = 该字段标识 SS 包类型。有效值参见 USB3 规范第 8.3.1.2 节。 - Header Info = 要发送给目标设备的报头类型特定数据。编码信息参见 USB3 规范第 8 节。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2949-L2966（p138）
o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
- Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2973-L2977（p139）
流程图 · 4.6.16 Force Header 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L2978-L3006
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Force Header Command is executed by the xHC it shall perform the following operations: • Insert a Command Completion Event on the Event Ring. o TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 6-91). o Command TRB Pointer = The address of the Force Header Command TRB. o Slot ID = 0. o If the value Root Hub Port Number field is in range: • If the Force Header packet was transmitted successfully: • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). o else // The Force Header packet was not transmitted successfully • Completion Code = Undefined Error. o else // The value Root Hub Port Number field is not in range • Completion Code = TRB Error. o Clear all other fields of the event TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Event Ring’s PCS flag.
当 xHC 执行 Force Header 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 在事件环（Event Ring）上插入一个命令完成事件。 - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 6-91）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Force Header 命令 TRB 的地址。 - Slot ID = 0。 - 若 Root Hub Port Number 字段值在有效范围内： - 若 Force Header 包被成功发送： - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - else // Force Header 包未被成功发送 - Completion Code = Undefined Error。 - else // Root Hub Port Number 字段值不在有效范围内 - Completion Code = TRB Error。 - 将事件 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 事件环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2978-L3006（p139）
4.6.17Get Extended Property可选命令p139-p141

规范引文（机制主线）

The Get Extended Property Command is used by system software to discover specific Extended Capabilities supported by the xHC, and to enumerate and read specific attributes of those Extended Capabilities. If the Get/Set Extended Property Capability (GSC) bit in the HCCPARAMS2 register is ‘1’, the xHC shall support this command.
系统软件使用 Get Extended Property 命令（获取扩展属性命令）来发现 xHC 所支持的特定扩展能力（Extended Capability），并对这些扩展能力的特定属性进行枚举和读取。 若 HCCPARAMS2 寄存器中的 Get/Set Extended Property Capability（GSC）位为 ‘1’，则 xHC 必须支持本命令。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3009-L3013（p139）
Depending upon the actual Extended Capability and Subtype in the Get Extended Property command, the command may contain a pointer to an Extended Property Context, in which case the xHC shall update the Extended Property Context with the property referenced by the Get Extended Property command. Since the context is overwritten by the xHC, it is not necessary for SW to initialize the context before passing it to the xHC.
根据 Get Extended Property 命令中实际的扩展能力与子类型（Subtype），该命令可以包含一个指向扩展属性上下文（Extended Property Context）的指针；此时 xHC 必须用该命令所引用的属性来更新扩展属性上下文。由于该上下文会被 xHC 覆写，软件在将其传给 xHC 之前无需初始化它。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3014-L3019（p139）
This command shall complete with a Success Completion Code if the command is supported (that is, GSC bit in the HCCPARAMS2 register is ‘1’), or a TRB Error Completion Code if the command is not supported (that is, GSC bit in the HCCPARAMS2 register is ‘0’).
若本命令受支持（即 HCCPARAMS2 寄存器中的 GSC 位为 ‘1’），则本命令必须以完成码（Completion Code）Success 完成；若不受支持（即 HCCPARAMS2 寄存器中的 GSC 位为 ‘0’），则以完成码 TRB Error 完成。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3046-L3049（p140）

规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

流程图 · 4.6.17.1 Get Extended Property 发行算法（system software） · 依据 spec-46.txt L3050-L3074
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
4.6.17.1 SW Execution of Get Extended Property Command To issue a Get Extended Property Command, software shall perform the following operations: • Allocate an Extended Property Context Data Structure if needed. • Insert a Get Extended Property Command TRB into the command ring. o TRB Type = Get Extended Property Command o Extended Capability Identifier = either set to all zeroes (See section 4.6.17.2 for details) or one bit within the identifier field set to indicate the specific capability the command is associated with. o Slot ID = Slot ID associated with the command, or all zeroes if the command does not reference a specific Device o EP ID = EP ID associated with the command, or all zeroes if the command does not reference a specific EP. o Subtype = Specific command subtype to be executed. The subtype field is dependent upon the Extended Capability referenced. • Write the host controller doorbell with the DB Target = Host Controller Command.
4.6.17.1 Get Extended Property 命令的软件执行（SW Execution of Get Extended Property Command） 要发出 Get Extended Property 命令，软件必须执行以下操作： - 若需要，分配一个扩展属性上下文数据结构。 - 在命令环上插入一个 Get Extended Property 命令 TRB。 - TRB Type = Get Extended Property 命令。 - Extended Capability Identifier = 要么置为全零（细节参见第 4.6.17.2 节），要么在标识符字段内置位一位，以指明本命令所关联的特定能力。 - Slot ID = 与本命令关联的 Slot ID；若本命令不引用特定设备，则为全零。 - EP ID = 与本命令关联的 EP ID；若本命令不引用特定 EP，则为全零。 - Subtype = 要执行的特定命令子类型。Subtype 字段取决于所引用的扩展能力。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3050-L3074（p140）
流程图 · 4.6.17.2 Get Extended Property 执行算法（xHC） · 依据 spec-46.txt L3075-L3085 + L3092-L3113
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
4.6.17.2 xHC Execution of Get Extended Property Command When a Get Extended Property Command is executed by the xHC, it shall perform the following operations: • If the Extended Capability and SubType referenced by the command require the Extended Property Context to be updated (as defined in the appropriate Extended Capability Description in Chapter 7), the xHC shall write the required information to the Extended Property Context location specified by the Extended Property Context pointers in the Get Extended Property command.
4.6.17.2 Get Extended Property 命令的 xHC 执行（xHC Execution of Get Extended Property Command） 当 xHC 执行 Get Extended Property 命令时，它必须执行以下操作： - 若本命令所引用的扩展能力与子类型要求更新扩展属性上下文（如第 7 章中相应扩展能力描述所定义），则 xHC 必须把所需信息写入由 Get Extended Property 命令中扩展属性上下文指针所指定的扩展属性上下文位置。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3075-L3085（p140）
• Subsequently, the xHC shall insert a Command Completion Event TRB in the Event Ring o TRB Type = Command Completion Event (refer to Table 139). o Command TRB pointer = The address of the Get Extended Property Command TRB. o Slot ID = Slot ID referenced in the Get Extended Property Command o Extended Capability Identifier = Either of the following: • If the Get Extended Property Command had the Extended Capability Identifier set to zero, the xHC shall set the bit associated with each supported extended capability, as defined by Table 4-3. • If the Get Extended Property Command referenced a specific extended capability (by setting one bit in the Extended Capability Identifier field), the xHC shall set that bit in the completion TRB. o Completion Code= Success
- 随后，xHC 必须在事件环上插入一个命令完成事件 TRB（Command Completion Event TRB）。 - TRB Type = Command Completion Event（参见表 139）。 - Command TRB Pointer = Get Extended Property 命令 TRB 的地址。 - Slot ID = Get Extended Property 命令中引用的 Slot ID。 - Extended Capability Identifier = 以下两者之一： - 若 Get Extended Property 命令的 Extended Capability Identifier 被置为零，则 xHC 必须按表 4-3 的定义，把与每个受支持扩展能力相关联的位都置位。 - 若 Get Extended Property 命令引用了某个特定扩展能力（通过在 Extended Capability Identifier 字段内置位一位），则 xHC 必须在该完成 TRB 中置位该位。 - Completion Code = Success
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3092-L3113（p141）
4.6.17.3 Enumeration of Supported Extended Capabilities In order to discover if the xHC supports specific Extended Capabilities that are associated with the Get Extended Property Command, System Software shall issue a Get Extended Property command with the Extended Capability ID field and the SubType field set to all zeroes. • In response to receiving a Get Extended Property Command with the Extended Capabilities ID field set to zero, the xHC shall return a Command Completion TRB with a bit set for each supported extended capability in bits [15:0] of the Command Completion Parameter field of the Command Completion Event TRB (as defined in Table 4-3 below). Note that multiple bits may be set if multiple capabilities are supported. The Extended Capability Identifier field is defined as shown below:
4.6.17.3 受支持扩展能力的枚举（Enumeration of Supported Extended Capabilities） 为发现 xHC 是否支持与 Get Extended Property 命令相关联的特定扩展能力，系统软件必须发出一条 Extended Capability ID 字段与 SubType 字段均被置为全零的 Get Extended Property 命令。 - 响应收到 Extended Capabilities ID 字段被置为零的 Get Extended Property 命令，xHC 必须返回一个命令完成 TRB（Command Completion TRB），对每个受支持的扩展能力，在该命令完成事件 TRB 的 Command Completion Parameter 字段的 [15:0] 位中置位一位（如下方表 4-3 所定义）。注意，若支持多个能力，则可以置位多个位。 扩展能力标识符字段的定义如下所示：
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3114-L3127（p141）
Table 4-3: Extended Capability Identifier
BitsDescription
0Audio Sideband Extended Capability
11:1RsvdZ.
15:12Vendor Defined Extended CapabilityEach bit, when set, refers to a separate vendor defined extended capability. System software interprets and uses these bits in the context of the specific host controller vendor.
4.6.18Set Extended Property可选命令p141-p142

规范引文（机制主线）

The Set Extended Property Command is used by System Software to control attributes of specific Extended Capabilities supported by the xHC. If the Get/Set Extended Property Capability (GSC) bit in the HCCPARAMS2 register is ‘1’, the xHC shall support this command. The format of the Set Extended Property is defined in section 7.9.2.
系统软件使用 Set Extended Property 命令（设置扩展属性命令）来控制 xHC 所支持的特定扩展能力的属性。 若 HCCPARAMS2 寄存器中的 Get/Set Extended Property Capability（GSC）位为 ‘1’，则 xHC 必须支持本命令。 Set Extended Property 的格式定义于第 7.9.2 节。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3141-L3145（p141）
This command shall complete with a Success Completion Code if the command is supported (that is, GSC bit in the HCCPARAMS2 register is ‘1’), or a TRB Error Completion Code if the command is not supported (that is, GSC bit in the HCCPARAMS2 register is ‘0’).
若本命令受支持（即 HCCPARAMS2 寄存器中的 GSC 位为 ‘1’），则本命令必须以完成码 Success 完成；若不受支持（即 HCCPARAMS2 寄存器中的 GSC 位为 ‘0’），则以完成码 TRB Error 完成。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3178-L3181（p142）

规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

• The Set Extended Property Command references a specific Extended Capability using the Extended Capability Identifier. o Each bit in the Extended Capability Identifier represents one specific Extended Capability as defined in Table 4-3. o Software shall not set more than one bit in the Extended Capability Identifier field. • The list of Extended Capabilities allowed to use this command are listed in Table 4-3. • The Set Extended Property Command further contains a Subtype field that defines the specific property within the scope of the Extended Capability. • The Set Extended Property Command may identify the specific Endpoint ID and Device Slot ID targeted by the command, depending upon the Extended Capability and Subtype. • The specific subtypes and xHC actions are defined in the appropriate section in Chapter 7 (Extended Capabilities). • The Set Extended Property Command specifies a Capability Parameter that is used to configure certain aspects of the Extended Capability associated with the Extended Capability specified in the Extended Capability ID.
- Set Extended Property 命令使用扩展能力标识符来引用一个特定的扩展能力。 - 扩展能力标识符中的每一位代表一个特定的扩展能力，如表 4-3 所定义。 - 软件不得在扩展能力标识符字段中置位多于一位。 - 允许使用本命令的各扩展能力列于表 4-3。 - Set Extended Property 命令还包含一个 Subtype 字段，用于定义该扩展能力范围内的特定属性。 - 根据扩展能力与子类型，Set Extended Property 命令可以标识该命令所目标的特定 Endpoint ID 与 Device Slot ID。 - 具体的子类型与 xHC 动作定义于第 7 章（扩展能力）中的相应小节。 - Set Extended Property 命令指定一个 Capability Parameter，用于配置与 Extended Capability ID 中所指定扩展能力相关联的该扩展能力的某些方面。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L3152-L3177（p142）

§4.7Doorbells 门铃 R12 批 A · xh 命名首验批 · 最短节单卡

①大区导语 · 1 卡

4.7 是门铃机制总节（全章最短、零小节）：门铃寄存器阵列按 Device Slot ID 索引、DB Target 字段说明「为什么敲」，0 号=主机控制器专用，1-255=设备上下文门铃（1:1 映射设备槽）；xHC 内部记录全部门铃写引用、无需清除；Disabled 槽/端点禁写并回 Endpoint Not Enabled Error。本节无算法块（不硬凑流程图）、无规范表；补丁片已上线（d66eaf9f8950：门铃路径 ring_doorbell_for_active_rings 空指针崩溃判空修复，与本卡贴码同函数）——补丁版块在本区卡内（R12 批 A-3，§6 逐节全配）。

4.7Doorbells 门铃机制
4.7Doorbells 门铃机制p142-p143

规范引文（机制主线）

The xHCI presents an array of up to 256 32-bit Doorbell Registers (refer to section 5.6), which reside in MMIO space and are indexed by Device Slot ID. The base of the Doorbell Register Array is pointed to by the Doorbell Offset (DBOFF) register in the xHCI Capability Registers (refer to section 5.3.7). Each Doorbell Register contains a DB Target field, which is used to indicate the reason for a software reference to the register. System software “rings” a doorbell by writing a Doorbell Register with the appropriate value in the DB Target field.
xHCI 提供了最多 256 个 32 位门铃寄存器（Doorbell Register）构成的数组（参见第 5.6 节），这些寄存器驻留在 MMIO 空间中，并以 Device Slot ID 为索引。门铃寄存器数组的基址由 xHCI 能力寄存器（xHCI Capability Registers）中的门铃偏移（Doorbell Offset，DBOFF）寄存器指向（参见第 5.3.7 节）。 每个门铃寄存器都包含一个 DB Target 字段，用于指示软件访问该寄存器的原因。系统软件通过向门铃寄存器写入、并在 DB Target 字段中填入适当取值来“振铃”（ring）一个门铃。
—— evidence/spec-47.txt L3-L10（p142）
Doorbell Register 0 is dedicated to the Host Controller. For this register, there is only one valid value for the DB Target field, 0 (Host Controller Command). The remaining values (1-255) are reserved.
门铃寄存器 0 专用于主机控制器。对于该寄存器，DB Target 字段只有一个有效取值，即 0（Host Controller Command）。其余取值（1-255）为保留值。
—— evidence/spec-47.txt L11-L13（p142）
Doorbell Registers 1-255 are referred to as the Device Context Doorbell registers. There is a 1:1 mapping of Device Context Doorbell registers to Device Slots. System software rings a Device Context Doorbell after it has inserted work on a Transfer Ring (endpoint/Stream) associated with the respective Device Slot. The DB Target and DB Stream ID fields of a Device Context Doorbell register is used to identify which Transfer Ring of a device has been modified. Refer to Table 5-43 for the encoding of the DB Target field.
门铃寄存器 1-255 被称为设备上下文门铃寄存器（Device Context Doorbell Register）。设备上下文门铃寄存器与设备槽位之间存在 1:1 映射。在向与相应设备槽位关联的某个传输环（端点/流）插入工作之后，系统软件才振铃设备上下文门铃。设备上下文门铃寄存器的 DB Target 与 DB Stream ID 字段用于标识设备的哪个传输环被修改。DB Target 字段的编码参见表 5-43。
—— evidence/spec-47.txt L14-L20（p142）
The xHC internally records all Doorbell Register write references and uses the information to determine if the Command Ring or a Transfer Ring has newly posted work items (TDs). There is no need to “clear” a Doorbell Register. To inform the xHC that work has been posted to two separate Transfer Rings of a device, system software shall post two writes to the associated Doorbell Registers, where the value of the DB Target field identifies the respective Transfer Ring.
xHC 会在内部记录所有门铃寄存器写入引用，并利用该信息来判定命令环或某个传输环是否新投递了工作项（TD）。无需“清除”门铃寄存器。为通知 xHC 已向一个设备的两个独立传输环投递了工作，系统软件必须向相应的门铃寄存器发出两次写入，其中 DB Target 字段的值标识各自的传输环。
—— evidence/spec-47.txt L27-L33（p143）
Software shall not write to a Doorbell register: • If the associated Device Slot is in the Disabled state. • If the associated Device Slot is not in the Disabled state and the DB Target field is set to an endpoint that is in the Disabled state. If a doorbell register is written by software with the DB Target value that references an endpoint that is in the Disabled state, the xHC should generate a Transfer Event TRB with the TRB Pointer, TRB Transfer Length, Event Data (ED) fields set to ‘0’, a Completion Code of Endpoint Not Enabled Error, and the Slot ID and Endpoint ID fields contain the IDs of device slot/endpoint that the doorbell that was rung for. This transfer Event TRB shall be posted to the Primary Event Ring.
软件不得在以下情况下向门铃寄存器写入： - 关联的设备槽位处于 Disabled 状态。 - 关联的设备槽位不处于 Disabled 状态，而 DB Target 字段被置为处于 Disabled 状态的某个端点。 若软件向门铃寄存器写入的 DB Target 取值引用了处于 Disabled 状态的端点，则建议 xHC 生成一个传输事件 TRB（Transfer Event TRB），其 TRB Pointer、TRB Transfer Length、Event Data（ED）字段被置为 ‘0’，Completion Code 为 Endpoint Not Enabled Error，且 Slot ID 与 Endpoint ID 字段包含被振铃门铃所对应的设备槽位/端点的 ID。该传输事件 TRB 必须被投递到主事件环（Primary Event Ring）。
—— evidence/spec-47.txt L35-L47（p143）
An Endpoint Not Enabled Error should be generated for doorbell register writes to Device Slots that are in the Disabled state regardless of the DB Target value provided. The xHC may ignore doorbell references to Device Slots in the Disabled state or endpoints in the Disabled state. The xHC shall ignore doorbell references to endpoints in the Halted or Error state.
对于向处于 Disabled 状态的设备槽位发出的门铃寄存器写入，无论提供的 DB Target 取值如何，都建议生成 Endpoint Not Enabled Error。 xHC 可以忽略指向处于 Disabled 状态的设备槽位或处于 Disabled 状态的端点的门铃引用。 xHC 必须忽略指向处于 Halted 或 Error 状态端点的门铃引用。
—— evidence/spec-47.txt L48-L54（p143）

drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c:585-607 · xhci_ring_doorbell_for_active_rings · d9008e061539
585void xhci_ring_doorbell_for_active_rings(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, unsigned int slot_id,


586					 unsigned int ep_index)


587{


588	unsigned int stream_id;


589	struct xhci_virt_ep *ep;


590


591	ep = &xhci->devs[slot_id]->eps[ep_index];


592


593	/* A ring has pending URBs if its TD list is not empty */


594	if (!(ep->ep_state & EP_HAS_STREAMS)) {


595		if (ep->ring && !(list_empty(&ep->ring->td_list)))


596			xhci_ring_ep_doorbell(xhci, slot_id, ep_index, 0);


597		return;


598	}


599


600	for (stream_id = 1; stream_id < ep->stream_info->num_streams;


601			stream_id++) {


602		struct xhci_stream_info *stream_info = ep->stream_info;


603		if (!list_empty(&stream_info->stream_rings[stream_id]->td_list))


604			xhci_ring_ep_doorbell(xhci, slot_id, ep_index,


605						stream_id);


606	}


607}

背景（何时 / 谁修 / 为什么是它）

2013 年 7 月，Oleksij Rempel 提交。场景（message 原文）：设备挂在 xHCI 口上但不响应——举例 ath9k_htc 固件停摆——内核在 ring_doorbell_for_active_rings() 里崩溃。对应 §4.7 门铃机制：软件放好工作后敲门铃、xHC 记录写引用判断新 TD——本卡贴码段（L585-L607）正是这条路径的内核侧。

要解决的问题（症状 + 机制）

症状：空指针解引用内核崩溃。机制：函数对每个「有挂起 TD」的环敲门铃（函数注释原文 "A ring has pending URBs if its TD list is not empty"）；但走到非流端点分支时 ep->ring 可能为 NULL（端点尚无环），&ep->ring->td_list 一取址即崩。

代码逻辑（补丁前 → 后行为对照）

用前判空：if (ep->ring && !(list_empty(&ep->ring->td_list)))——有环且有挂起 TD 两条件都成立才敲。规范对齐：§4.7 p142 "System software rings a Device Context Doorbell after it has inserted work on a Transfer Ring"——ep->ring 为 NULL 时连关联的 Transfer Ring 都不存在，判空把敲铃收回到「有工作才敲」的规范语义内。对读注记：修复行=基线 L595，恰在本卡上方贴码段（L585-L607）内——贴码即补丁后形态，故无独立对读段（ch4610p 先例）；分帧走读见 xh0700p（scene=46）。

补丁分帧动画 · 三幕走读 → 背景现场 → diff 逐行走读 → 规范收尾（对照 §4.7 p142「有工作才敲」敲铃语义）

§4.8Endpoint 端点 R12 批 A · 三小节三卡（寻址/上下文初始化/状态机）

①大区导语 · 3 卡

4.8 定义端点：寻址（Endpoint Number+Direction → 16 对 Endpoint Context，DCI 公式）、上下文初始化（Input Endpoint Context 全零起步+四端点型例外清单）、上下文状态（五态状态机：Disabled/Running/Halted/Stopped/Error 与命令驱动的转移）。本节无规范表（Figure 4-5 为状态图非表）；补丁片已上线（dceea67058fe：EP 状态域掩码 0xf→0x7 勘正，引 spec 6.2.3 三位状态域）——补丁版块在 4.8.3 卡内（R12 批 A-3，§6 逐节全配）。

4.8.1Endpoint Addressing 端点寻址机制4.8.2Endpoint Context Initialization 端点上下文初始化机制4.8.3Endpoint Context State 端点上下文状态机制
4.8.1Endpoint Addressing 端点寻址机制p143-p144

规范引文（机制主线）

A USB device supports up to 31 endpoints (EPs): for example,15 IN, 15 OUT, and 1 Control. The Default Control EP (0) is a bidirectional EP defined for all USB devices.
一个 USB 设备最多支持 31 个端点（EP）：例如 15 个 IN、15 个 OUT 和 1 个 Control。默认控制 EP（0）是为所有 USB 设备定义的双向 EP。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L3-L5（p143）
An Endpoint Address defined by a USB Endpoint Descriptor allows up to 31 possible values, where a 4-bit Endpoint Number is combined with a Direction bit (refer to section 9.6.6 in the USB2 spec). The xHCI parallels this organization by using the Endpoint Number to select one of 16 Endpoint Context data structure pairs, and the Direction bit to select the IN or OUT Endpoint Context of a pair. Refer to Figure 4-4 to the right.
由 USB 端点描述符（Endpoint Descriptor）定义的端点地址（Endpoint Address）最多允许 31 个可能的取值，其中 4 位的端点号（Endpoint Number）与一个方向位（Direction bit）组合而成（参见 USB2 规范第 9.6.6 节）。xHCI 仿照这一组织方式：用端点号从 16 对端点上下文（Endpoint Context）数据结构对中选出一对，再用方向位选出该对中的 IN 或 OUT 端点上下文。参见图 4-4（位于右侧）。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L41-L46（p144）
A Control endpoint (for example, EP Number 0 in Figure 4-4) is a bidirectional endpoint and, per the USB specification, the Direction bit is “ignored” when calculating its Endpoint Address, that is, only the Endpoint Number is used to calculate the location of a Control Endpoint Context data structure. To accommodate the addressing anomaly of USB bidirectional endpoint addressing the xHC shall use the IN (odd) Endpoint Context of the pair to manage bidirectional endpoints.
控制端点（例如图 4-4 中的 EP 号 0）是双向端点；按照 USB 规范，在计算其端点地址时方向位被“忽略”，也就是说，只用端点号来计算控制端点上下文（Control Endpoint Context）数据结构的位置。为兼容 USB 双向端点寻址的这一反常之处，xHC 必须使用该对中的 IN（奇数）端点上下文来管理双向端点。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L47-L53（p144）
The USB specification allows a device to define additional Control (bidirectional) endpoints, beyond the Default Control Endpoint (EP 0) required by the USB Framework. Using the rules defined above, the xHCI is capable of supporting additional Control endpoints.
USB 规范允许设备在 USB 框架所要求的默认控制端点（EP 0）之外，定义额外的控制（双向）端点。按照上述规则，xHCI 能够支持这些额外的控制端点。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L54-L57（p144）
For all Endpoint Numbers greater than 0, the xHC shall ignore the OUT (even) Endpoint Context of the pair of any endpoint that declares itself as a bidirectional. Software shall use the IN (odd) Endpoint Context of a pair for managing a Control Endpoint.
对于所有大于 0 的端点号，若某端点声明自身为双向，则 xHC 必须忽略其对中 OUT（偶数）端点上下文。软件必须使用一对中的 IN（奇数）端点上下文来管理控制端点。

1467/* The reverse operation to xhci_get_endpoint_index. Calculate the USB endpoint


1468 * address from the XHCI endpoint index.


1469 */


1470static unsigned int xhci_get_endpoint_address(unsigned int ep_index)


1471{


1472	unsigned int number = DIV_ROUND_UP(ep_index, 2);


1473	unsigned int direction = ep_index % 2 ? USB_DIR_OUT : USB_DIR_IN;


1474	return direction | number;


1475}


1476


1477/* Find the flag for this endpoint (for use in the control context).  Use the


1478 * endpoint index to create a bitmask.  The slot context is bit 0, endpoint 0 is


1479 * bit 1, etc.


1480 */


1481static unsigned int xhci_get_endpoint_flag(struct usb_endpoint_descriptor *desc)


1482{


1483	return 1 << (xhci_get_endpoint_index(desc) + 1);


1484}


1485


1486/* Compute the last valid endpoint context index.  Basically, this is the


1487 * endpoint index plus one.  For slot contexts with more than valid endpoint,


1488 * we find the most significant bit set in the added contexts flags.


1489 * e.g. ep 1 IN (with epnum 0x81) => added_ctxs = 0b1000


1490 * fls(0b1000) = 4, but the endpoint context index is 3, so subtract one.


1491 */


1492unsigned int xhci_last_valid_endpoint(u32 added_ctxs)


1493{


1494	return fls(added_ctxs) - 1;


1495}

1410		struct xhci_virt_device *virt_dev,


1411		struct usb_device *udev,


1412		struct usb_host_endpoint *ep,


1413		gfp_t mem_flags)


1414{


1415	unsigned int ep_index;


1416	struct xhci_ep_ctx *ep_ctx;


1417	struct xhci_ring *ep_ring;


1418	unsigned int max_packet;

1421	u32 endpoint_type;


1422	unsigned int max_burst;

1428	ep_index = xhci_get_endpoint_index(&ep->desc);


1429	ep_ctx = xhci_get_ep_ctx(xhci, virt_dev->in_ctx, ep_index);


1430


1431	endpoint_type = xhci_get_endpoint_type(ep);


1432	if (!endpoint_type)


1433		return -EINVAL;


1434


1435	ring_type = usb_endpoint_type(&ep->desc);


1436


1437	/* Ensure host supports double isoc bandwidth for eUSB2 devices */


1438	if (usb_endpoint_is_hs_isoc_double(udev, ep) && !(xhci->hcc_params2 & HCC2_EUSB2_DIC))	{


1439		dev_dbg(&udev->dev, "Double Isoc Bandwidth not supported by xhci\n");


1440		return -EINVAL;


1441	}


1442


1443	/*


1444	 * Get values to fill the endpoint context, mostly from ep descriptor.


1445	 * The average TRB buffer lengt for bulk endpoints is unclear as we


1446	 * have no clue on scatter gather list entry size. For Isoc and Int,


1447	 * set it to max available. See xHCI 1.1 spec 4.14.1.1 for details.


1448	 */


1449	max_esit_payload = usb_endpoint_max_periodic_payload(udev, ep);


1450	interval = xhci_get_endpoint_interval(udev, ep);


1451


1452	/* Periodic endpoint bInterval limit quirk */


1453	if (usb_endpoint_xfer_int(&ep->desc) ||


1454	    usb_endpoint_xfer_isoc(&ep->desc)) {


1455		if ((xhci->quirks & XHCI_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_INTERVAL_9) &&


1456		    interval >= 9) {


1457			interval = 8;


1458		}


1459		if ((xhci->quirks & XHCI_LIMIT_ENDPOINT_INTERVAL_7) &&


1460		    udev->speed >= USB_SPEED_HIGH &&


1461		    interval >= 7) {


1462			interval = 6;


1463		}


1464	}


1465


1466	mult = xhci_get_endpoint_mult(xhci, udev, ep);


1467	max_packet = xhci_usb_endpoint_maxp(udev, ep);


1468	max_burst = xhci_get_endpoint_max_burst(udev, ep);


1469	avg_trb_len = max_esit_payload;


1470


1471	/* FIXME dig Mult and streams info out of ep companion desc */


1472


1473	/* Allow 3 retries for everything but isoc, set CErr = 3 */


1474	if (!usb_endpoint_xfer_isoc(&ep->desc))


1475		err_count = 3;


1476	/* HS bulk max packet should be 512, FS bulk supports 8, 16, 32 or 64 */


1477	if (usb_endpoint_xfer_bulk(&ep->desc)) {

1479			max_packet = 512;


1480		if (udev->speed == USB_SPEED_FULL) {


1481			max_packet = rounddown_pow_of_two(max_packet);


1482			max_packet = clamp_val(max_packet, 8, 64);


1483		}


1484	}

1490	virt_dev->eps[ep_index].new_ring =


1491		xhci_ring_alloc(xhci, 2, ring_type, max_packet, mem_flags);


1492	if (!virt_dev->eps[ep_index].new_ring)


1493		return -ENOMEM;


1494


1495	virt_dev->eps[ep_index].skip = false;


1496	virt_dev->eps[ep_index].next_uframe = -1;


1497	ep_ring = virt_dev->eps[ep_index].new_ring;

1499


1500	/* Fill the endpoint context */


1501	ep_ctx->ep_info = cpu_to_le32(EP_MAX_ESIT_PAYLOAD_HI(max_esit_payload) |


1502				      EP_INTERVAL(interval) |

规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
• EP Type = Control. Refer to Table 6-9 for the encoding. • Max Packet Size = For USB2 devices: Device Descriptor:bMaxPacketSize0 or for USB3 devices” Device Descriptor:2bMaxPacketSize0. May be set to Default Endpoint Max Packet Size until USB Device Descriptor is retrieved. An Evaluate Endpoint Command shall be used to modify the value of Max Packet Size when the device slot is in the Addressed state. • CErr = 3. Enables 3 retries. • TR Dequeue Pointer = Start address of the first segment of the previously allocated Transfer Ring. • Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) = 1. Assuming that all TRBs in the segment referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer have been initialized to ‘0’, this field reflects Cycle bit state for valid TRBs written by software.
- EP Type = Control。编码参见表 6-9。 - Max Packet Size = 对于 USB2 设备：Device Descriptor:bMaxPacketSize0；对于 USB3 设备：Device Descriptor:2bMaxPacketSize0。在取回 USB 设备描述符之前，可以先将其设为默认端点 Max Packet Size。当设备槽位处于 Addressed 状态时，必须使用 Evaluate Endpoint 命令（评估端点命令）来修改 Max Packet Size 的值。 - CErr = 3。启用 3 次重试。 - TR Dequeue Pointer = 此前分配的传输环第一个段（segment）的起始地址。 - Dequeue Cycle State（DCS）= 1。假设 TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用段中的所有 TRB 均已被初始化为 ‘0’，则该字段反映软件写入的有效 TRB 的 Cycle bit 状态。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L74-L87（p145）
Identical to the Default Control Endpoint except that the Max Packet Size shall be set to the value of the associated Endpoint Descriptor:wMaxPacketSize.
与默认控制端点相同，唯一区别是 Max Packet Size 必须被置为关联的 Endpoint Descriptor:wMaxPacketSize 的值。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L90-L91（p145）
• EP Type = Bulk IN or Bulk OUT. Refer to Table 6-9 for the encoding. • Max Packet Size = Endpoint Descriptor:wMaxPacketSize. • Max Burst Size = For USB3 devices: SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bMaxBurst, for USB2 devices: ‘0’. • CErr = 3. Enables 3 retries. • If Streams are enabled (that is, SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bmAttributes MaxStreams field > 0): • Allocate and clear Primary Stream Array. • MaxPStreams = Size of Primary Stream Array. • TR Dequeue Pointer = Start address of Primary Stream Array. • HID = Initialize as required to enable or disable Host Initiated Move Data operations. • LSA = Initialize as required to enable or disable Linear Stream Array operations. • else • MaxPStreams = ‘0’. • TR Dequeue Pointer = Start address of the first segment of the previously allocated Transfer Ring. • Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) = 1. Assuming that all TRBs in the segment referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer have been initialized to ‘0’, this field reflects Cycle bit state for valid TRBs written by software. The Endpoint Context Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) field is not applicable if the Streams are enabled.
- EP Type = Bulk IN 或 Bulk OUT。编码参见表 6-9。 - Max Packet Size = Endpoint Descriptor:wMaxPacketSize。 - Max Burst Size = 对于 USB3 设备：SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bMaxBurst；对于 USB2 设备：‘0’。 - CErr = 3。启用 3 次重试。 - 若启用了流（Stream）（即 SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bmAttributes 的 MaxStreams 字段 > 0）：• 分配并清零主流数组（Primary Stream Array）。• MaxPStreams = 主流数组的大小。• TR Dequeue Pointer = 主流数组的起始地址。• HID = 按需初始化，以启用或禁用 Host Initiated Move Data 操作。• LSA = 按需初始化，以启用或禁用线性流数组（Linear Stream Array）操作。 - 否则（else）• MaxPStreams = ‘0’。• TR Dequeue Pointer = 此前分配的传输环第一个段的起始地址。• Dequeue Cycle State（DCS）= 1。假设 TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用段中的所有 TRB 均已被初始化为 ‘0’，则该字段反映软件写入的有效 TRB 的 Cycle bit 状态。 若启用了流，则端点上下文的 Dequeue Cycle State（DCS）字段不适用。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L94-L129（p145）
• Max Packet Size = Endpoint Descriptor:wMaxPacketSize & 07FFh. • Max Burst Size = SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bMaxBurst or (Endpoint Descriptor: wMaxPacketSize & 1800h) >> 11. • Mult = SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bmAttributes:Mult field. Always ‘0’ for Interrupt endpoints. • CErr = 3 for Interrupt endpoints. Enables 3 retries. CErr = 0 for Isoch endpoints. Retries are not performed for Isoch endpoints. • TR Dequeue Pointer = Start address of the first segment of the previously allocated Transfer Ring. • Dequeue Cycle State (DCS) = 1. Assuming that all TRBs in the segment referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer have been initialized to ‘0’, this field reflects Cycle bit state for valid TRBs written by software. • Max ESIT Payload = Refer to section 4.14.2 for value.
- Max Packet Size = Endpoint Descriptor:wMaxPacketSize & 07FFh。 - Max Burst Size = SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bMaxBurst 或 (Endpoint Descriptor: wMaxPacketSize & 1800h) >> 11。 - Mult = SuperSpeed Endpoint Companion Descriptor:bmAttributes:Mult 字段。对中断端点恒为 ‘0’。 - CErr = 3（对中断端点）。启用 3 次重试。CErr = 0（对等时端点）。等时端点不执行重试。 - TR Dequeue Pointer = 此前分配的传输环第一个段的起始地址。 - Dequeue Cycle State（DCS）= 1。假设 TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用段中的所有 TRB 均已被初始化为 ‘0’，则该字段反映软件写入的有效 TRB 的 Cycle bit 状态。 - Max ESIT Payload = 取值参见第 4.14.2 节。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L140-L158（p146）
4.8.3Endpoint Context State 端点上下文状态机制p146-p149

规范引文（机制主线）

The current state of an Endpoint Context is identified by its respective Endpoint State (EP State) field. Figure 4-5 defines the Endpoint States.
端点上下文（Endpoint Context）的当前状态由其相应的端点状态（Endpoint State，EP State）字段标识。图 4-5 定义了各端点状态。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L161-L162（p146）
1. The Address Device Command transitions the Default Control Endpoint from the Disabled to the Running state. 2. The Configure Endpoint Command (Add (A)= ‘1’and Drop (D) = ‘0’) shall transition an endpoint, except the Default Control Endpoint, from the Disabled to the Running state. 3. The Configure Endpoint Command (Add (A)= ‘0’ and Drop (D) = ‘1’) or Reset Device Command shall transition an endpoint, from any state to the Disabled state, except the Default Control Endpoint which may transition from the Stopped to the Running state or remain in the Stopped state.
1. Address Device 命令（寻址设备命令）使默认控制端点从 Disabled 状态迁移到 Running 状态。 2. Configure Endpoint 命令（Add (A) = ‘1’ 且 Drop (D) = ‘0’）必须使除默认控制端点之外的端点从 Disabled 状态迁移到 Running 状态。 3. Configure Endpoint 命令（Add (A) = ‘0’ 且 Drop (D) = ‘1’）或 Reset Device 命令必须使一个端点从任何状态迁移到 Disabled 状态；但默认控制端点例外——它可以从 Stopped 状态迁移到 Running 状态，或保持停留在 Stopped 状态。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L170-L178（p146）
4. The Disable Slot Command shall transition all endpoints of a Device Slot, including the Default Control Endpoint, from any state to the Disabled state. 5. In the Running state, a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command should only be issued to the non-active Transfer Rings of a Stream endpoint. Refer to section 4.12 for active vs. non-active Stream Context information. 6. The Configure Endpoint Command (Add (A) = ‘1’ and Drop (D) = ‘1’) shall transition an endpoint, except the Default Control Endpoint, from the Stopped to the Running state. 7. In the Stopped state, a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command may be used to modify the starting TRB of an endpoint or non-active Stream prior to ringing the Doorbell. Refer to section 4.12 for active vs. non-active Stream Context information.
4. Disable Slot 命令必须使一个设备槽位的所有端点（包括默认控制端点）从任何状态迁移到 Disabled 状态。 5. 在 Running 状态下，Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令建议只发给流端点（Stream endpoint）的非活动传输环。活动与非活动流上下文（Stream Context）信息参见第 4.12 节。 6. Configure Endpoint 命令（Add (A) = ‘1’ 且 Drop (D) = ‘1’）必须使除默认控制端点之外的端点从 Stopped 状态迁移到 Running 状态。 7. 在 Stopped 状态下，可以在振铃门铃之前使用 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令来修改端点或非活动流（Stream）的起始 TRB。活动与非活动流上下文信息参见第 4.12 节。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L185-L195（p147）
Figure 4-5 illustrates the state transitions presented by an endpoint. The Disabled to Running transition for the Default Control Endpoint shall occur due to an Address Device Command, and for all other endpoints the transition shall be invoked by a Configure Endpoint Command. Refer to Appendix E for state machine notation. A Halt condition, for example, a Stall Error, Invalid Stream Type Error, Invalid Stream ID Error, Babble Detected Error, Event Lost Error, USB Transaction Error, or a Split Transaction Error detected on a USB pipe shall cause a Running Endpoint to transition to the Halted state. A Reset Endpoint Command shall be used to clear the Halt condition on the endpoint and transition the endpoint to the Stopped state. A Stop Endpoint Command received while an endpoint is in the Halted state shall have no effect and shall generate a Command Completion Event with the Completion Code set to Context State Error.
图 4-5 图示了端点所呈现的状态迁移。默认控制端点从 Disabled 到 Running 的迁移必须由 Address Device 命令引发；对所有其他端点，该迁移必须由 Configure Endpoint 命令触发。状态机记法参见附录 E。 在 USB 管道上检测到的 halt（停机）条件——例如 Stall Error、Invalid Stream Type Error、Invalid Stream ID Error、Babble Detected Error、Event Lost Error、USB Transaction Error 或 Split Transaction Error——必须使处于 Running 的端点迁移到 Halted 状态。必须使用 Reset Endpoint 命令来清除端点上的 halt 条件，并把端点迁移到 Stopped 状态。端点处于 Halted 状态期间收到的 Stop Endpoint 命令不得产生任何效果，且必须生成一个 Completion Code 被置为 Context State Error 的命令完成事件（Command Completion Event）。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L196-L209（p147）
Note: A STALL detected on any stage (Setup, Data, or Status) of a Default Control Endpoint request shall transition the Endpoint Context to the Halted state. A Default Control Endpoint STALL condition is cleared by a Reset Endpoint Command which transitions the endpoint from the Halted to the Stopped state. The Default Control Endpoint shall return to the Running state when the Doorbell is rung for the next Setup Stage TD sent to the endpoint. Section 8.5.3.4 of the USB2 spec and section 8.12.2.3 of the USB3 spec state of Control pipes, “Unlike the case of a functional stall, protocol stall does not indicate an error with the device.” The xHC treats a functional stall and protocol stall identically, by Halting the endpoint and requiring software to clear the condition by issuing a Reset Endpoint Command. Note: If the STALL condition is detected on the Setup or Data Stage TD of a request, software shall be responsible for removing the Data Stage or Status Stage TDs, respectively, associated with the request from the Transfer Ring.
注：在默认控制端点请求的任何阶段（Setup、Data 或 Status）检测到 STALL（停滞）时，都必须把端点上下文迁移到 Halted 状态。默认控制端点的 STALL 条件由 Reset Endpoint 命令清除，该命令把端点从 Halted 状态迁移到 Stopped 状态。当为发送给该端点的下一个 Setup Stage TD 振铃门铃时，默认控制端点必须返回 Running 状态。USB2 规范第 8.5.3.4 节与 USB3 规范第 8.12.2.3 节在讲述控制管道的状态时指出：“与功能停滞（functional stall）的情形不同，协议停滞（protocol stall）并不表示设备出错。”xHC 对功能停滞与协议停滞同等对待：halt 该端点，并要求软件通过发出 Reset Endpoint 命令来清除该条件。 注：若在某个请求的 Setup 或 Data Stage TD 上检测到 STALL 条件，则软件必须负责把与该请求关联的 Data Stage 或 Status Stage TD 分别从传输环上移除。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L210-L224（p147）
A TRB Error condition should cause a Running Endpoint to transition to the Error state. A Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command shall be used to transition the endpoint to the Stopped state. A Stop Endpoint Command received while an endpoint is in the Error state shall have no effect and shall generate a Command Completion Event with the Completion Code set to Context State Error.
TRB Error 条件建议使处于 Running 的端点迁移到 Error 状态。必须使用 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令把端点迁移到 Stopped 状态。端点处于 Error 状态期间收到的 Stop Endpoint 命令不得产生任何效果，且必须生成一个 Completion Code 被置为 Context State Error 的命令完成事件。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L225-L230（p147）
Note: An endpoint in the Running state may be Busy (actively processing TRBs on its Transfer Ring) or Idle (the endpoint is not processing TRBs and waiting for a doorbell ring) sub-state, that is, an endpoint does not exit the Running state if it exhausts its Transfer Ring. Note: Some xHC implementations may not handle a TRB Error gracefully, resulting in undefined behavior and possibly the assertion of HCE. It is the responsibility of software to always present correctly formed TRBs to the xHC.
注：处于 Running 状态的端点可以处于 Busy（正在其传输环上活跃地处理 TRB）或 Idle（端点未在处理 TRB，正在等待门铃振铃）子状态；也就是说，端点耗尽其传输环时并不会退出 Running 状态。 注：某些 xHC 实现可能无法妥善处理 TRB Error，从而导致未定义行为，并可能置起（assert）HCE。始终向 xHC 呈现格式正确的 TRB 是软件的责任。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L237-L243（p148）
A Stop Endpoint Command shall also transition the endpoint to the Stopped state. While in the Stopped state, the ownership of the Transfer Ring is relinquished up by the xHC, allowing software to add, delete, or modify any TD on the ring. If an endpoint is in the Stopped state when the doorbell is rung, it will transition to the Running state. A Configure Endpoint Command shall also transition a Stopped endpoint to the Running state. Note that a Configure Endpoint Command does not affect the Default Control Endpoint, therefore shall not transition the Default Control Endpoint from the Stopped to the Running state. A Configure Endpoint “deconfigure” (DC = ‘1’) or Reset Device Command shall transition all endpoints, except for the Default Control Endpoint, from the Running, Halted, Error, or Stopped states to the Disabled state. A Disable Slot Command shall transition all endpoints, including the Default Control Endpoint, from the Running, Halted, Error, or Stopped states to the Disabled state, as noted by the large bubble. System software is responsible for issuing a Disable Slot Command when a device detach event is detected.
Stop Endpoint 命令也必须使端点迁移到 Stopped 状态。处于 Stopped 状态期间，传输环的所有权由 xHC 交出，从而允许软件在环上添加、删除或修改任何 TD。 若端点在门铃振铃时处于 Stopped 状态，它将迁移到 Running 状态。Configure Endpoint 命令也必须使处于 Stopped 的端点迁移到 Running 状态。注意，Configure Endpoint 命令不影响默认控制端点，因此不得使默认控制端点从 Stopped 状态迁移到 Running 状态。 Configure Endpoint 的“去配置”（deconfigure）（DC = ‘1’）或 Reset Device 命令必须使除默认控制端点之外的所有端点从 Running、Halted、Error 或 Stopped 状态迁移到 Disabled 状态。 Disable Slot 命令必须使所有端点（包括默认控制端点）从 Running、Halted、Error 或 Stopped 状态迁移到 Disabled 状态，如图中大圆圈（bubble）所标注。当检测到设备 detach 事件时，由系统软件负责发出 Disable Slot 命令。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L244-L260（p148）
A Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command may be issued to a non-active Stream Context of an endpoint to set its Dequeue Pointer while the endpoint is in the Running state. Refer to sections 4.6.10 and 4.12. An endpoint in the Stopped state shall not generate Transfer Events. When an endpoint transitions from the Stopped to the Running state due to a doorbell ring, the EP State field of the Output Endpoint Context shall be updated by the xHC to running before any Transfer Events are generated.
可以向端点的非活动流上下文（Stream Context）发出 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，以便在端点处于 Running 状态时设置其出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）。参见第 4.6.10 节与第 4.12 节。 处于 Stopped 状态的端点不得生成传输事件（Transfer Event）。 当端点因门铃振铃而从 Stopped 状态迁移到 Running 状态时，xHC 必须在任何传输事件生成之前，把输出端点上下文（Output Endpoint Context）的 EP State 字段更新为 Running。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L261-L267（p148）
Note: If the xHC is reset while an endpoint is not in the Disabled state, the value of the Endpoint State (EP State) field shall be invalid. Note: An Endpoint is considered “enabled” if it is not in the Disabled state. Note: Software shall not write to the Doorbell register with the DB Target field value set to an endpoint that is in the Disabled state.
注：若在端点不处于 Disabled 状态时 xHC 被复位，则端点状态（EP State）字段的值将为无效。 注：端点只要不处于 Disabled 状态，即被视为“已启用”（enabled）。 注：软件不得在 DB Target 字段值被置为处于 Disabled 状态端点的情况下写门铃寄存器。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L268-L272（p148）
Note: There are several cases where the EP State field in the Output Endpoint Context may not reflect the current state of an endpoint. The xHC should attempt to keep EP State as current as possible, however it may defer these updates to perform higher priority references to memory, for example, Isoch data transfers, etc. Software should maintain an internal variable that tracks the state of an endpoint and not depend on EP State to represent the instantaneous state of an endpoint. For example, when a Command that affects EP State is issued, the value of EP State may be updated anytime between when software rings the Command Ring doorbell for a command and when the associated Command Completion Event is placed on the Event Ring by the xHC. The update of EP State may also be delayed relative to a Doorbell ring or error condition (for example, TRB Error, STALL, or USB Transaction Error) that causes an EP State change not generated by a command.
注：有多种情形下，输出端点上下文中的 EP State 字段可能不反映端点的当前状态。建议 xHC 尽量让 EP State 保持最新，但它可能把这些更新推迟，以执行对内存的更高优先级引用，例如等时数据传输等。建议软件维护一个跟踪端点状态的内部变量，而不要依赖 EP State 来表示端点的瞬时状态。例如，当发出一条影响 EP State 的命令时，EP State 的值可能在软件为该命令振铃命令环门铃之后、到 xHC 把相关命令完成事件放到事件环上之前的任何时刻被更新。相对于门铃振铃，或相对于引发 EP State 变化（非由命令产生）的错误条件（例如 TRB Error、STALL 或 USB Transaction Error），EP State 的更新也可能被延迟。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L288-L302（p149）
Software should maintain an accurate value for EP State, by tracking it with an internal variable that is driven by Events and Doorbell accesses associated with an endpoint using the following method: • When a command is issued to an endpoint that affects its state, software should use the Command Completion Event to update its image of EP State to the appropriate state. • When a Transfer Event reports a TRB Error, software should update its image of EP State to Error. • When a Transfer Event reports a Stall Error or USB Transaction Error, software should update its image of EP State to Halted. • When software rings the Doorbell of an endpoint to transition it from the Stopped to Running state, it should update its image of EP State to Running.
相对于门铃振铃，或相对于引发 EP State 变化（非由命令产生）的错误条件（例如 TRB Error、STALL 或 USB Transaction Error），EP State 的更新也可能被延迟。建议软件用以下方法来维护 EP State 的准确值：用一个由与该端点相关联的事件和门铃访问所驱动的内部变量来跟踪它： - 当向一个端点发出影响其状态的命令时，建议软件用命令完成事件把其 EP State 映像（image）更新为适当的状态。 - 当传输事件报告 TRB Error 时，建议软件把其 EP State 映像更新为 Error。 - 当传输事件报告 Stall Error 或 USB Transaction Error 时，建议软件把其 EP State 映像更新为 Halted。 - 当软件振铃端点的门铃使其从 Stopped 状态迁移到 Running 状态时，建议软件把其 EP State 映像更新为 Running。
—— evidence/spec-48.txt L304-L320（p149）

上游 commit dceea67058fe22075db3aed62d5cb62092be5053 · 2020-06-24 · Mathias Nyman（Intel） · drivers/usb/host/xhci.h 1 文件 +1/-1 · hunk @@ -716,7（EP_STATE_MASK）· Cc: stable

commit dceea67058fe22075db3aed62d5cb62092be5053
Author: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
Date:   Wed Jun 24 16:59:45 2020 +0300

    xhci: Fix incorrect EP_STATE_MASK
    
    EP_STATE_MASK should be 0x7 instead of 0xf
    
    xhci spec 6.2.3 shows that the EP state field in the endpoint context data
    structure consist of bits [2:0].
    The old value included a bit from the next field which fortunately is a
     RsvdZ region. So hopefully this hasn't caused too much harm
    
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
    Signed-off-by: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
    Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200624135949.22611-2-mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com
    Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/host/xhci.h b/drivers/usb/host/xhci.h
index 2c6c4f8d1ee1..c295e8a7f5ae 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/host/xhci.h
+++ b/drivers/usb/host/xhci.h
@@ -716,7 +716,7 @@ struct xhci_ep_ctx {
  * 4 - TRB error
  * 5-7 - reserved
  */
-#define EP_STATE_MASK		(0xf)
+#define EP_STATE_MASK		(0x7)
 #define EP_STATE_DISABLED	0
 #define EP_STATE_RUNNING	1
 #define EP_STATE_HALTED		2

背景（何时 / 谁修 / 为什么是它）

2020 年 6 月，Intel Mathias Nyman 提交。EP_STATE_MASK 是从端点上下文提取 EP State 的掩码（消费者 GET_EP_CTX_STATE，基线 L462）；§4.8.3 定义端点上下文状态（Figure 4-5 五态：Disabled/Running/Halted/Stopped/Error），状态值落在 EP State 域。

要解决的问题（症状 + 机制）

症状：掩码 0xf=b1111 比 EP State 域（bits[2:0]）多罩一位——bit 3 属域外邻域位，按域布局是 RsvdZ（恒 0），message 原文自评 "hopefully this hasn't caused too much harm"（幸而无害的勘误）。

代码逻辑（补丁前 → 后行为对照）

一行勘正 0xf→0x7：b0111 恰罩 bits[2:0]；五态值 0-4+5-7 保留，恰好填满三位域。位宽权威=补丁 message 引 spec 6.2.3 域布局（第 6 章，出本章界——章界口径注记不展开）；下方对读段注释头 L448 "Endpoint State - bits 0:2" 与 L454 "5-7 - reserved" 即内核侧域宽双证。分帧走读见 xh0803p（scene=47）。

补丁对读段 commit d9008e061539 · 修复后形态（基线即含此补丁）· 零摘录热行（判据=diff 原文+规范引文）

drivers/usb/host/xhci.h:448-462 · EP 状态域定义（注释头+五态 defines+提取宏） · d9008e061539
448 * Endpoint State - bits 0:2


449 * 0 - disabled


450 * 1 - running


451 * 2 - halted due to halt condition - ok to manipulate endpoint ring


452 * 3 - stopped


453 * 4 - TRB error


454 * 5-7 - reserved


455 */


456#define EP_STATE_MASK		(0x7)


457#define EP_STATE_DISABLED	0


458#define EP_STATE_RUNNING	1


459#define EP_STATE_HALTED		2


460#define EP_STATE_STOPPED	3


461#define EP_STATE_ERROR		4


462#define GET_EP_CTX_STATE(ctx)	(le32_to_cpu((ctx)->ep_info) & EP_STATE_MASK)

§4.9TRB Ring TRB 环 R12 批 A · 巨节四卡（环基础+TD/传输环管理/命令环管理轻片/事件环管理）

①大区导语 · 4 卡

4.9 定义 TRB 环机制：三环类型（Transfer/Event/Command）共用的循环队列模型、生产者/消费者指针与 Cycle bit、TD 结构，以及三类环各自的管理规则（4.9.2/4.9.3/4.9.4）。重叠面处置（R12-SPEC §0）：4.9.3 命令环管理为轻片互链 4.6.1 卡；Table 4-4（事件环状态机定义，p165-166 跨页）按 R11 批 A 配方重建为规范样式表。补丁片已上线（b234c70fefa7：环满被误判空环致扩容漏检——deq 越过 enq 特例，与 4.9.2 卡贴码教学点直接咬合）——补丁版块在 4.9.2 卡内（R12 批 A-3，§6 逐节全配）。

4.9.1TRB 环基础与传输描述符机制4.9.2Transfer Ring Management 传输环管理机制4.9.3Command Ring Management 命令环管理（轻片）机制4.9.4Event Ring Management 事件环管理机制
4.9.1TRB 环基础与传输描述符机制p149-p152

规范引文（机制主线）

There are 3 basic types or TRB Rings; Transfer, Event, and Command. Each type of ring defines an exclusive set of TRB data structures; however they all employ the underlying TRB Ring mechanism to organize their work items and the basic TRB template. Transfer Rings provide data transport to and from USB devices. There is a 1:1 mapping between Transfer Rings and USB Pipes. They are defined by an Endpoint Context data structure contained in a Device Context, or the Stream Context Array pointed to by the Endpoint Context.
TRB 环有 3 种基本类型：传输（Transfer）、事件（Event）与命令（Command）。每种类型的环都定义一组专属的 TRB 数据结构；但它们都采用底层的 TRB 环机制来组织各自的工作项，并采用基本的 TRB 模板。 传输环（Transfer Ring）提供与 USB 设备之间往来的数据传送。传输环与 USB 管道（Pipe）之间存在 1:1 映射。传输环由设备上下文（Device Context）中包含的端点上下文数据结构、或由端点上下文所指向的流上下文数组（Stream Context Array）定义。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L22-L29（p149）
The Event Ring provides the xHC with a means of reporting to system software: data transfer and command completion status, Root Hub port status changes, and other xHC related events. An Event Ring is defined by the Event Ring Segment Table Base Address, Segment Table Size, and Dequeue Pointer registers which reside in the Runtime Registers. The Command Ring provides system software the ability to issue commands to enumerate USB Devices, configure the xHC to support those devices, and to coordinate virtualization features. The Command Ring is managed by the Command Ring Control Register that resides in the Operational Registers.
事件环（Event Ring）为 xHC 提供了向系统软件报告以下事项的手段：数据传输与命令完成状态、根集线器（Root Hub）端口状态变化，以及其他与 xHC 相关的事件。事件环由驻留在运行时寄存器（Runtime Registers）中的事件环段表基地址（Event Ring Segment Table Base Address）、段表大小（Segment Table Size）与出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）寄存器定义。 命令环（Command Ring）为系统软件提供了发出命令的能力，用于枚举 USB 设备、配置 xHC 以支持这些设备，以及协调虚拟化特性。命令环由驻留在操作寄存器（Operational Registers）中的命令环控制寄存器（Command Ring Control Register）管理。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L30-L38（p149）
The Enqueue Pointer and Dequeue Pointer are terms used to refer to the logical beginning and end of the valid entries in a TRB Ring. The size of a TRB ring is determined by the number and size of the segments that comprise the ring. Note: The Dequeue and Enqueue Pointers for Transfer and Command Rings are NOT defined as physical xHC registers. However a facsimile of these pointers are maintained internally by the xHC and system software to manage a respective ring. Note: Only the Dequeue Pointer for an Event Ring is defined as a physical xHC register. A facsimile of the Enqueue Pointer is maintained internally by the xHC and system software to manage an Event Ring.
入队指针（Enqueue Pointer）与出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）这两个术语用于指称 TRB 环中有效条目的逻辑开头与逻辑结尾。TRB 环的大小由构成该环的段（segment）的数量与大小决定。 注：传输环与命令环的出队与入队指针并未被定义为物理的 xHC 寄存器。不过，xHC 与系统软件会在内部维护这些指针的副本（facsimile），以管理相应的环。 注：只有事件环的出队指针被定义为物理的 xHC 寄存器。xHC 与系统软件会在内部维护入队指针的副本，以管理事件环。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L39-L49（p149）
The Enqueue Pointer is the address of the next TRB in a ring available to the producer. The producer constructs new Work Items starting with the TRB at this location, and advances the Enqueue Pointer when the construction is complete. The Dequeue Pointer is the address of the next TRB to be serviced by the consumer.
入队指针是环中下一个可供生产者使用的 TRB 的地址。生产者从该位置处的 TRB 开始构造新的工作项，并在构造完成时推进入队指针。 出队指针是消费者将要服务的下一个 TRB 的地址。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L53-L58（p149）
If the Dequeue Pointer equals the Enqueue Pointer, then the TRB Ring is empty. If the “Enqueue Pointer + 1” = Dequeue Pointer, then the ring is full. Note that the calculation of the “Enqueue Pointer + 1” value requires comprehending Link TRBs. Refer to section 4.11.5.1 for more information on Link TRBs. TRBs between the Enqueue Pointer -1 and Dequeue Pointer are owned by the consumer of the Work Items. All other TRBs in a ring are owned by the producer of the Work Items. TRB ownership is passed to the consumer when the Enqueue Pointer is advanced by the producer. TRB ownership is passed to producer when the Dequeue Pointer is advanced by the consumer. A consumer or producer may modify any TRB that it owns, at any time, and in any order. The producer shall never modify a TRB that is owed by the consumer. And the consumer shall never modify a TRB that is owed by the producer. TRBs shall be executed by the consumer in order, starting at the TRB referenced by the Dequeue Pointer.
若出队指针等于入队指针，则 TRB 环为空。若“入队指针 + 1” = 出队指针，则环为满。注意，“入队指针 + 1”值的计算需要理解 Link TRB。Link TRB 的更多信息参见第 4.11.5.1 节。 位于入队指针 -1 与出队指针之间的 TRB 由工作项的消费者拥有。环中所有其他 TRB 由工作项的生产者拥有。当生产者推进入队指针时，TRB 所有权传递给消费者。当消费者推进出队指针时，TRB 所有权传递给生产者。 消费者或生产者可以在任何时刻、以任何顺序修改其拥有的任何 TRB。生产者绝不能修改消费者拥有的 TRB；消费者也绝不能修改生产者拥有的 TRB。 TRB 必须由消费者按序执行，从出队指针所引用的 TRB 开始。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L65-L80（p151）
All TRB data structures shall be 16 bytes in size. TRB Rings may be larger than a Page, however they shall not cross a 64K byte boundary. Refer to section 4.11.5.1 for more information on TRB Rings and page boundaries. Initially when the TRB Ring is created in memory, or if it is ever re-initialized, all TRBs in the ring shall be cleared to ‘0’. This state represents an empty queue.
所有 TRB 数据结构的大小都必须是 16 字节。 TRB 环可以大于一个页（Page），但不得跨越 64KB 边界。TRB 环与页边界的更多信息参见第 4.11.5.1 节。 最初在内存中创建 TRB 环时，或每当其被重新初始化时，环中所有 TRB 都必须被清零为 ‘0’。该状态表示空队列。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L81-L87（p151）
Transfer Rings support Transfer Descriptors (TDs) that consists of 1 or more TRBs. The TRB Chain (C) bit is set in all but the last TRB of a TD. The xHC shall schedule Max Packet Size USB transactions for all packets associated with a TD, except possibly for the last packet if the TD does not define an integer multiple of Max Packet Size data bytes. To generate a “zero-length” USB transaction, software shall explicitly define a TD with a single Transfer TRB, and its TRB Transfer Length field shall equal ‘0’. Note that this TD may include non-Transfer TRBs, for example, an Event Data or Link TRB.
传输环支持由 1 个或多个 TRB 组成的传输描述符（Transfer Descriptor，TD）。TD 中除最后一个 TRB 之外，所有 TRB 的 chain bit（C，件界标记）都会被置位。 xHC 必须为与一个 TD 关联的所有包调度 Max Packet Size（最大包大小）的 USB 事务，除非该 TD 定义的数据字节数不是 Max Packet Size 的整数倍——此时仅最后一个包可能例外。 要生成“零长度”（zero-length）USB 事务，软件必须显式定义一个带单个传输 TRB 的 TD，且其 TRB Transfer Length 字段必须等于 ‘0’。注意，该 TD 可以包含非传输类 TRB，例如事件数据（Event Data）TRB 或 Link TRB。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L98-L106（p151）
There are many conditions described in this specification where the xHC shall “advance to the next TD”. However, if the xHC is processing a partially formed TD when one of these conditions occurs, then advancing to the next TD is not possible and the xHC shall stop advancing when it reaches the Enqueue Pointer (that is, the Cycle bit transition). In this case, the xHC sees the Transfer Ring as empty (that is, the Dequeue Pointer is equal to the Enqueue Pointer), and the next time the doorbell is rung for the endpoint, the xHC shall attempt to advance to the next TD boundary. Note that the xHC shall always interpret the New TR Dequeue Pointer field of a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command as a pointer to the “next TD”, terminate any effort to “advance to the next TD”. A “partially completed TD” is identified by the case where the Chain bit (CH) set to ‘1’ in the TRB referenced by the Dequeue Pointer and advancing the Dequeue Pointer sets it equal to the Enqueue Pointer.
本规范描述了多种条件，在这些条件下 xHC 必须“前进到下一个 TD”。然而，若这些条件之一发生时 xHC 正在处理一个部分成形的 TD，则无法前进到下一个 TD，且 xHC 必须在到达入队指针时（即 Cycle bit 翻转处）停止前进。此时，xHC 会把传输环视为空（即出队指针等于入队指针），下次为该端点振铃门铃时，xHC 必须尝试前进到下一个 TD 边界。注意，xHC 必须始终把 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令的 New TR Dequeue Pointer 字段解释为指向“下一个 TD”的指针，并终止任何“前进到下一个 TD”的尝试。 “部分完成的 TD”（partially completed TD）由下述情形识别：出队指针所引用 TRB 的 Chain bit（CH）被置为 ‘1’，且推进出队指针会使其等于入队指针。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L115-L127（p152）
