4.9.2Transfer Ring Management 传输环管理机制p152-p160

规范引文（机制主线）

This section describes the operation of Enqueue and Dequeue Pointers in Transfer Rings. The operation of Enqueue and Dequeue Pointers in Command Rings is described in section 4.9.3 and Event Rings in section 4.9.4. Figure 4-6 shows a graphical representation of a Transfer Ring. The producer (host) places items in a Transfer Ring at the Enqueue Pointer, and the consumer (xHC) removes items from the Transfer Ring at the Dequeue Pointer.
本节描述传输环（Transfer Ring）中入队指针（Enqueue Pointer）与出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）的操作。命令环（Command Ring）中入队指针与出队指针的操作在 4.9.3 节描述，事件环（Event Ring）的则在 4.9.4 节描述。 图 4-6 给出了一个传输环的图形化表示。生产者（主机）在入队指针处将条目放入传输环，消费者（xHC）在出队指针处从传输环取出条目。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L150-L156（p152）
The Cycle bit field in a TRB identifies the location of the Enqueue Pointer in a Transfer Ring, eliminating the need to define a physical Enqueue Pointer register. Software uses and maintains private copies of the Enqueue and Dequeue Pointers for each Transfer Ring. The Enqueue and Dequeue Pointers are set to the address of the first TRB location in the Transfer Ring and written to the Endpoint/Stream Context TR Dequeue Pointer field, when a Transfer Ring is initially set up. Software uses the Enqueue Pointer to determine where to place the next Work Item on a Transfer Ring. Software advances its copy of the Enqueue Pointer, by either incrementing it by the TRB size, or reloading it with the value of the Ring Segment Pointer field when it encounters a Link TRB, every time it writes a TRB to the Transfer Ring. The position of the Enqueue pointer is also marked in the Transfer Ring itself, by a transition of the Cycle bit.
TRB 中的 Cycle bit（轮次）字段标识了入队指针在传输环中的位置，从而无需再定义一个物理的入队指针寄存器。 软件为每个传输环使用并维护各自的入队指针与出队指针私有副本。传输环初次建立时，入队指针与出队指针被设置为传输环中第一个 TRB 位置的地址，并写入 Endpoint/Stream Context 的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段。软件使用入队指针来确定下一个工作项（Work Item）在传输环上的放置位置。软件每次向传输环写入一个 TRB 时，都会推进其入队指针副本——或将其按 TRB 大小递增，或在遇到 Link TRB 时用其 Ring Segment Pointer 字段的值重新加载。入队指针的位置同时也通过 Cycle bit 的跳变在传输环自身中被标记出来。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L163-L176（p153）
The xHC also maintains private copies of the Enqueue and Dequeue Pointers for each Transfer Ring. When a Transfer Ring is enabled or reset, the xHC initializes its copies of the Enqueue and Dequeue Pointers with the value of the Endpoint/Stream Context TR Dequeue Pointer field. The xHC uses the Dequeue Pointer to determine where to fetch the next Work Item from a Transfer Ring. The xHC advances its copy of the Dequeue Pointer, by either incrementing it by the TRB size, or reloading it with the value of the Ring Segment Pointer field when it encounters a Link TRB, every time it fetches a TRB from the Transfer Ring. The xHC employs the Event Ring to report the current value of the Dequeue Pointer to system software. Each Transfer Event placed on the Event Ring points to the Transfer TRB that generated it. Software may interpret the pointer value from the latest Transfer Event as the “current value” of the xHC Dequeue Pointer.
xHC 同样为每个传输环维护各自的入队指针与出队指针私有副本。当传输环被启用（enable）或复位时，xHC 会用 Endpoint/Stream Context 的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段的值来初始化其入队指针与出队指针副本。 xHC 使用出队指针来确定从传输环的何处取用下一个工作项。xHC 每次从传输环取出一个 TRB 时，都会推进其出队指针副本——或将其按 TRB 大小递增，或在遇到 Link TRB 时用其 Ring Segment Pointer 字段的值重新加载。 xHC 利用事件环向系统软件报告出队指针的当前值。放置到事件环上的每个传输事件（Transfer Event）都指向产生它的 Transfer TRB。软件可以把最新传输事件中的指针值解释为 xHC 出队指针的“当前值”。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L177-L190（p153）
The xHC uses the Enqueue Pointer to determine when a Transfer Ring is empty. As it fetches TRBs from a Transfer Ring it checks for a Cycle bit transition. If a transition detected, the ring is empty. Software uses the Dequeue Pointer to determine when a Transfer Ring is full. As it processes Transfer Events, it updates its copy of the Dequeue Pointer with the value of the Transfer Event TRB Pointer field. If advancing the Enqueue Pointer would make it equal to the Dequeue Pointer then the Transfer Ring is full and software shall wait for Transfer Events that will advance the Dequeue Pointer. The Enqueue Pointer is managed by the producer and the Dequeue Pointer is managed by the consumer. The producer maintains a Producer Cycle State (PCS) flag which identifies the value that it shall write to the TRB Cycle bit. The consumer maintains a Consumer Cycle State (CCS) flag, which it compares to the Cycle bit in TRBs that it fetches. If the CCS flag is equal to the value of the TRB Cycle bit, then the consumer owns the TRB pointed to by the Dequeue Pointer and may process it. If they are not equal, then the consumer shall stop processing TRBs and wait for a notification of more work.
xHC 使用入队指针来判断传输环何时为空。在从传输环取 TRB 时，它会检查 Cycle bit 是否发生跳变；若检测到跳变，则环为空。 软件使用出队指针来判断传输环何时已满。在处理传输事件时，软件会用 Transfer Event 的 TRB Pointer 字段的值更新其出队指针副本。如果推进入队指针将使其等于出队指针，则传输环已满，软件必须等待将会推进出队指针的传输事件。 入队指针由生产者管理，出队指针由消费者管理。生产者维护一个生产者轮次状态（Producer Cycle State，PCS）标志，该标志标识它写入 TRB Cycle bit 时应采用的值。消费者维护一个消费者轮次状态（Consumer Cycle State，CCS）标志，并将其与它所取 TRB 中的 Cycle bit 进行比较。若 CCS 标志等于该 TRB Cycle bit 的值，则消费者拥有出队指针所指向的 TRB，并可以处理它；若二者不相等，则消费者必须停止处理 TRB，并等待有更多工作的通知。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L191-L207（p153）
In Figure 4-6, TRBs are written by the producer setting the Cycle bit to the value of PCS. Note that in Figure 4-6, “~PCS” is the inverted version of PCS. To form a ring (or circular queue) a Link TRB may be inserted at the end of a ring to point to the first TRB in the ring. A ring may contain multiple Link TRBs which are used to chain together Transfer Ring Segments. In the example of Figure 4-6 the Toggle Cycle flag is set in the Link TRB. If the Producer encounters a Toggle Cycle flag set in a Link TRB it shall toggle the state of its PCS flag. If the Consumer encounters a Toggle Cycle flag set in a Link TRB it shall toggle the state of its CCS flag. The producer sets the TRB Cycle bit to the value of the PCS flag when it writes a TRB to set the position of the Enqueue Pointer. In Figure 4-6, the next TRB written by the producer after encountering the Link TRB will be TRB 0. The assertion of the Toggle Cycle bit in the Link TRB will cause the Producer to toggle the state of the PCS flag. The Cycle bit in TRB0 will be set to the value of PCS. Link TRBs allow Transfer Rings to span Page boundaries and to be dynamically sized. Note: All TRBs between the Dequeue Pointer and the Enqueue Pointer-1 are owned by the Consumer and may not be modified by the Producer. If the Ring is empty (Dequeue Pointer = Enqueue Pointer) then no TRBs are owned by the Consumer. Any TRBs in a ring not owned by the Consumer are owned by the Producer.
在图 4-6 中，生产者写入 TRB 时将 Cycle bit 置为 PCS 的值。注意，图 4-6 中的“~PCS”是 PCS 的反相版本。 为了构成一个环（即循环队列），可以在环的末尾插入一个 Link TRB，使其指向环中的第一个 TRB。一个环可以包含多个 Link TRB，用于把多个传输环段（Ring Segment）链接在一起。 在图 4-6 的示例中，Link TRB 里设置了 Toggle Cycle（翻转轮次）标志。如果生产者遇到某个 Link TRB 中设置了 Toggle Cycle 标志，它必须翻转其 PCS 标志的状态；如果消费者遇到某个 Link TRB 中设置了 Toggle Cycle 标志，它必须翻转其 CCS 标志的状态。生产者写入 TRB 以设定入队指针位置时，将 TRB 的 Cycle bit 置为 PCS 标志的值。在图 4-6 中，生产者在遇到该 Link TRB 之后写入的下一个 TRB 将是 TRB 0。Link TRB 中 Toggle Cycle 位的置位将使生产者翻转 PCS 标志的状态。TRB0 中的 Cycle bit 将被置为 PCS 的值。 Link TRB 使传输环能够跨越页边界，并支持动态调整大小。 注意：出队指针与入队指针-1 之间的所有 TRB 都由消费者拥有，生产者不得修改。如果环为空（出队指针 = 入队指针），则没有任何 TRB 由消费者拥有。环中任何不由消费者拥有的 TRB 都由生产者拥有。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L260-L280（p154）
Note: If Streams are not enabled for an endpoint, the Transfer Ring CCS flag shall be set to the value of the Endpoint Context DCS flag by a Configure Endpoint Command if the associated Add Context flag is ‘1’, or by a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command.
注意：如果端点未启用 Streams（流），则当关联的 Add Context 标志为 ‘1’ 时，传输环的 CCS 标志应由 Configure Endpoint Command（配置端点命令）设置为 Endpoint Context 的 DCS（Dequeue Cycle State，出队轮次状态）标志的值，或者由 Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command（设置 TR 出队指针命令）设置。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L281-L284（p154）
If Streams are enabled for an endpoint, then when a Stream is selected, the CCS flag shall be set to the value of the DCS flag in the associated Stream Context, and when the Stream state is saved, the DCS flag in the associated Stream Context shall be set to the value of the CCS flag.
如果端点启用了 Streams，则在选定某个 Stream 时，CCS 标志应被置为关联 Stream Context 中 DCS 标志的值；当该 Stream 的状态被保存时，关联 Stream Context 中的 DCS 标志应被置为 CCS 标志的值。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L292-L295（p155）
The Link TRB provides support for non-contiguous TRB Rings. For instance, if contiguous Pages of memory cannot be allocated by system software to form a large TRB Ring, then Link TRBs can be used to tie together multiple memory Pages to form a single large Transfer Ring. A non-contiguous TRB Ring is composed of Ring Segments. A Ring Segment is a contiguous block of physical memory. The Link TRB provides a 64-bit pointer which points to the next segment of a ring. If the ring is comprised of only a single segment, then the only Link TRB points to the beginning of the ring, as illustrated in Figure 4-6 above. A multi-segment ring will use a Link TRB to delimit the end of one Segment and the start of the next. The last TRB in a Ring Segment is always a Link TRB.
Link TRB 为非连续的 TRB 环提供了支持。例如，如果系统软件无法分配连续的内存页来构成一个较大的 TRB 环，则可以使用 Link TRB 把多个内存页串接起来，构成一个大的传输环。 非连续 TRB 环由环段组成。环段是一块物理上连续的内存。Link TRB 提供一个 64 位指针，指向环的下一段。如果环仅由单个段组成，则唯一的 Link TRB 指向环的开头，如上面的图 4-6 所示。多段环会使用 Link TRB 来界定一段的结束与下一段的开始。环段中的最后一个 TRB 总是 Link TRB。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L298-L308（p155）
Figure 4-7 illustrates a Segmented Ring that contains two segments. In this example both segments are allocated as 4KB contiguous blocks of memory. Segment 0 defines 256 TRBs, where the last TRB is a Link TRB that points to the beginning of the next segment. Segment 1, which defines 244 TRBs, does not fully utilize the 4K buffer that was allocated for it. The two segments together define ring size of 500 total TRBs, where 498 of them are available for TDs. Note that the Toggle Cycle flag is set only in Segment 1’s Link TRB.
图 4-7 展示了一个包含两个段的分段环。此例中两个段都分配为 4KB 的连续内存块。段 0 定义了 256 个 TRB，其中最后一个 TRB 是指向下一段开头的 Link TRB。段 1 定义了 244 个 TRB，未完全用满为其分配的 4K 缓冲。两个段合计定义了总大小为 500 个 TRB 的环，其中 498 个可用于 TD。注意，只有段 1 的 Link TRB 中设置了 Toggle Cycle 标志。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L348-L354（p155）
To increase the size of a Transfer Ring, software shall allocate and initialize a new segment. Software then identifies a segment boundary (Link TRB) where it will add the new segment. Note: Only Link TRBs that are owned by the producer may be modified to point to the new segment.
要增大传输环的大小，软件必须分配并初始化一个新段。 然后，软件确定将在其处加入新段的段边界（Link TRB）。 注意：只有生产者拥有的 Link TRB 才可以被修改为指向新段。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L455-L460（p158）
Figure 4-9 illustrates a two segment Transfer Ring (A and B) where TRBs 5 to n of Segment B and TRBs 0 to 3 of Segment A are owned by the consumer (xHC), and the remaining TRBs are available to the producer (software) for creating new TDs. Note that the Toggle Cycle (TC) bit is set in the Link TRB of segment B and not set in the Link TRB of segment A, hence the state of the Cycle bit is toggled once each pass through the Transfer Ring. Now, consider the case where software needs to grow the ring size of Figure 4-9. Software may pause its insertion of TDs on the Transfer Ring, which temporarily stops the Enqueue Pointer from advancing, to insert a new segment. Software may only modify Link TRBs that it owns, so the new segment C may only be inserted between existing segments A and B as illustrated in Figure 4-10.
图 4-9 展示了一个两段的传输环（A 与 B），其中段 B 的 TRB 5 到 n 与段 A 的 TRB 0 到 3 由消费者（xHC）拥有，其余 TRB 可供生产者（软件）用于创建新的 TD。注意，Toggle Cycle（TC）位在段 B 的 Link TRB 中被设置，而在段 A 的 Link TRB 中未设置，因此每绕传输环一圈，Cycle bit 的状态翻转一次。 现在考虑软件需要扩大图 4-9 所示环的大小的情形。软件可以暂停其在传输环上插入 TD，从而暂时阻止入队指针推进，以便插入一个新段。软件只能修改其拥有的 Link TRB，因此新段 C 只能插入到现有段 A 与段 B 之间，如图 4-10 所示。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L506-L517（p159）
In this example software initializes the new segment with the following operations: • All TRBs in the new segment C to ‘0’, including the Cycle bit. • The TRB Type of the last TRB (n) in segment C shall be set to Link TRB. • And the Ring Segment Pointer field of the segment C Link TRB (n) shall be initialized to point to the first TRB (0) of segment B. • The Toggle Cycle (TC) flag of the segment C Link TRB (n) shall be set, to indicate the Cycle bit transition between the last TRB in segment C and first TRB in segment B. Software then modifies segment A’s Link pointer to point to link the new Segment C into the ring. • The Ring Segment Pointer field of the segment A Link TRB (n) shall be initialized to point to the first TRB (0) of segment C. • The Toggle Cycle (TC) flag of the segment A Link TRB (n) shall be set to ‘1’, to indicate the Cycle bit transition between the consumer owned TRBs in segments A and C. Software is required to ensure that the state of the Cycle bits in the new segment(s) and the Toggle Cycle flags in the Link TRBs that are used to connect the new segment to existing segments, do not cause an inconsistency in the definition of the Enqueue Pointer position.
在此示例中，软件通过以下操作初始化新段： - 新段 C 中的所有 TRB 置为 ‘0’，包括 Cycle bit。 - 段 C 中最后一个 TRB（n）的 TRB Type 必须被设置为 Link TRB。 - 并且段 C 的 Link TRB（n）的 Ring Segment Pointer 字段必须被初始化为指向段 B 的第一个 TRB（0）。 - 段 C 的 Link TRB（n）的 Toggle Cycle（TC）标志必须被设置，以指示段 C 最后一个 TRB 与段 B 第一个 TRB 之间的 Cycle bit 跳变。 随后，软件修改段 A 的 Link 指针，把新段 C 链接入环。 - 段 A 的 Link TRB（n）的 Ring Segment Pointer 字段必须被初始化为指向段 C 的第一个 TRB（0）。 - 段 A 的 Link TRB（n）的 Toggle Cycle（TC）标志必须被置为 ‘1’，以指示段 A 与段 C 中消费者所拥有的 TRB 之间的 Cycle bit 跳变。 软件必须确保：新段（们）中 Cycle bit 的状态，以及用于把新段连接到现有段的那些 Link TRB 中的 Toggle Cycle 标志，不会造成入队指针位置定义上的不一致。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L595-L620（p159）
Software is required to ensure that the state of the Cycle bits in the new segment(s) and the Toggle Cycle flags in the Link TRBs that are used to connect the new segment to existing segments, do not cause an inconsistency in the definition of the Enqueue Pointer position. Given the initial conditions illustrated in Figure 4-9, to ensure Cycle bit consistency when inserting segments software may either: 1) clear all the Cycle bits in all TRBs in the new segment(s) to ‘0’ and modify the Link TRB
软件必须确保：新段（们）中 Cycle bit 的状态，以及用于把新段连接到现有段的那些 Link TRB 中的 Toggle Cycle 标志，不会造成入队指针位置定义上的不一致。 给定图 4-9 所示的初始条件，为了在插入段时保证 Cycle bit 的一致性，软件可以：1) 把新段（们）中所有 TRB 的所有 Cycle bit 清为 ‘0’，并修改指向新段的那个段以及新段中的 Link TRB Toggle Cycle 标志；或 2) 把新段中所有 TRB 的所有 Cycle bit 置为 ‘1’。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L617-L624（p159）
Toggle Cycle flags in the segment that points to the new segment and the new segment, or 2) set all the Cycle bits in all TRBs in the new segment to ‘1’. Figure 4-10 illustrates the case 1.
给定图 4-9 所示的初始条件，为了在插入段时保证 Cycle bit 的一致性，软件可以：1) 把新段（们）中所有 TRB 的所有 Cycle bit 清为 ‘0’，并修改指向新段的那个段以及新段中的 Link TRB Toggle Cycle 标志；或 2) 把新段中所有 TRB 的所有 Cycle bit 置为 ‘1’。图 4-10 展示的是情形 1。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L630-L632（p160）
To decrease the size of a Transfer Ring, software shall identify a segment boundary (Link TRB) where it will perform the shrink operation. Note: The producer shall not modify Link TRBs that it does not currently own. Software may modify the Link TRB Ring Segment Pointer to map out one or more intermediate segments and/or set the Link TRB Ring Segment Pointer to a TRB location in the segment terminated by the Link TRB. Software shall ensure that the state of the Cycle bits in all remaining segments do not cause an inconsistency in the definition of the Enqueue Pointer position by managing the Link TRB Toggle Cycle bits.
要减小传输环的大小，软件必须确定执行收缩操作的段边界（Link TRB）。 注意：生产者不得修改其当前不拥有的 Link TRB。 软件可以修改 Link TRB 的 Ring Segment Pointer 以把一个或多个中间段移出映射（map out），和/或把 Link TRB Ring Segment Pointer 设置为该 Link TRB 所终止段内的某个 TRB 位置。 软件必须通过管理 Link TRB 的 Toggle Cycle 位，确保所有剩余段中 Cycle bit 的状态不会造成入队指针位置定义上的不一致。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L635-L643（p160）

413int xhci_ring_expansion(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, struct xhci_ring *ring,


414				unsigned int num_new_segs, gfp_t flags)


415{


416	struct xhci_ring new_ring;


417	int ret;


418


419	if (num_new_segs == 0)


420		return 0;


421


422	new_ring.num_segs = num_new_segs;


423	new_ring.bounce_buf_len = ring->bounce_buf_len;


424	new_ring.type = ring->type;


425	ret = xhci_alloc_segments_for_ring(xhci, &new_ring, flags);


426	if (ret)


427		return -ENOMEM;


428


429	xhci_initialize_ring_segments(xhci, &new_ring);


430


431	if (ring->type == TYPE_STREAM) {


432		ret = xhci_update_stream_segment_mapping(ring->trb_address_map, ring,


433							 new_ring.first_seg, flags);


434		if (ret)


435			goto free_segments;


436	}


437


438	xhci_link_rings(xhci, &new_ring, ring);


439	trace_xhci_ring_expansion(ring);


440	xhci_dbg_trace(xhci, trace_xhci_dbg_ring_expansion,


441			"ring expansion succeed, now has %d segments",


442			ring->num_segs);


443


444	return 0;


445


446free_segments:


447	xhci_ring_segments_free(xhci, &new_ring);


448	return ret;


449}

规范算法全文收纳（算法流程图 + 折叠原文逐字备查；短片降密度：片内只讲机制主线）

流程图 · 4.9.2.2 入队指针推进与判满（Figure 4-8 语义重建） · 依据 spec-49.txt L363-L383 + L413-L448（图 L390-L407）
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Dequeue Pointer is “advanced”, its value is adjusted to point to the next transfer related (Isoch, Setup Stage, Normal, etc.) TRB to be executed. The xHC increments the pointer value by 16 bytes to point to the next TRB, however if the next TRB is a Link TRB and its Cycle bit indicates that it is a valid TRB, then the xHC will automatically set the Dequeue Pointer to the address provided by the Link TRB. This operation will point the Dequeue Pointer to the first TRB of the next segment. Software is responsible for advancing the Enqueue pointer. It does this by toggling the Cycle bit each pass through the ring as it writes TRBs. Once started (by a doorbell), the xHC processes TRBs until the ring is empty. A ring is defined as “empty” if the Dequeue Pointer is equal to the Enqueue pointer. The value of the Enqueue Pointer is defined by the Cycle bit transition. To prevent overruns, software shall determine when the Ring is full. The ring is defined as “full” if advancing the Enqueue Pointer will make it equal to the Dequeue Pointer. Software shall take Link TRBs into account when evaluating the full condition. If the Enqueue Pointer is not pointing at a Link TRB, software can determine if the Ring is full by adding the size of a TRB (16) to the Enqueue Pointer and checking if the result is equal to the value of the Dequeue Pointer. If the Enqueue Pointer is pointing at a Link TRB, then software shall compare the Ring Segment Pointer value in the Link TRB with the Dequeue Pointer.
当出队指针被“推进”时，其值被调整为指向下一个待执行的、与传输相关的（等时（Isoch）、Setup Stage、Normal 等）TRB。xHC 将指针值增加 16 字节以指向下一个 TRB；但如果下一个 TRB 是 Link TRB 且其 Cycle bit 表明它是有效 TRB，则 xHC 会自动把出队指针设置为该 Link TRB 所提供的地址。这一操作会把出队指针指向下一段的第一个 TRB。 推进入队指针是软件的职责。软件通过在每次绕环写入 TRB 时翻转 Cycle bit 来做到这一点。 一旦被启动（通过门铃（doorbell）），xHC 就会持续处理 TRB 直至环为空。若出队指针等于入队指针，则定义环为“空”。入队指针的值由 Cycle bit 的跳变来定义。 为防止溢出（overrun），软件必须自行判定环何时已满。如果推进入队指针将使其等于出队指针，则定义环为“满”。软件在评估“满”条件时必须将 Link TRB 考虑在内。如果入队指针未指向 Link TRB，软件可以通过把一个 TRB 的大小（16）加到入队指针上、并检查结果是否等于出队指针的值来判定环是否已满。如果入队指针正指向一个 Link TRB，则软件应将 Link TRB 中的 Ring Segment Pointer 值与出队指针进行比较。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L363-L383（p156）
The Pointer Advancement rules: • The Cycle bit shall be initialized by software to ‘0’ in all TRBs of all segments when initializing a ring. • The Producer Cycle State (PCS) and the Consumer Cycle State (CCS) bits shall be set to ‘1’ when a ring is initialized. Note: The initial state of a Transfer Ring’s CCS flag is determined by the Endpoint Context DCS flag. The initial state of the Command Ring’s CCS flag is determined by the Command Ring Control Register Ring Cycle State (RCS) flag. The initial state of the Event Ring’s CCS flag is always ‘1’. The previous two bullets assume that the DCS and RCS flags are initialized to ‘1’ by software. If software chooses to initialize a CCS flag (DCS or RCS) to ‘0’, the Cycle bits in the respective ring shall be set to ‘1’. • The Cycle bit shall be written by the producer with the current value of the PCS bit. • The Cycle bit shall be treated as Read-Only by the consumer. • The Consumer may execute a TRB referenced by the Dequeue Pointer whose Cycle bit equals CCS.
指针推进（Pointer Advancement）规则： - 初始化环时，软件必须把所有段中所有 TRB 的 Cycle bit 初始化为 ‘0’。 - 环被初始化时，生产者轮次状态（PCS）与消费者轮次状态（CCS）位必须被置为 ‘1’。 注意：传输环 CCS 标志的初始状态由 Endpoint Context 的 DCS 标志决定。命令环 CCS 标志的初始状态由 Command Ring Control 寄存器的 Ring Cycle State（RCS）标志决定。事件环 CCS 标志的初始状态始终为 ‘1’。前两条列表项假设 DCS 与 RCS 标志已由软件初始化为 ‘1’。如果软件选择把某个 CCS 标志（DCS 或 RCS）初始化为 ‘0’，则相应环中的 Cycle bit 应被置为 ‘1’。 - 生产者写入 Cycle bit 时必须采用 PCS 位的当前值。 - 消费者必须把 Cycle bit 视为只读（Read-Only）。 - 消费者可以执行出队指针所引用、且其 Cycle bit 等于 CCS 的 TRB。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L413-L434（p157）
• If the Enqueue Pointer references a Link TRB, then the Enqueue Pointer shall be set to Link TRB Ring Segment Pointer and if the Toggle Cycle bit is set to ‘1’ in the Link TRB, the PCS bit shall be toggled by the Producer. • If the Dequeue Pointer references a Link TRB then the Dequeue Pointer shall be set to Link TRB Ring Segment Pointer and if the Toggle Cycle bit is set to ‘1’ in the Link TRB, the CCS bit shall be toggled by the Consumer. Note: A Cycle bit transition takes place between a Link TRB and the first TRB of the segment that the Link TRB Ring Segment Pointer references. Note: The TR Dequeue Pointer and Link TRB are not required to point to the beginning of a memory page.
- 如果入队指针引用的是 Link TRB，则入队指针必须被设置为该 Link TRB 的 Ring Segment Pointer；且如果该 Link TRB 中的 Toggle Cycle 位被置为 ‘1’，生产者必须翻转 PCS 位。 - 如果出队指针引用的是 Link TRB，则出队指针必须被设置为该 Link TRB 的 Ring Segment Pointer；且如果该 Link TRB 中的 Toggle Cycle 位被置为 ‘1’，消费者必须翻转 CCS 位。 注意：Cycle bit 的跳变发生在 Link TRB 与该 Link TRB 的 Ring Segment Pointer 所引用段的第一个 TRB 之间。 注意：TR Dequeue Pointer 与 Link TRB 不要求指向内存页的起始处。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L441-L452（p158）
上游 commit b234c70fefa7532d34ebee104de64cc16f1b21e4 · 2024-03-05 · Mathias Nyman（Intel） · drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c 1 文件 +7/-1 · hunk @@ -326,7（xhci_ring_expansion_needed）· Reported-by/Tested-by Chris Yokum（TotalPhase）· Fixes f5af638f0609 · Cc: stable # v6.5+

完整补丁 · git show 逐字

commit b234c70fefa7532d34ebee104de64cc16f1b21e4
Author: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
Date:   Tue Mar 5 15:23:12 2024 +0200

    xhci: Fix failure to detect ring expansion need.
    
    Ring expansion checker may incorrectly assume a completely full ring
    is empty, missing the need for expansion.
    
    This is due to a special empty ring case where the dequeue ends up
    ahead of the enqueue pointer. This is seen when enqueued TRBs fill up
    exactly a segment, with enqueue then pointing to the end link TRB.
    Once those TRBs are handled the dequeue pointer will follow the link
    TRB and end up pointing to the first entry on the next segment, past
    the enqueue.
    
    This same enqueue - dequeue condition can be true if a ring is full,
    with enqueue ending on that last link TRB before the dequeue pointer
    on the next segment.
    
    This can be seen when queuing several ~510 small URBs via usbfs in
    one go before a single one is handled (i.e. dequeue not moved from first
    entry in segment).
    
    Expand the ring already when enqueue reaches the link TRB before the
    dequeue segment, instead of expanding it when enqueue moves into the
    dequeue segment.
    
    Reported-by: Chris Yokum <linux-usb@mail.totalphase.com>
    Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/all/949223224.833962.1709339266739.JavaMail.zimbra@totalphase.com
    Tested-by: Chris Yokum <linux-usb@mail.totalphase.com>
    Fixes: f5af638f0609 ("xhci: Fix transfer ring expansion size calculation")
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v6.5+
    Signed-off-by: Mathias Nyman <mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com>
    Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240305132312.955171-2-mathias.nyman@linux.intel.com
    Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

-	if (trbs_past_seg <= 0)

+	 * Consider expanding the ring already if num_trbs fills the current

背景（何时 / 谁修 / 为什么是它）

2024 年 3 月，TotalPhase 的 Chris Yokum 报告并实测。场景（message 原文）：usbfs 一次排入 ~510 个小 URB、一个还没被处理——环扩容检查器漏检扩容需求。对应 §4.9.2 传输环管理：本卡贴码段 xhci_ring_expansion()（扩容执行方）调用下述检查器。

要解决的问题（症状 + 机制）

症状：完全满环被当成空环、漏扩容。机制：TRBs 恰好填满一段时 enq 停在段尾 Link TRB；deq 处理完跟随 Link 跳到下一段首、越过 enq——「deq 在 enq 前面」这个形态，空环特例（enq 卡 Link TRB 而 deq 已前进）与完全满环同形；旧检查 trbs_past_seg <= 0 在「恰好填满」（==0）时提前返回不用扩。

代码逻辑（补丁前 → 后行为对照）

边界条件 <= 0 → < 0（+7 行注释）：恰好填满段（==0）即扩，不等 TRB 伸进下一段——满环不再走到空环特例去撞同形判定。规范对齐：§4.9.2 p156 "the ring is defined as 'full' if advancing the Enqueue Pointer will make it equal to the Dequeue Pointer. Software shall take Link TRBs into account when evaluating the full condition"——满判定必须计入 Link TRB，修复把边界提前到 enq 抵达 Link TRB 之时。对读注记：下方对读段（L386-L426）即检查器全文，基线即含此补丁；分帧走读见 xh0902p（scene=48）。

补丁对读段 commit d9008e061539 · 修复后形态（基线即含此补丁）· 零摘录热行（判据=diff 原文+规范引文）

drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c:386-426 · xhci_ring_expansion_needed·补丁对读段 · d9008e061539
386static unsigned int xhci_ring_expansion_needed(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, struct xhci_ring *ring,


387					       unsigned int num_trbs)


388{


389	struct xhci_segment *seg;


390	int trbs_past_seg;


391	int enq_used;


392	int new_segs;


393


394	enq_used = ring->enqueue - ring->enq_seg->trbs;


395


396	/* how many trbs will be queued past the enqueue segment? */


397	trbs_past_seg = enq_used + num_trbs - (TRBS_PER_SEGMENT - 1);


398


399	/*


400	 * Consider expanding the ring already if num_trbs fills the current


401	 * segment (i.e. trbs_past_seg == 0), not only when num_trbs goes into


402	 * the next segment. Avoids confusing full ring with special empty ring


403	 * case below


404	 */


405	if (trbs_past_seg < 0)


406		return 0;


407


408	/* Empty ring special case, enqueue stuck on link trb while dequeue advanced */


409	if (trb_is_link(ring->enqueue) && ring->enq_seg->next->trbs == ring->dequeue)


410		return 0;


411


412	new_segs = 1 + (trbs_past_seg / (TRBS_PER_SEGMENT - 1));


413	seg = ring->enq_seg;


414


415	while (new_segs > 0) {


416		seg = seg->next;


417		if (seg == ring->deq_seg) {


418			xhci_dbg(xhci, "Adding %d trbs requires expanding ring by %d segments\n",


419				 num_trbs, new_segs);


420			return new_segs;


421		}


422		new_segs--;


423	}


424


425	return 0;


426}

4.9.3Command Ring Management 命令环管理（轻片）机制p160-p161

规范引文（机制主线）

The operation of a Command Ring is identical to Transfer Rings with the following exceptions: • If the Command Ring Control Register (CRCR) is written while the Command Ring is stopped (CRR = ‘0’) the xHC shall initialize the Command Ring Dequeue Pointer with the value of the Command Ring Pointer field (refer to section 5.4.5). • When the Host Controller Doorbell Register (0) is written by system software, the xHC will evaluate the Command TRB pointed to by the Command Ring Dequeue Pointer. Once started (by a doorbell write), the xHC processes Command TRBs and advances the Command Ring Dequeue Pointer until the ring is empty. • The location of the Command Ring Dequeue Pointer is reported on the Event Ring in Command Completion Events. • No multi-TRB TDs are allowed on the Command Ring.
命令环的操作与传输环完全相同，但有以下例外： - 如果在命令环处于停止状态（CRR = ‘0’）时写入命令环控制寄存器（Command Ring Control Register，CRCR），xHC 必须用 Command Ring Pointer 字段的值来初始化命令环出队指针（参见 5.4.5 节）。 - 当系统软件写入主机控制器门铃寄存器（Host Controller Doorbell Register，编号 0）时，xHC 会评估命令环出队指针所指向的 Command TRB。一旦被启动（通过写门铃），xHC 便处理命令 TRB 并推进命令环出队指针，直至环为空。 - 命令环出队指针的位置通过命令完成事件（Command Completion Event）在事件环上报告。 - 命令环上不允许出现多 TRB TD。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L648-L665（p160）
All other aspects of Command Ring management are identical to those described for the Transfer Rings. that is: • Software is responsible for advancing the Enqueue pointer. It does this by toggling the Cycle bit each pass through the Command Ring as it writes Command TRBs. • A Command Ring is defined as “empty” if the Dequeue Pointer is equal to the Enqueue pointer. The Enqueue Pointer is defined by a Cycle bit transition.
命令环管理所有其他方面都与针对传输环所描述的完全相同，即： - 推进入队指针是软件的职责。软件通过在每次绕命令环写入命令 TRB 时翻转 Cycle bit 来做到这一点。 - 如果出队指针等于入队指针，则定义命令环为“空”。入队指针由 Cycle bit 的跳变来定义。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L666-L675（p160）
Note: While the Command Ring is in the Running state (CRR = ‘1’), it may be Busy (actively processing Command TRBs) or Idle (not processing Command TRBs and waiting for a doorbell ring), that is, CRR is not negated when the Command Ring has completed all queued commands.
注意：当命令环处于 Running 状态（CRR = ‘1’）时，它可能处于 Busy（正在处理命令 TRB）或 Idle（未在处理命令 TRB、等待门铃被敲响）；也就是说，当命令环已完成所有排队的命令时，CRR 并不会被清除（negated）。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L684-L687（p161）

drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c:460-494 · xhci_handle_stopped_cmd_ring · d9008e061539
460static void xhci_handle_stopped_cmd_ring(struct xhci_hcd *xhci,


461					 struct xhci_command *cur_cmd)


462{


463	struct xhci_command *i_cmd;


464


465	/* Turn all aborted commands in list to no-ops, then restart */


466	list_for_each_entry(i_cmd, &xhci->cmd_list, cmd_list) {


467


468		if (i_cmd->status != COMP_COMMAND_ABORTED)


469			continue;


470


471		i_cmd->status = COMP_COMMAND_RING_STOPPED;


472


473		xhci_dbg(xhci, "Turn aborted command %p to no-op\n",


474			 i_cmd->command_trb);


475


476		trb_to_noop(i_cmd->command_trb, TRB_CMD_NOOP, false);


477


478		/*


479		 * caller waiting for completion is called when command


480		 *  completion event is received for these no-op commands


481		 */


482	}


483


484	xhci->cmd_ring_state = CMD_RING_STATE_RUNNING;


485


486	/* ring command ring doorbell to restart the command ring */


487	if ((xhci->cmd_ring->dequeue != xhci->cmd_ring->enqueue) &&


488	    !(xhci->xhc_state & XHCI_STATE_DYING)) {


489		xhci->current_cmd = cur_cmd;


490		if (cur_cmd)


491			xhci_mod_cmd_timer(xhci);


492		xhci_ring_cmd_db(xhci);


493	}


494}

4.9.4Event Ring Management 事件环管理机制p161-p170

规范引文（机制主线）

A fundamental difference between an Event Ring and a Transfer or Command Ring is that the xHC is the producer and system software is the consumer of Event TRBs. The xHC writes Event TRBs to the Event Ring and updates the Cycle bit in the TRBs to indicate to software the current position of the Enqueue Pointer. The xHC maintains an Event Ring Producer Cycle State (PCS) bit, initializing it to ‘1’ and toggling it every time the Event Ring Enqueue Pointer wraps back to the beginning of the Event Ring. The value of the PCS bit is written to the Cycle bit when the xHC generates an Event TRB on the Event Ring. Software maintains an Event Ring Consumer Cycle State (CCS) bit, initializing it to ‘1’ and toggling it every time the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer wraps back to the beginning of the Event Ring. If the Cycle bit of the Event TRB pointed to by the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer equals CCS, then the Event TRB is a valid event, software processes it and advances the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer. If the Event TRB Cycle bit is not equal to CCS, then software stops processing Event TRBs and waits for an interrupt from the xHC for the Event Ring. When the interrupt occurs, software picks up where it left off, checking the Cycle bit of the Event TRB pointed to by the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer against its CCS bit.
事件环与传输环或命令环的一个根本区别在于：Event TRB 的生产者是 xHC，消费者是系统软件。xHC 把 Event TRB 写入事件环，并更新 TRB 中的 Cycle bit，以此向软件指示入队指针的当前位置。 xHC 维护一个事件环生产者轮次状态（Event Ring Producer Cycle State，PCS）位，将其初始化为 ‘1’，并在事件环入队指针每次回绕到事件环开头时翻转它。当 xHC 在事件环上生成一个 Event TRB 时，PCS 位的值被写入 Cycle bit。 软件维护一个事件环消费者轮次状态（Event Ring Consumer Cycle State，CCS）位，将其初始化为 ‘1’，并在事件环出队指针每次回绕到事件环开头时翻转它。如果事件环出队指针所指向的 Event TRB 的 Cycle bit 等于 CCS，则该 Event TRB 是一个有效事件，软件处理它并推进事件环出队指针。如果该 Event TRB 的 Cycle bit 不等于 CCS，则软件停止处理 Event TRB，等待 xHC 针对该事件环发出的中断。中断发生时，软件从上次停下的地方继续，把事件环出队指针所指向 Event TRB 的 Cycle bit 与其 CCS 位进行比较。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L695-L713（p161）
System software shall write the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer (ERDP) register to inform the xHC that it has completed the processing of Event TRBs up to and including the Event TRB referenced by the ERDP. Note: The detection of a Cycle bit mismatch in an Event TRB processed by software indicates the location of the xHC Event Ring Enqueue Pointer and that the Event Ring is empty. Software shall write the ERDP with the address of this TRB to indicate that it has processed all Events in the ring.
系统软件必须写 Event Ring Dequeue Pointer（ERDP）寄存器，以告知 xHC：它已完成对直至并包含 ERDP 所引用 Event TRB 在内的所有 Event TRB 的处理。 注意：软件在处理某个 Event TRB 时检测到 Cycle bit 不匹配，即指示了 xHC 事件环入队指针的位置，且事件环为空。软件应把 ERDP 写为该 TRB 的地址，以表明它已处理完环中的所有事件。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L714-L720（p161）
Event Ring segments are defined by an Event Ring Segment Table (ERST).
事件环段由事件环段表（Event Ring Segment Table，ERST）定义。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L721-L721（p161）
Note: The xHC may prefetch the next ERST entry before completely consuming the current ERST entry to avoid temporarily running out of Event Ring entries to write. As a result, if the xHC is currently writing to ERST(ERSTSZ - 1) and software increases the size of the Event Ring by writing a larger value to ERSTSZ (see Section 4.9.4.1) the xHC may have already prefetched ERST(0). In this case the effect of increasing the size of the Event Ring will take effect after the xHC consumes ERST(0). Similarly, if the xHC is currently writing to ERST(n) and software removes ERST(n+1) by shrinking the size of the Event Ring (see Section 4.9.4.2) the xHC may have already prefetched ERST(n+1). In this case the effect of decreasing the size of the Event Ring will take effect after the xHC consumes ERST(n+1).
注意：xHC 可以在完全耗尽当前 ERST 项之前预取下一个 ERST 项，以避免出现暂时没有事件环条目可写的情况。因此，如果 xHC 当前正在写 ERST(ERSTSZ - 1)，而软件通过向 ERSTSZ 写入更大的值来增大事件环的大小（见 4.9.4.1 节），xHC 可能已经预取了 ERST(0)。在这种情况下，增大事件环大小的效果将在 xHC 耗尽 ERST(0) 之后生效。类似地，如果 xHC 当前正在写 ERST(n)，而软件通过缩小事件环的大小移除了 ERST(n+1)（见 4.9.4.2 节），xHC 可能已经预取了 ERST(n+1)。在这种情况下，缩小事件环大小的效果将在 xHC 耗尽 ERST(n+1) 之后生效。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L741-L751（p162）
Figure 4-11 illustrates a segmented Event Ring that consists of 3 segments. Rules for operation of an Event Ring:
图 4-11 展示了一个由 3 个段组成的分段事件环。 事件环的操作规则：
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L799-L800（p162）
Prior to writing the ERST Base Address (ERSTBA) register system software shall: Initialize the Event Ring Segments that will be referenced by the Event Ring Segment Table (ERST) to ‘0’. Initialize the ERST by initializing the ERST.BaseAddress and ERST.Size fields of each element in the table. The ERST.BaseAddress field shall point to the associated Event Ring Segment, and the ERST.Size field shall indicate the number of TRBs supported by the segment. • Write the ERST Size (ERSTSZ) Register with the number of valid entries in the ERST and Event Ring Dequeue Pointer (ERDP) Register with the value of ERST(0).BaseAddress.
- 在写 ERST Base Address（ERSTBA）寄存器之前，系统软件必须：把将被事件环段表（ERST）引用的事件环段初始化为 ‘0’；通过初始化表中每个元素的 ERST.BaseAddress 与 ERST.Size 字段来初始化 ERST。ERST.BaseAddress 字段必须指向关联的事件环段，ERST.Size 字段必须指明该段支持的 TRB 数量。 - 向 ERST Size（ERSTSZ）寄存器写入 ERST 中有效条目的数量，并向 Event Ring Dequeue Pointer（ERDP）寄存器写入 ERST(0).BaseAddress 的值。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L802-L813（p162）
Write the ERST Base Address (ERSTBA) register with the value of ERST(0).BaseAddress. When the ERSTBA register is written, the Event Ring State Machine (Figure 4-12) is set to the Start state. • System software shall advance the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer by writing the address of the last processed Event TRB to the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer (ERDP) register. Note, the “last processed Event TRB” includes the case where software detects a Cycle bit mismatch when evaluating an Event TRB and the ring is empty. • System software is responsible for ensuring valid values for ERST entries in paged environments. • System software is responsible for ensuring the Size of every ERST entry (Event Ring segment) is at least 16.
- 向 ERST Base Address（ERSTBA）寄存器写入 ERST(0).BaseAddress 的值。ERSTBA 寄存器被写入时，事件环状态机（Event Ring State Machine，图 4-12）被置为 Start（启动）状态。 - 系统软件必须通过把最后一个已处理的 Event TRB 的地址写入 Event Ring Dequeue Pointer（ERDP）寄存器来推进事件环出队指针。注意，“最后一个已处理的 Event TRB”也包括软件在评估某个 Event TRB 时检测到 Cycle bit 不匹配、且环为空的情形。 - 在分页环境中，系统软件负责确保 ERST 各项的值有效。 - 系统软件负责确保每个 ERST 项（事件环段）的 Size 至少为 16。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L821-L835（p163）
Figure 4-12 describes the algorithm the xHC employs for advancing its internal Event Ring Enqueue Pointer (EREP). The left side of the figure describes the EREP Advancement algorithm. The right side of the figure describes the algorithm for checking if the Event Ring is full. Note: The Producer Cycle State (PCS) flag for the Event Ring is toggled only when the Event Ring wraps back to the beginning. Note: The Event Ring State machine is Stopped if the USBCMD Run/Stop (R/S) flag is ‘0’. Note: A blocked Event Ring may impact forward progress on endpoints whose TDs target other Event Rings.
EREP 推进（EREP Advancement）／事件环满检查（Event Ring Full Check）　图 4-12 描述了 xHC 用于推进其内部事件环入队指针（Event Ring Enqueue Pointer，EREP）的算法。图的左侧描述 EREP 推进算法；右侧描述检查事件环是否已满的算法。 注意：事件环的生产者轮次状态（PCS）标志只在事件环回绕到开头时才翻转。 注意：若 USBCMD 的 Run/Stop（R/S）标志为 ‘0’，事件环状态机处于 Stopped（停止）状态。 注意：被阻塞的事件环可能影响那些 TD 以其他事件环为目标的端点的前向进展（forward progress）。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L924-L933（p164）
Note: It is recommended that software process as many Events as possible before writing the ERDP. This approach not only minimizes the number of MMIO writes, but is particularly important if the Event Ring is full. If an Event Ring Full condition exists, writing the ERDP after processing individual Events may cause no work to progress because the Event Ring becomes filled with Event Ring Full Events. Ideally, software writes the ERDP after processing all Events on an Event Ring. Practically, software should maximize the number of Events processed before writing the ERDP, for example, processing a minimum of 4 Events before each ERDP write.
注意：建议软件在写 ERDP 之前尽可能多地处理事件。这种做法不仅可以最小化 MMIO 写入次数，而且在事件环已满时尤为重要。如果存在事件环满（Event Ring Full）状态，在逐个处理事件后就写 ERDP，可能因为事件环被 Event Ring Full 事件填满而导致没有任何工作取得进展。理想情况下，软件在处理完事件环上的所有事件之后再写 ERDP。实际上，软件应在写 ERDP 之前最大化已处理事件的数量，例如，每次写 ERDP 之前至少处理 4 个事件。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L940-L951（p165）
Note: Software writes to the ERDP register shall always advance the Event Ring Dequeue Pointer value, that is, software shall not write the same value to the ERDP register on two consecutive write operations.
注意：对 ERDP 寄存器的软件写入必须总是推进事件环出队指针的值，也就是说，软件不得在连续两次写操作中向 ERDP 寄存器写入相同的值。

Table 4-4: Event Ring State Machine Definitions
NameLabelDescription
Event Ring Segment TableERSTResides in host memory. Contains the addresses and lengths of the Event Ring segments. Refer to section 6.5.
Event Ring Dequeue PointerERDPResides in Runtime register space. Advanced by software. Refer to section 5.5.2.3.3.
Event Ring Enqueue PointerEREPInternal xHC variable. Advanced by Figure 4-12 algorithm
Event Ring Segment Table CountERST CountInternal xHC variable. Identifies the offset into the ERST of the segment that is currently being filled with Event TRBs by the xHC.
Event Ring Segment Table EntryERSTEInternal xHC variable. A pointer to an ERST entry.
Event Ring Segment Table Base AddressERSTE.BaseAddrRing Segment Base Address field of current ERST entry.
Event Ring Segment SizeERSTE.SizeSegment Size field of current ERST entry.
Event Ring Segment Table SizeERSTSZNumber of entries in the in the ERST.

TRB CountTRB CountInternal xHC variable. Identifies the number of remaining TRBs in the current segment.
To increase the size of an Event Ring, software shall allocate and initialize a new segment. Software then initializes ERST entries, starting at the offset defined by ERSTSZ, with the Address and Size of the new Event Ring segment(s) and writes new size of the ERST to the ERSTSZ Register. Software may determine when the xHC has started using the new segment by evaluating the Completion Code of the first TRB in the new segment for a non- zero (valid) condition.
要增大事件环的大小，软件必须分配并初始化一个新段。 然后，软件从 ERSTSZ 定义的偏移开始，用新事件环段（们）的地址与大小初始化 ERST 条目，并把 ERST 的新大小写入 ERSTSZ 寄存器。 软件可以通过评估新段中第一个 TRB 的完成码（Completion Code）是否为非零（有效），来判定 xHC 何时开始使用新段。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L1143-L1150（p168）
To decrease the size of an Event Ring, software shall decrement value of the ERSTSZ Register. Software may determine when the xHC has stopped using the segment that is to be removed by evaluating the state of the Cycle bit of the first TRB in the deleted segment(s).
要减小事件环的大小，软件必须减小（decrement）ERSTSZ 寄存器的值。 软件可以通过评估被删除段（们）中第一个 TRB 的 Cycle bit 状态，来判定 xHC 何时已停止使用将被移除的段。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L1197-L1201（p169）
The number of Interrupters available to software is defined by the MaxIntrs field in the HCSPARAMS1 register. If more than one Interrupter is available then the 0th Interrupter is referred to as the Primary Interrupter and all other Interrupters are referred to as the Secondary Interrupters. Each Interrupter defines an associated Event Ring. The Event Ring associated with the 0th Interrupter is referred to as the Primary Event Ring. The Event Rings associated with the other Interrupters are referred to as the Secondary Event Rings. The only Event TRB types that may be found on a Secondary Event Ring are:
软件可用的中断器数量由 HCSPARAMS1 寄存器中的 MaxIntrs 字段定义。如果可用的中断器多于一个，则 0 号中断器被称为主中断器（Primary Interrupter），其余所有中断器被称为次级中断器（Secondary Interrupter）。每个中断器都定义了一个关联的事件环。与 0 号中断器关联的事件环被称为主事件环（Primary Event Ring），与其他中断器关联的事件环被称为次级事件环（Secondary Event Ring）。次级事件环上可能出现的 Event TRB 类型仅有：
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L1230-L1238（p170）
Transfer Events generated by a Device Slot may be directed to a Secondary Event Ring by a non-’0’ value in the Transfer TRB Interrupter Target field. All Transfer Events with the TRB Interrupter Target field cleared to ‘0’, shall be directed to the Primary Event Ring by the xHC. Bandwidth Request and Device Notification Events are targeted at a Device Slot. The xHC shall use the Device Slot’s Slot Context Interrupter Target field to determine the Event Ring that shall receive the event.
设备槽位（Device Slot）产生的 Transfer Event 可以通过 Transfer TRB 的 Interrupter Target 字段中的非 ‘0’ 值被定向到某个次级事件环。所有 Interrupter Target 字段被清为 ‘0’ 的 Transfer Event，都必须由 xHC 定向到主事件环。 Bandwidth Request Event 与 Device Notification Event 以设备槽位为目标。xHC 必须使用该设备槽位的 Slot Context 中的 Interrupter Target 字段来确定应当接收该事件的事件环。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L1249-L1255（p170）

流程图 · 4.9.4 EREP 推进算法（Figure 4-12 左侧语义重建） · 依据 spec-49.txt L1018-L1056
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
The following steps describe the xHC Event Ring Enqueue Pointer (EREP) Advancement algorithm (left side of Figure 4-12): 4. When the ERST Base Address (ERSTBA) register is initially written the Event Ring State Machine enters the Start state. 5. The xHC initializes its internal PCS flag to ‘1’. 6. The xHC sets its internal ERST Count to ‘0’. 7. The xHC then fetches the entry in the Event Ring Segment Table referenced by the ERST Count (ERSTE = ERST[ERST Count]) and initializes its Enqueue Pointer (EREP) with the value of the Ring Segment Base Address field (ERSTE.BaseAddr), and the TRB Count with the value of the Segment Size field (ERSTE.Size). 8. If the USBCMD Run/Stop (R/S) flag = ‘0’ the Event Ring State Machine shall wait for Run/Stop (R/S) to return to ‘1’27. When Run/Stop (R/S) flag = ‘1’ the xHC shall proceeds to check if an event is posted (step 6., otherwise it proceeds immediately to step 6. 9. When an event is posted for the ring, the xHC shall first check if the ring is full. If not, the xHC writes the Event TRB to the location identified by the EREP, increments the EREP by 16, and decrements the TRB Count. The Cycle bit of the Event TRB is set to the value of the PCS flag. If no event is posted, the xHC will return to step 5. 10. As long as the TRB Count is non-zero, the xHC shall return to step 5, continuing to check Run/Stop (R/S) or for new events. 11. When the TRB Count reaches ‘0’, the xHC shall increment the ERST Count and evaluate it, otherwise it returns to step 5. d. If the ERST Count is not equal to the value of the ERSTSZ register, then the xHC returns to step 4 to process events starting in the next segment of the ERST. e. If the ERST Count equals the value of the ERSTSZ register, then the xHC sets the ERST Count to ‘0’, toggles the Producer Cycle State (PCS) flag, and return to step 3 to process events starting in the first segment of the ERST.
以下步骤描述 xHC 的事件环入队指针（EREP）推进算法（图 4-12 左侧）： 4. ERST Base Address（ERSTBA）寄存器被初次写入时，事件环状态机进入 Start 状态。 5. xHC 把其内部 PCS 标志初始化为 ‘1’。 6. xHC 把其内部 ERST Count 置为 ‘0’。 7. 然后，xHC 取出事件环段表中被 ERST Count 引用的条目（ERSTE = ERST[ERST Count]），用 Ring Segment Base Address 字段（ERSTE.BaseAddr）的值初始化其入队指针（EREP），并用 Segment Size 字段（ERSTE.Size）的值初始化 TRB Count。 8. 若 USBCMD 的 Run/Stop（R/S）标志 = ‘0’，事件环状态机必须等待 Run/Stop（R/S）恢复为 ‘1’27。当 Run/Stop（R/S）标志 = ‘1’ 时，xHC 将继续检查是否有事件被投递（步骤 6.），否则立即进入步骤 6.。 9. 当有事件被投递给该环时，xHC 必须首先检查环是否已满。若未满，xHC 把 Event TRB 写入 EREP 所标识的位置，将 EREP 加 16，并将 TRB Count 减 1。Event TRB 的 Cycle bit 被置为 PCS 标志的值。若没有事件被投递，xHC 将返回步骤 5。 10. 只要 TRB Count 非零，xHC 就必须返回步骤 5，继续检查 Run/Stop（R/S）或新事件。 11. 当 TRB Count 达到 ‘0’ 时，xHC 必须把 ERST Count 加 1 并对其进行评估；否则返回步骤 5。 d. 如果 ERST Count 不等于 ERSTSZ 寄存器的值，则 xHC 返回步骤 4，从 ERST 的下一段开始处理事件。 e. 如果 ERST Count 等于 ERSTSZ 寄存器的值，则 xHC 把 ERST Count 置为 ‘0’，翻转生产者轮次状态（PCS）标志，并返回步骤 3，从 ERST 的第一段开始处理事件。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L1018-L1056（p166）
流程图 · 4.9.4 事件环满检查算法（Figure 4-12 右侧语义重建） · 依据 spec-49.txt L1071-L1113
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
The following steps describe the xHC algorithm for checking if the Event Ring is full (right side of Figure 4-12): 12. If the TRB Count is greater than ‘1’, then the xHC can simply add 16 to the EREP and compare it to the ERDP to determine whether the Event Ring is full. 13. If the TRB Count is equal to ‘1’, then the xHC shall check if the ERDP points to the first entry in the next segment. To obtain the base address for the next segment the xHC retrieves the ERST.BaseAddress entry for the ERST Count + 1 modulus the ERSTSZ. Then calculates the address of the next Event Ring segment (NSP). a. If the NSP does not equal the ERDP, then the Event Ring has room and the Event Ring Full Check exits. b. If the NSP equals the ERDP, then the Event Ring is full. The xHC stops processing the Transfer and Command Rings, writes an Event Ring Full Error Event to the EREP, advances the EREP and decrements the TRB Count. Refer to Step 2b note below. 14. If the TRB Count is not equal ‘0’, then there is room in the current segment for more events so go to step 6 and wait for the ERDP to advance. 15. If the TRB Count is equal ‘0’, then increment the ERST Count to advance the EREP to the next segment. a. If the ERST Count is not equal to the value of the ERSTSZ register, then the xHC goes to step 5 to initialize the state machine parameters for the next segment of the ERST. b. If the ERST Count equals the value of the ERSTSZ register, then advance the EREP to the first segment of the ERST by setting the ERST Count to ‘0’ and toggling the Producer Cycle State (PCS) flag, then go to step 5 to initialize the state machine parameters for the first segment of the ERST. 16. To initialize the state machine parameters, the xHC fetches the entry in the Event Ring Segment Table referenced by the ERST Count (ERSTE = ERST[ERST Count]) and initializes its Enqueue Pointer (EREP) with the value of the Ring Segment Base Address field (ERSTE.BaseAddr) and the TRB Count with the value of the Segment Size field (ERSTE.Size). Once the EREP has been advanced to the next segment go to step 6 and wait for the ERDP to advance. 17. The Event Ring will remain full until the next time that software writes the ERDP. When the ERDP is written, the xHC will determine if the new ERDP value has freed space on the Event Ring by returning to step 1).
以下步骤描述 xHC 检查事件环是否已满的算法（图 4-12 右侧）： 12. 如果 TRB Count 大于 ‘1’，则 xHC 只需把 EREP 加 16 并与 ERDP 比较，即可判定事件环是否已满。 13. 如果 TRB Count 等于 ‘1’，则 xHC 必须检查 ERDP 是否指向下一段的第一个条目。为获得下一段的基地址，xHC 取出 ERST Count + 1 对 ERSTSZ 取模（modulus）所对应的 ERST.BaseAddress 条目，然后计算下一个事件环段的地址（NSP）。 a. 如果 NSP 不等于 ERDP，则事件环尚有空间，事件环满检查（Event Ring Full Check）退出。 b. 如果 NSP 等于 ERDP，则事件环已满。xHC 停止处理传输环与命令环，向 EREP 写入一个 Event Ring Full Error 事件，推进 EREP 并把 TRB Count 减 1。参见下文步骤 2b 的注。 14. 如果 TRB Count 不等于 ‘0’，则当前段中还有空间容纳更多事件，因此转到步骤 6 并等待 ERDP 推进。 15. 如果 TRB Count 等于 ‘0’，则把 ERST Count 加 1，以把 EREP 推进到下一段。 a. 如果 ERST Count 不等于 ERSTSZ 寄存器的值，则 xHC 转到步骤 5，为 ERST 的下一段初始化状态机参数。 b. 如果 ERST Count 等于 ERSTSZ 寄存器的值，则通过把 ERST Count 置为 ‘0’ 并翻转生产者轮次状态（PCS）标志，把 EREP 推进到 ERST 的第一段，然后转到步骤 5，为 ERST 的第一段初始化状态机参数。 16. 为初始化状态机参数，xHC 取出事件环段表中被 ERST Count 引用的条目（ERSTE = ERST[ERST Count]），用 Ring Segment Base Address 字段（ERSTE.BaseAddr）的值初始化其入队指针（EREP），并用 Segment Size 字段（ERSTE.Size）的值初始化 TRB Count。EREP 被推进到下一段之后，转到步骤 6 并等待 ERDP 推进。 17. 事件环将保持已满状态，直到软件下一次写 ERDP。ERDP 被写入时，xHC 会通过回到步骤 1) 来判定新的 ERDP 值是否已在事件环上腾出空间。
—— evidence/spec-49.txt L1071-L1113（p167）

§4.10Host Controller TRB Handling 主机控制器 TRB 处理 R12 批 B · 巨节四卡+wf-transport 传输全链+补丁片 xh1002p

①大区导语 · 4 卡

4.10.1Transfer TRBs 传输 TRB 处理机制p170-p175

规范引文（机制主线）

A fully configured host controller can support 255 USB Devices, where each device can declare up to 31 endpoints. 30 of the endpoints may declare up to 64K Streams each. This means that approximately 500M Transfer Rings may exist for a single xHC. Of course, this is a worst case value; however the xHC architecture shall cope efficiently with reporting the completion status of hundreds, or possibly thousands, of Transfer Rings. Transfer Ring completions are queued on Event Rings as Transfer Event TRBs for the host. Refer to
一台完全配置的主机控制器可以支持 255 个 USB 设备，每个设备最多可声明 31 个端点，其中 30 个端点各自可以声明多达 64K 个流（Stream）。这意味着单个 xHC 可能存在约 500M 个传输环（Transfer Ring）。当然，这是最坏情况的数值；但 xHC 体系结构必须能够高效地应对报告成百上千、甚至数千个传输环完成状态的任务。传输环的完成状态会以传输事件 TRB（Transfer Event TRB）的形式为主机排队到事件环（Event Ring）上。关于传输事件 TRB 的更多信息参见第 4.11.3.1 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L4-L10（p170）
When the data transfer associated with a Transfer TRB is completed, the xHC will evaluate the completion status of the transfer and the Transfer TRB flags to determine whether to generate a Transfer Event TRB for the Transfer TRB. If upon transfer completion of a TRB the Interrupt On Completion (IOC) flag is set, the xHC shall generate a Transfer Event TRB. Note the generation of an Event TRB always generates an interrupt to the host. The Completion Code and Length fields of the Transfer Event TRB will reflect the completion status of the Transfer TRB that generated the event.
当与某个传输 TRB 相关联的数据传输完成时，xHC 会评估该传输的完成状态以及该传输 TRB 的各标志，以决定是否为该传输 TRB 生成一个传输事件 TRB。 若某个 TRB 的传输完成时其完成时中断（Interrupt On Completion，IOC）标志已置位，xHC 必须生成一个传输事件 TRB。注意，事件 TRB 的生成总是会向主机产生一次中断。该传输事件 TRB 的 Completion Code 与 Length 字段将反映生成该事件的传输 TRB 的完成状态。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L12-L19（p170）
The detection of a USB Short Packet (that is, the actual number of bytes received was less than the expected number of bytes defined by the Transfer TRB) during a transfer does not necessarily generate an Event. A Short Packet will trigger the generation of a Transfer Event TRB on the Event Ring if the Interrupt-on-Short (ISP) or Interrupt On Completion (IOC) flags are set in the TRB that the Short Packet was detected on. The Completion Code field of the Transfer Event shall be set to Short Packet. The Length field of the Transfer Event shall be set to the residual number of bytes not written to the Transfer TRBs’ data buffer. A Short Packet may occur on an intermediate TRB of a TD. In this case the xHC shall advance to the first TRB of the next TD after completing the transfer.
在传输过程中检测到 USB 短包（Short Packet，即实际接收到的字节数少于传输 TRB 所定义的期望字节数）并不一定会生成事件。若在检测到短包的那个 TRB 中短包中断（Interrupt-on-Short，ISP）标志或完成时中断（IOC）标志已置位，短包将触发在事件环上生成一个传输事件 TRB。该传输事件的完成码（Completion Code）字段必须置为 Short Packet。该传输事件的 Length 字段必须置为未写入传输 TRB 数据缓冲区的残余字节数。短包可能发生在某个 TD 的中间 TRB 上；此时 xHC 必须在完成该传输之后前进到下一个 TD 的第一个 TRB。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L26-L36（p171）
Note: The xHC shall execute the first Event Data TRB encountered while advancing to the end of the Short Packet TD.
注：xHC 在前进到短包 TD 末尾的过程中，必须执行遇到的第一个事件数据 TRB（Event Data TRB）。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L37-L38（p171）
The detection of an error during a transfer shall always generate a Transfer Event, irrespective of whether the Interrupt-on-Short or Interrupt On Completion (IOC) flags are set in the Transfer TRB. The Completion Code of the Transfer Event shall identify the detected error condition. If a Missed Service Error occurs on an intermediate TRB of a TD of an Isoch endpoint the xHC shall advance to the first TRB of the next TD or the Enqueue Pointer (that is, Cycle bit transition), whichever is encountered first, when continuing execution on the Transfer Ring. When an error condition is encountered which requires an endpoint to halt; the xHC shall stop on the TRB in error, the endpoint shall be halted, and software shall use a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command to advance the Transfer Ring to the next TD.
在传输过程中检测到错误时必须总是生成一个传输事件，无论该传输 TRB 中是否设置了 Interrupt-on-Short 或完成时中断（IOC）标志。该传输事件的完成码必须标识检测到的错误条件。若等时（Isoch）端点的某个 TD 的中间 TRB 上发生 Missed Service Error，xHC 在该传输环上继续执行时必须前进到下一个 TD 的第一个 TRB 或入队指针（Enqueue Pointer，即 cycle bit（轮次）翻转处），以先遇到者为准。当遇到要求端点 halt（停机）的错误条件时：xHC 必须停在出错的 TRB 上，端点必须被 halt，软件必须使用 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令把传输环前进到下一个 TD。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L39-L49（p171）
Note: If the xHC encounters a Cycle bit transition and is unable to advance to a TD boundary when it encounters an error, it shall advance to the next TD boundary the next time the doorbell is rung. The only exception is if a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command is issued before the doorbell is rung, modifying the Dequeue Pointer. In this case the xHC shall assume that the modified Dequeue Pointer references the first TRB of a TD.
注：若 xHC 在遇到错误时碰到 cycle bit 翻转且无法前进到 TD 边界，则它必须在下次门铃被振铃时前进到下一个 TD 边界。唯一的例外是：在门铃振铃之前发出了修改出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）的 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令；此时 xHC 必须假定修改后的出队指针引用的是某个 TD 的第一个 TRB。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L50-L55（p171）
A Transfer Event TRB identifies the location of the TRB that “generated the event” (the Device ID, Endpoint ID, and address of the source TRB). The Completion Code field of the Transfer Event TRB shall contain the originating TRBs’ completion status. The location information in the Transfer Event TRB allows system software to identify the device, endpoint, and TRB that generated the event. The location information also allows the host to update its copy of the Dequeue Pointer for the Transfer Ring that generated the event. If interrupts to the host are enabled, Interrupt Moderation (refer to section 4.17) is used to gracefully manage bursts of Transfer Events.
传输事件 TRB 标识“生成该事件”的那个 TRB 的位置（即 Device ID、Endpoint ID 与源 TRB 的地址）。该传输事件 TRB 的完成码字段必须包含发起 TRB 的完成状态。传输事件 TRB 中的位置信息使系统软件能够识别生成该事件的设备、端点与 TRB；该位置信息还使主机能够更新其保存的、生成该事件的传输环的出队指针副本。 若发往主机的中断已启用，则使用中断调节（Interrupt Moderation，参见第 4.17 节）来平稳地管理传输事件的突发（burst）。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L56-L64（p171）
A host controller implementation may delay the generation of Events associated with Transfer TRBs. The following conditions should force Transfer Event generation to take place immediately: • The completion of a TRB that has its IOC flag set. • The completion of a Short Packet on a TRB that has its ISP flag set. • An error occurs on any Transfer TRB.
主机控制器实现可以延迟生成与传输 TRB 相关联的事件。下列条件建议强制传输事件立即生成： - 设置了 IOC 标志的 TRB 完成。 - 在设置了 ISP 标志的 TRB 上短包完成。 - 任何传输 TRB 上发生错误。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L65-L73（p171）
• An xHC implementation dependent threshold, designed to prevent the TRB Ring state from getting too far behind, is reached.
- 达到了旨在防止 TRB 环状态落后过远的 xHC 实现相关阈值。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L80-L82（p172）
Note: The TRB Pointer field in a Transfer Event TRBs not only references the TRB that generated the event, but it also provides system software with the latest value of the xHC Dequeue Pointer for the Transfer Ring. Software may choose to use Event Data TRBs exclusively to report TD completions (for example, never setting an IOC flag in the Transfer TRBs of TDs). However, to keep the software copy of the Transfer Ring Dequeue Pointer current, software will occasionally have to set the IOC flag in a Transfer TRB, except if an Event Data TRB is declared. The frequency with which the IOC flag is set in Transfer TRBs will depend on many system and software factors, that are outside the scope of this specification.
注：传输事件 TRB 中的 TRB Pointer 字段不仅引用生成该事件的 TRB，还向系统软件提供该传输环的 xHC 出队指针的最新值。软件可以选择只使用事件数据 TRB 来报告 TD 完成（例如从不在 TD 的传输 TRB 中设置 IOC 标志）。然而，为保持软件侧传输环出队指针副本为最新，软件仍需偶尔在某个传输 TRB 中设置 IOC 标志——除非已声明使用事件数据 TRB。在传输 TRB 中设置 IOC 标志的频率取决于许多系统与软件因素，这超出本规范的范围。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L83-L92（p172）
Note: System software should not generate unnecessary Events. Typically, there is no need to set the IOC flag in more than one Transfer TRB per TD. The only exceptions would be for 1) very large TDs (for example, > 16MB transfers) where Intermediate Event Data TRBs are declared, or 2) if the IOC flag is set to refresh the software Dequeue Pointer value.
注：系统软件建议不要生成不必要的事件。通常，每个 TD 无需在多于一个传输 TRB 中设置 IOC 标志。仅有的例外情形是：1) 声明了中间事件数据 TRB 的超大 TD（例如 > 16MB 的传输）；或 2) 为刷新软件侧出队指针值而设置 IOC 标志。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L93-L97（p172）
Note: An Event Lost Error shall be generated for the endpoint if the xHC is unable to generate all the Events defined by a TD. An Event Lost Error shall halt the endpoint. By following the recommendations in the notes above, this condition may be avoided. The conditions that generate this error are xHC implementation specific.
注：若 xHC 无法生成某个 TD 所定义的全部事件，则必须为该端点生成 Event Lost Error。Event Lost Error 必须 halt 该端点。遵循上述各注中的建议可以避免该情形。生成此错误的具体条件由 xHC 实现决定。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L98-L102（p172）
The TD Transfer Size is defined by the sum of the Length fields in all TRBs that comprise the TD. On an IN endpoint the xHC shall schedule ((TD Transfer Size - 1) / Max Packet Size) + 1 USB packets for each TD. If the TD Transfer Size is larger than Max Packet Size, all USB packets shall be Max Packet Size except for the last packet, which shall be sized to contain the remaining TD data. A Short Packet condition shall occur if the number of bytes received for a USB packet associated with a TD is less than the number of bytes expected.
TD Transfer Size 由组成该 TD 的所有 TRB 的 Length 字段之和定义。在 IN 端点上，xHC 必须为每个 TD 调度 ((TD Transfer Size - 1) / Max Packet Size) + 1 个 USB 包。 若 TD Transfer Size 大于 Max Packet Size，则除最后一个包之外的所有 USB 包都必须为 Max Packet Size 大小，最后一个包的大小应恰好容纳 TD 的剩余数据。 若与某个 TD 相关联的一个 USB 包实际接收到的字节数少于期望的字节数，则必须发生短包条件。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L105-L112（p172）
Software shall perform the following operations when using Event Data TRBs to flag the completion of a TD that may receive a Short Packet, then: • The ISP and IOC flags shall be cleared (‘0’) in all Transfer TRBs. • The IOC shall be set (‘1’) in all Event Data TRB(s).
当使用事件数据 TRB 来标记某个可能收到短包的 TD 的完成时，软件必须执行以下操作： - 所有传输 TRB 中的 ISP 与 IOC 标志必须清零（‘0’）。 - 所有事件数据 TRB 中的 IOC 必须置位（‘1’）。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L155-L160（p173）
If a Short Packet occurs and the PAE flag is set (‘1’), then all subsequent Event Data Transfer TRBs encountered while advancing to the end of the TD shall generate an Event Data Transfer Event with its Completion Code = Short Packet and should set the TRB Transfer Length field equal to the number of bytes transferred since the beginning of the TD or the previous Event Data Transfer TRB of the TD. If a Short Packet occurs and the PAE flag is cleared (‘0’), then subsequent Event Data Transfer TRBs encountered while advancing to the end of the TD shall not generate Event Data Transfer Events. If a Short Packet does not occur, then the last Event Data Transfer TRB shall generate an Event Data Transfer Event with its Completion Code = Success (assuming no errors) and TRB Transfer Length field equal to the number of bytes transferred since the beginning of the TD (that is, EDTLA) or the previous
若发生短包且 PAE 标志置位（‘1’），则在前进到该 TD 末尾的过程中遇到的所有后续事件数据传输 TRB 都必须生成事件数据传输事件，其完成码 = Short Packet，且建议其 TRB Transfer Length 字段等于自该 TD 起始处或该 TD 上一个事件数据传输 TRB 以来已传输的字节数。若发生短包且 PAE 标志清零（‘0’），则在前进到该 TD 末尾的过程中遇到的后续事件数据传输 TRB 不得生成事件数据传输事件。 若未发生短包，则最后一个事件数据传输 TRB 必须生成一个事件数据传输事件，其完成码 = Success（假定无错误），且 TRB Transfer Length 字段等于自该 TD 起始处（即 EDTLA）或该 TD 上一个事件数据传输 TRB 以来已传输的字节数。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L166-L177（p173）
Event Data Transfer TRB of the TD. Refer to section 4.11.5.2 for more information on Event Data TRB usage.
若未发生短包，则最后一个事件数据传输 TRB 必须生成一个事件数据传输事件，其完成码 = Success（假定无错误），且 TRB Transfer Length 字段等于自该 TD 起始处（即 EDTLA）或该 TD 上一个事件数据传输 TRB 以来已传输的字节数。关于事件数据 TRB 用法的更多信息参见第 4.11.5.2 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L184-L185（p174）
• If a TD on an IN endpoint is terminated with an Event Data TRB, there is no need to set the ISP flag in every TRB of the TD because the length of the transfer (including the terminating Short Packet) shall be reported by the TRB Transfer Length field of the Event Data TRB. • Software shall not interpret a Short Packet Event Data Transfer Event as indicating that the TD that it is associated with is “complete”, unless the Event Data Transfer Event is the last TRB of the TD.
- 若 IN 端点上的某个 TD 以事件数据 TRB 结束，则无需在该 TD 的每个 TRB 中都设置 ISP 标志，因为传输的长度（包括终结性的短包）必须由该事件数据 TRB 的 TRB Transfer Length 字段报告。 - 软件不得把某个短包事件数据传输事件解读为表明其所关联的 TD 已经“完成”，除非该事件数据传输事件是该 TD 的最后一个 TRB。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L186-L194（p174）
If software is not using Event Data TRBs, but it wants to flag the completion of a TD that may receive a Short Packet, then: • The ISP flag shall be set (‘1’) in all Transfer TRBs of the TD except the last Transfer TRB and may be set in the last Transfer TRB, and • The IOC flag shall be set (‘1’) in the last Transfer TRB of the TD. If a Short Packet occurs, then a Transfer Event shall be generated with the Completion Code = Short Packet, its TRB Pointer field pointing to the Transfer TRB that the Short Packet occurred on, and its TRB Transfer Length field shall indicate the residue bytes in the buffer.
若软件不使用事件数据 TRB，但希望标记某个可能收到短包的 TD 的完成，则： - 该 TD 中除最后一个传输 TRB 之外的所有传输 TRB 都必须将 ISP 标志置位（‘1’），最后一个传输 TRB 中也可以置位；且 - 该 TD 的最后一个传输 TRB 的 IOC 标志必须置位（‘1’）。 若发生短包，则必须生成一个完成码 = Short Packet 的传输事件，其 TRB Pointer 字段指向发生短包的那个传输 TRB，且其 TRB Transfer Length 字段必须指明缓冲区中的残余字节数。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L196-L206（p174）
If a Short Packet does not occur, then the last TRB of the TD shall generate a Transfer Event with its Completion Code = Success (assuming there was no error), its TRB Pointer field pointing to the last Transfer TRB, and the TRB Transfer Length field shall equal 0. If the Short Packet occurred while processing a Transfer TRB with only an ISP flag set, then two events shall be generated for the transfer; one for the Transfer TRB that the Short Packet occurred on, and a second for the last TRB with the IOC flag set. Table 6-38 defines the Completion Code and TRB Transfer Length for the first event. In the second event, the Completion Code shall be set to Short Packet, and the TRB Transfer Length should be set to the same value that was reported by the initial Short Packet Event.
若未发生短包，则该 TD 的最后一个 TRB 必须生成一个传输事件，其完成码 = Success（假定没有错误），其 TRB Pointer 字段指向最后一个传输 TRB，且 TRB Transfer Length 字段必须等于 0。 若短包发生在处理某个仅设置了 ISP 标志的传输 TRB 期间，则必须为该传输生成两个事件：一个针对发生短包的那个传输 TRB，第二个针对设置了 IOC 标志的最后一个 TRB。表 6-38 定义了第一个事件的完成码与 TRB Transfer Length。在第二个事件中，完成码必须置为 Short Packet，且 TRB Transfer Length 建议置为与最初短包事件（Short Packet Event）所报告值相同的值。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L207-L217（p174）
Software shall not interpret a Short Packet Event as indicating that the TD that it is associated with is “complete”, unless the TRB Pointer field of the Transfer Event references the last TRB of the TD. If Event Data TRBs are not used, then the total number of received bytes for a Short Packet TD is the sum of the TRB Transfer Length fields in all Transfer TRBs up to and including the one that generated the Short Packet Event, minus the residue value of the TRB Transfer Length field in the Short Packet Event.
软件不得把某个短包事件解读为表明其所关联的 TD 已经“完成”，除非该传输事件的 TRB Pointer 字段引用的是该 TD 的最后一个 TRB。 若未使用事件数据 TRB，则短包 TD 的总接收字节数 = 所有传输 TRB（直到并包括生成短包事件的那个 TRB）的 TRB Transfer Length 字段之和，减去短包事件中 TRB Transfer Length 字段的残余值。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L218-L224（p174）
Note: Typically, an IOC flag is only set in the last TRB of a TD, and the event that is generated by the TRB is referred to as the "TD Completion Event", that is, the Event that completes the TD. Also note that due to errors or Short Packet conditions, the TD Completion Event may not occur on the last TRB of a TD. And for Transfer Ring management or other reasons, software may set the IOC flag in any TRB of a TD, including a TD that is configured to handle Short
注：通常，IOC 标志只在该 TD 的最后一个 TRB 中设置，由该 TRB 生成的事件称为“TD 完成事件（TD Completion Event）”，即完成该 TD 的事件。还要注意，由于错误或短包条件，TD 完成事件可能不发生在该 TD 的最后一个 TRB 上。而且出于传输环管理或其他原因，软件可以在 TD 的任何 TRB 中设置 IOC 标志，包括被配置为处理短包的 TD（即在一个或多个 TRB 中设置了 ISP 标志的 TD）。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L225-L231（p174）
Packets (that is, with the ISP flag set in one or more TRBs). Because of this the xHC must handle the generation of multiple Events for a single TD, and those events may occur before and after the "TD Completion Event".
而且出于传输环管理或其他原因，软件可以在 TD 的任何 TRB 中设置 IOC 标志，包括被配置为处理短包的 TD（即在一个或多个 TRB 中设置了 ISP 标志的 TD）。因此 xHC 必须处理为单个 TD 生成多个事件的情形，且这些事件可能发生在“TD 完成事件”之前或之后。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L237-L239（p175）
TD Completion Events are generated by few basic conditions: • If the IOC flag = ‘1’ and the TD completes successfully, then a Transfer Event shall be generated with its Completion Code = Success and TRB Transfer Length identifying the number bytes transferred. • If a Short Packet occurs and the ISP or IOC flags are set, then a Transfer Event shall be generated with set its Completion Code = Short Packet and TRB Transfer Length identifying the number bytes transferred. • If an error condition is detected while processing any TRB within a TD, an Event shall be forced for that TRB (irrespective of whether the IOC or ISP flags are set on the TRB) with the Condition Code indicating the error that occurred and the TRB Transfer Length indicating the number of bytes that were successfully transferred.
TD 完成事件由以下几个基本条件生成： - 若 IOC 标志 = ‘1’ 且该 TD 成功完成，则必须生成一个完成码 = Success、TRB Transfer Length 标明已传输字节数的传输事件。 - 若发生短包且 ISP 或 IOC 标志已置位，则必须生成一个完成码 = Short Packet、TRB Transfer Length 标明已传输字节数的传输事件。 - 若在处理某个 TD 内的任何 TRB 时检测到错误条件，则必须为该 TRB 强制生成一个事件（无论该 TRB 上是否设置了 IOC 或 ISP 标志），其 Condition Code 指示所发生的错误，TRB Transfer Length 指示已成功传输的字节数。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L241-L255（p175）
Events generated for a TD by TRBs encountered before the TD Completion Event shall set their Completion Code to Success. Where Data Transfer Events (ED = '0') shall set their TRB Transfer Length to 0 (since the TRB Transfer Length field represents the "residue" of a transfer and all the bytes the buffer referenced by the TRB were successfully moved), and Event Data Transfer Events (ED = '1') shall set their TRB Transfer Length to the current value of the EDTLA and then reset the EDTLA to zero.
在 TD 完成事件之前由所遇 TRB 为某个 TD 生成的事件必须把其完成码置为 Success。其中，数据传输事件（Data Transfer Event，ED = ‘0’）必须把其 TRB Transfer Length 置为 0（因为 TRB Transfer Length 字段表示一次传输的“残余量”，而该 TRB 所引用缓冲区的全部字节都已成功搬移），事件数据传输事件（ED = ‘1’）必须把其 TRB Transfer Length 置为 EDTLA 的当前值，然后把 EDTLA 复位为零。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L256-L262（p175）
After the TD Completion Event, if any subsequent Transfer TRBs are encountered with their IOC flag set while advancing to the end of the TD then those TRBs shall also generate an Event, where the Completion Code field shall return the same value as TD Completion Event and TRB Transfer Length field should return the same value as TD Completion Event. There are a couple of exceptions to this rule: • If the IOC flag is set in an Event Data TRB then an Event Data Transfer Event shall be generated only if PAE = '1'. • If the IOC flag is set in a Link TRB then the Transfer Event shall be generated with Completion Code = Success, and the TRB Transfer Count = 0. Note: Setting the IOC flag in a TRB always forces an Event for that TRB (whether a Short Packet condition occurs or not), therefore also setting the ISP flag in the same TRB is redundant (but allowed).
在 TD 完成事件之后，若在前进到该 TD 末尾的过程中遇到任何后续的、设置了 IOC 标志的传输 TRB，则这些 TRB 也必须生成事件，其中完成码字段必须返回与 TD 完成事件相同的值，TRB Transfer Length 字段建议返回与 TD 完成事件相同的值。此规则有以下几个例外： - 若 IOC 标志设置在某个事件数据 TRB 中，则仅当 PAE = ‘1’ 时才必须生成事件数据传输事件。 - 若 IOC 标志设置在某个 Link TRB 中，则必须生成完成码 = Success 且 TRB Transfer Count = 0 的传输事件。 注：在某个 TRB 中设置 IOC 标志总是强制为该 TRB 生成一个事件（无论是否发生短包条件），因此在同一 TRB 中再设置 ISP 标志是冗余的（但允许）。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L263-L278（p175）

drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c:2518-2587 · process_bulk_intr_td（短包记账与 TD 推进） · d9008e061539
2518/*


2519 * Process bulk and interrupt tds, update urb status and actual_length.


2520 */


2521static void process_bulk_intr_td(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, struct xhci_virt_ep *ep,


2522				 struct xhci_ring *ep_ring, struct xhci_td *td,


2523				 union xhci_trb *ep_trb, struct xhci_transfer_event *event)


2524{


2525	struct xhci_slot_ctx *slot_ctx;


2526	u32 trb_comp_code;


2527	u32 remaining, requested, ep_trb_len;


2528


2529	slot_ctx = xhci_get_slot_ctx(xhci, ep->vdev->out_ctx);


2530	trb_comp_code = GET_COMP_CODE(le32_to_cpu(event->transfer_len));


2531	remaining = EVENT_TRB_LEN(le32_to_cpu(event->transfer_len));


2532	ep_trb_len = TRB_LEN(le32_to_cpu(ep_trb->generic.field[2]));


2533	requested = td->urb->transfer_buffer_length;


2534


2535	switch (trb_comp_code) {


2536	case COMP_SUCCESS:


2537		ep->err_count = 0;


2538		/* handle success with untransferred data as short packet */


2539		if (ep_trb != td->end_trb || remaining) {


2540			xhci_warn(xhci, "WARN Successful completion on short TX\n");


2541			xhci_dbg(xhci, "ep %#x - asked for %d bytes, %d bytes untransferred\n",


2542				 td->urb->ep->desc.bEndpointAddress,


2543				 requested, remaining);


2544		}


2545		td->status = 0;


2546		break;


2547	case COMP_SHORT_PACKET:


2548		ep->err_count = 0;


2549		td->status = 0;


2550		break;


2551	case COMP_STOPPED_SHORT_PACKET:


2552		td->urb->actual_length = remaining;


2553		goto finish_td;


2554	case COMP_STOPPED_LENGTH_INVALID:


2555		/* stopped on ep trb with invalid length, exclude it */


2556		td->urb->actual_length = sum_trb_lengths(td, ep_trb);


2557		goto finish_td;


2558	case COMP_USB_TRANSACTION_ERROR:


2559		if (xhci->quirks & XHCI_NO_SOFT_RETRY ||


2560		    (ep->err_count++ > MAX_SOFT_RETRY) ||


2561		    le32_to_cpu(slot_ctx->tt_info) & TT_SLOT)


2562			break;


2563


2564		td->status = 0;


2565


2566		xhci_handle_halted_endpoint(xhci, ep, td, EP_SOFT_RESET);


2567		return;


2568	default:


2569		/* do nothing */


2570		break;


2571	}


2572


2573	if (ep_trb == td->end_trb)


2574		td->urb->actual_length = requested - remaining;


2575	else


2576		td->urb->actual_length =


2577			sum_trb_lengths(td, ep_trb) +


2578			ep_trb_len - remaining;


2579finish_td:


2580	if (remaining > requested) {


2581		xhci_warn(xhci, "bad transfer trb length %d in event trb\n",


2582			  remaining);


2583		td->urb->actual_length = 0;


2584	}


2585


2586	finish_td(xhci, ep, ep_ring, td, trb_comp_code);


2587}
