流程图 · 4.10.1.1.1 短包推进算法（Event Data TRB 形态） · 依据 spec-410.txt L114-L126 + L132-L148
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
When a Short Packet condition occurs and Event Data TRBs are being used, the xHC shall perform the following operations: • If the Interrupt-on Short Packet (ISP) or if the Interrupt On Completion (IOC) flag is set to ‘1’ in the TRB that the Short Packet condition occurred on, a Transfer Event shall be generated for that TRB with the Completion Code set to Short Packet. • Automatically advance the Dequeue Pointer for the Transfer Ring to the beginning of the next TD. When an Event Data TRB is encountered in the process of advancing the Dequeue Pointer from the Short Packet TRB to the beginning of the next
当发生短包条件且正在使用事件数据 TRB 时，xHC 必须执行以下操作： - 若在发生短包条件的那个 TRB 中，Interrupt-on Short Packet（ISP）标志或 Interrupt On Completion（IOC）标志被置为 ‘1’，则必须为该 TRB 生成一个传输事件，其完成码置为 Short Packet。 - 自动把传输环的出队指针前进到下一个 TD 的起始处。在把出队指针从短包 TRB 向前推进到下一个
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L114-L126（p172）
TD, the xHC shall parse the Event Data TRB, that is, if the IOC flag is set in the Event Data TRB, an Event Data Transfer Event shall be generated with the Completion Code set to Short Packet and the Length field set to the actual number of bytes received by the TD. ⎯ If subsequent Event Data TRBs are encountered in the process of advancing the Dequeue Pointer from the first Event Data TRB encountered to the beginning of the next TD, the xHC shall parse them if the Parse All Event Data (PAE) flag is set (‘1’), and shall not parse them if the PAE flag is cleared (‘0’). Refer to section 5.3.6 for more information on PAE. If a Link TRB is encountered, the xHC shall parse the Link TRB and if its IOC flag is set (‘1’), then a Transfer Event shall be generated with its Completion Code set to Success. All Link TRBs encountered in TD shall be parsed. If a Short Packet condition does not occur while receiving the data for a TD, the xHC shall parse all TRBs of the TD. that is, any TRB with its IOC flag shall generate a Transfer Event.
TD 的起始处的过程中，若遇到事件数据 TRB，xHC 必须解析该事件数据 TRB，即：若该事件数据 TRB 中 IOC 标志已置位，则必须生成一个事件数据传输事件（Event Data Transfer Event），其完成码置为 Short Packet，且 Length 字段置为该 TD 实际接收到的字节数。⎯ 若在把出队指针从第一个遇到的事件数据 TRB 向前推进到下一个 TD 起始处的过程中遇到后续的事件数据 TRB，则当解析全部事件数据（Parse All Event Data，PAE）标志置位（‘1’）时 xHC 必须解析它们，PAE 标志清零（‘0’）时则不解析。关于 PAE 的更多信息参见第 5.3.6 节。若遇到 Link TRB，xHC 必须解析该 Link TRB，且若其 IOC 标志置位（‘1’），则必须生成一个完成码置为 Success 的传输事件。TD 中遇到的所有 Link TRB 都必须被解析。 若在接收某个 TD 的数据期间未发生短包条件，xHC 必须解析该 TD 的全部 TRB，即任何设置了 IOC 标志的 TRB 都必须生成一个传输事件。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L132-L148（p173）

TD 结构与环侧推进规则在 4.9.1 环基础与传输描述符 与 4.9.2 传输环管理 卡——本卡聚焦完成评估、短包与 Event Data 双形态。

4.10.2Errors 错误族机制p175-p184

规范引文（机制主线）

The detection of an error during a USB transfer shall always generate a Transfer Event, irrespective of whether the Interrupt-on-Short Packet (ISP) or Interrupt On Completion (IOC) flags are set in the Transfer TRB. The Completion Code of the Transfer Event shall identify the detected error condition. An error may occur on any TRB of a TD.
在 USB 传输过程中检测到错误时，必须总是生成一个传输事件，无论该传输 TRB 中是否设置了短包中断（Interrupt-on-Short Packet，ISP）标志或完成时中断（Interrupt On Completion，IOC）标志。该传输事件的完成码（Completion Code）必须标识检测到的错误条件。错误可能发生在某个 TD 的任何 TRB 上。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L281-L285（p175）
All Transfer Ring error conditions force the state of the associated endpoint to Halted and require system software intervention to recover. Refer to section 4.11.2.2 for more information on Control Endpoint error handling.
所有传输环错误条件都会强制相关端点进入 Halted 状态，并需要系统软件干预才能恢复。 关于控制端点错误处理的更多信息参见第 4.11.2.2 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L292-L295（p176）
An isoch endpoint never halts because there is no handshake to report a halt condition. Errors are reported as a Completion Code associated with a TRB for an isochronous transfer, but an isoch pipe is not halted in an error case. If an error is detected, the xHC shall continue to process the data associated with the next ESIT of the transfer. Only limited error detection is possible because the protocol for isochronous transactions do not provide per-transaction handshakes. Refer to section 5.6.5 of the USB2 spec. There is no equivalent text in the USB3 spec, however Enhanced SuperSpeed isoch endpoints are treated the same way.
等时（Isoch）端点永远不会 halt，因为没有用于报告 halt 条件的握手。等时传输的错误以与某个 TRB 相关联的完成码形式报告，但发生错误时等时管道（isoch pipe）不会被 halt。若检测到错误，xHC 必须继续处理与该传输的下一个 ESIT 相关联的数据。由于等时事务的协议不提供逐事务握手，只能进行有限的错误检测。参见 USB2 规范第 5.6.5 节。USB3 规范中没有对应的文字，但增强超速（Enhanced SuperSpeed）等时端点按相同方式处理。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L296-L304（p176）
A STALL PID (USB2) or STALL LMP (USB3) may be returned by a USB function in response to an IN token or after the data phase of an OUT or in response to a PING transaction. The STALL PID indicates that a function is unable to transmit or receive data, or that a control pipe request is not supported. The state of a USB device after returning a STALL for any endpoint (except the Default Control Endpoint) is undefined. The host controller shall not return a STALL under any condition. When a STALL PID is received from a USB device by the xHC, it shall stop further activity on the associated Transfer Ring by removing it from its Pipe Schedule, set the associated Endpoint State (EP State) field to Halted, and generate a Transfer Event TRB with a Stall Error.
USB 功能（function）可以在响应 IN 令牌时、在 OUT 的数据阶段之后、或在响应 PING 事务时返回 STALL PID（USB2）或 STALL LMP（USB3）。STALL PID 表明该功能无法发送或接收数据，或者某个控制管道请求不受支持。USB 设备在为任何端点（默认控制端点（Default Control Endpoint）除外）返回 STALL（停滞）之后的状态是未定义的。主机控制器在任何条件下都不得返回 STALL。 当 xHC 从 USB 设备收到 STALL PID 时，它必须通过把相关传输环从其 Pipe Schedule（管道调度表）中移除来停止该传输环上的后续活动，把相关端点的 Endpoint State（EP State）字段置为 Halted，并生成一个带有 Stall Error 的传输事件 TRB。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L307-L317（p176）
Note: If a device responds to a SETUP packet with a STALL28 the endpoint shall generate a Stall Error for the Setup TRB and shall be halted.
注：若设备以 STALL28 响应 SETUP 包，该端点必须为 Setup TRB 生成 Stall Error，且必须被 halt。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L318-L319（p176）
A two-step process is required to recover a halted endpoint: 18. System software shall use a Reset Endpoint Command (section 4.11.4.7) to remove the Halted condition in the xHC. After the successful completion of the Reset Endpoint Command, the Endpoint Context is transitioned from the Halted to the Stopped state and the Transfer Ring of the endpoint is reenabled. The next write to the Doorbell of the Endpoint will transition the Endpoint Context from the Stopped to the Running state.
恢复一个被 halt 的端点需要一个两步过程： 18. 系统软件必须使用 Reset Endpoint 命令（复位端点命令，第 4.11.4.7 节）来清除 xHC 中的 Halted 状态。Reset Endpoint 命令成功完成后，端点上下文（Endpoint Context）从 Halted 状态迁移到 Stopped 状态，且该端点的传输环被重新启用。下一次对该端点门铃寄存器的写入将使端点上下文从 Stopped 状态迁移到 Running 状态。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L320-L327（p176）
Note: The Reset Endpoint Command for the endpoint shall complete successfully and the halt condition on the USB device shall be successfully cleared before attempting to restart the Transfer Ring by ringing its doorbell. 19. Software intervention is required to recover the pipe within the USB device.
注：在通过振铃其门铃来尝试重启传输环之前，该端点的 Reset Endpoint 命令必须已成功完成，且 USB 设备上的 halt 条件必须已成功清除。 19. 需要软件干预来恢复 USB 设备内的管道。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L341-L346（p177）
4.10.2.1.1 Non-Control Endpoints Removal of the halt condition on an interrupt or bulk pipe in a USB device is achieved via software intervention through a separate control pipe. Note: The software intervention required to remove the halt condition on the USB device shall be invoked after the pipe has been transitioned to the Stopped state by a successful Reset Endpoint Command, but before writing to the Doorbell register of the Endpoint to restart activity on the pipe. Note: Since an Isoch endpoint does not generate a transaction handshake, they cannot generate a Stall Error.
4.10.2.1.1 非控制端点（Non-Control Endpoints） 清除 USB 设备内中断或批量管道上的 halt 条件，需要软件通过一个单独的控制管道进行干预来实现。 注：清除 USB 设备上 halt 条件所需的软件干预，必须在管道已通过成功的 Reset Endpoint 命令迁移到 Stopped 状态之后、但在写入该端点的门铃寄存器以重启该管道上的活动之前进行。 注：由于等时端点不生成事务握手，它们无法生成 Stall Error。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L347-L355（p177）
4.10.2.1.2 Control Endpoints Removal of the halt condition on the Control endpoint of a USB device is achieved by the device accepting the next SETUP PID. For Control endpoints, a reset of the USB device shall be required to clear the halt or error condition if the device does not accept the next Setup PID. Refer to section 4.11.2.2 for additional Control Endpoint error handling.
4.10.2.1.2 控制端点（Control Endpoints） 清除 USB 设备控制端点上的 halt 条件，通过设备接受下一个 SETUP PID 来实现。 对于控制端点，若设备不接受下一个 Setup PID，则必须复位该 USB 设备才能清除 halt 或错误条件。 关于控制端点错误处理的更多信息参见第 4.11.2.2 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L356-L361（p177）
A TRB Error indicates the TRB field values are out of range or that the xHC has determined that a TRB is incorrectly formed. This error condition may be reported in a Transfer Event or a Command Completion Event due to an error detected on a Transfer or Command TRB, respectively. This error will not be reported in any other Event TRB types. Note: A Transfer Ring TRB Error should transition an endpoint to the Error state (refer to section 4.8.3), however an xHC implementation may assert HCE29 due to the detection of TRB Error related error conditions. It is the responsibility of software to always present correctly formed TRBs to the xHC.
TRB Error 表明 TRB 字段值超出范围，或 xHC 已判定某个 TRB 的构成不正确。 该错误条件可能分别在传输事件或命令完成事件（Command Completion Event）中报告，对应于分别在传输 TRB 或命令 TRB 上检测到的错误。此错误不会在任何其他类型的事件 TRB 中报告。 注：传输环上的 TRB Error 建议使端点迁移到 Error 状态（参见第 4.8.3 节），但 xHC 实现也可能因检测到 TRB Error 相关的错误条件而置位 HCE29。始终向 xHC 提供构成正确的 TRB 是软件的责任。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L364-L372（p177）
A transaction error is any error that causes the host controller to not complete a transfer successfully. Table 4-5 lists the events/responses that the xHC can observe as a result of a transaction. The effects of the Bus Error Counter and interrupt status are summarized in the following paragraphs. Most of these errors set the USB Transaction Error Completion Code in the appropriate Transfer Event TRB. There is a small set of protocol errors that relate only when executing a Setup Stage TRB and fit under the umbrella of a Bad PID error that are significant to explicitly identify. When these errors occur, the Bus Error Counter (4.10.2.7) is decremented. When the USB PID Code30 indicates a SETUP, the following responses are protocol errors and shall result in a USB Transaction Error if not resolved after CErr retries. • A high-speed device and returns a NAK handshake to a SETUP. • A high-speed device and returns a NYET handshake to a SETUP. • A low- or full-speed device complete-split receives a NAK handshake. • An Enhanced SuperSpeed device responds to a SETUP DP with an NRDY TP.
事务错误（transaction error）是任何导致主机控制器无法成功完成传输的错误。表 4-5 列出了 xHC 作为一次事务的结果能观察到的事件/响应。总线错误计数器（Bus Error Counter）与中断状态的影响在以下各段中汇总。这些错误中的大多数会在相应的传输事件 TRB 中置 USB Transaction Error 完成码。 有一小类协议错误只在执行 Setup Stage TRB 时才会出现，它们都归入 Bad PID 错误的范畴，值得显式识别。发生这些错误时，总线错误计数器（第 4.10.2.7 节）被递减。当 USB PID Code30 指示为 SETUP 时，下列响应属于协议错误，若在 CErr 次重试后仍未解决，则必须导致 USB Transaction Error。 - 高速设备对 SETUP 返回 NAK 握手。 - 高速设备对 SETUP 返回 NYET 握手。 - 低速或全速设备的 complete-split（完成拆分）收到 NAK 握手。 - 增强超速设备以 NRDY TP 响应 SETUP DP。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L386-L405（p178）
Table 4-5: Summary of USB Transaction Errors
Event / ResultError TriesTRB Error Status
USB2 CRC or USB3 DPP Error31CErrUSB Transaction32
TimeoutCErr (USB2), N/A (USB3)33USB Transaction32
USB2 Bad PID34CErrUSB Transaction32
BabbleN/ABabble Detected Error
Buffer ErrorN/AData Buffer Error
31Refer to Section 1.6 for the definition of a DPP Error. Note that the xHCI definition is slightly different than the definition of DPP Error in the USB3 spec because it includes the case where an ACK TP is received for a DPP with the Retry Data Packet (rty) bit set,
32If error occurs on a USB transaction, then a USB Transaction Error (XactErr) is asserted immediately on an Isoch pipe or after CErr unsuccessful attempts on all other pipe types. In addition, non-Isoch Transfer Ring shall be halted, refer to section 4.10.2.1.
33Section 8.13 of the USB3 spec states that if a tHostTransactionTimeout occurs, for control, bulk, and Interrupt transactions the host shall assume that the transaction has failed and halt the endpoint. For Isoch transactions the host shall not perform any more transactions to the endpoint in the current Service Interval. And the host shall not halt the endpoint and shall restart transactions to the endpoint in the next Service Interval. No retries are performed for any transaction type if a tHostTransactionTimeout occurs.
34The xHC received a response from the device, but it could not recognize the PID as a valid PID. Not applicable to USB3.
Note: No retries shall be performed if the xHC does not see a response to a Data Transaction (either IN or OUT) within tHostTransactionTimeout on a SuperSpeed or SuperSpeedPlus pipe. The endpoint shall transition to Halted state when this condition is detected. Note: The USB3 spec defines a range of possible tHostTransactionTimeout values. The specific value applied by an xHC implementation may be hardcoded by an xHC vendor or programmable through a vendor defined mechanism, for example, a Vendor Defined xHCI Extended Capability.
注：在超速（SuperSpeed）或 SuperSpeedPlus 管道上，若 xHC 在 tHostTransactionTimeout 内未看到对数据事务（IN 或 OUT）的响应，则不得执行重试。检测到该条件时，端点必须迁移到 Halted 状态。 注：USB3 规范定义了 tHostTransactionTimeout 的可能取值范围。 xHC 实现所采用的具体取值可以由 xHC 厂商硬编码，也可以通过厂商自定义机制（例如厂商自定义 xHCI 扩展能力（Vendor Defined xHCI Extended Capability））使之可编程。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L446-L453（p179）
When a device transmits more data on the USB than the host controller is expecting for a transaction, it is defined to be babbling. In general, this is called a Babble Error35. When a device sends more data than the TD Transfer Size bytes (TD Babble), unexpected activity that persists beyond a specified point in a (micro)frame (Frame Babble), or a packet greater than Max Packet Size (Packet Babble), the host controller shall set the Babble Detected Error in the Completion Code field of the TRB, generate an Error Event, and halt the endpoint (refer to Section 4.10.2.1). The Bus Error Counter is not decremented for a Babble Error condition.
当设备在 USB 上传输的数据多于主机控制器对某个事务所期望的量时，即定义为 babbling（babble 态）。通常，这称为 Babble Error35。当设备发送的数据多于 TD Transfer Size 字节（TD Babble）、（微）帧中超出指定点之后仍持续出现意外活动（Frame Babble）、或包大于 Max Packet Size（Packet Babble）时，主机控制器必须把该 TRB 的完成码字段置为 Babble Detected Error，生成一个错误事件（Error Event），并 halt 该端点（参见第 4.10.2.1 节）。对 Babble Error 条件，总线错误计数器不递减。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L456-L464（p179）
Note: When Babble Detected Error is generated, software shall assume that any excess received data has been lost and not attempt a Soft Retry. Note: If a Babble Error is detected and the received data passes all integrity checks, the host controller may write the received data (up to the expected data length) to the data buffer, and the value of the TRB Transfer Length field in the Babble Detected Error Transfer Event shall be consistent with the number of data bytes written to the buffer.
注：生成 Babble Detected Error 时，软件必须假定任何多收到的数据均已丢失，且不得尝试软重试（Soft Retry）。 注：若检测到 Babble Error 且接收到的数据通过全部完整性检查，主机控制器可以把接收到的数据（最多到期望数据长度）写入数据缓冲区，且 Babble Detected Error 传输事件中 TRB Transfer Length 字段的值应与写入缓冲区的数据字节数一致。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L468-L474（p179）
A babble condition also exists if IN transaction is in progress at High-speed EOF2 point. This is called a Frame Babble. If a Frame Babble condition is detected while a TRB is being processed the xHC shall set the Babble Detected Error in the Completion Code field of the TRB, generate an Error Event, and halt the endpoint. In addition, the xHC shall disable the Root Hub port to which the Frame Babble is detected. The xHC shall never start an OUT transaction that will babble across a microframe EOF.
若 IN 事务进行到高速 EOF2 点时仍在进行中，同样存在 babble 条件，这称为 Frame Babble（帧 babble）。若在处理某个 TRB 期间检测到 Frame Babble 条件，xHC 必须把该 TRB 的完成码字段置为 Babble Detected Error，生成一个错误事件，并 halt 该端点。此外，xHC 必须禁用检测到 Frame Babble 的那个根集线器端口。xHC 绝不能发起会跨越微帧 EOF 持续 babble 的 OUT 事务。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L476-L482（p179）
Note: Frame Babble is also a Port_Error condition which shall transition a port in the Enabled state to the Disabled state, assert the PEC flag (‘1’), and generate a Port Status Change Event. Refer to section 4.19.1.1.6.
注：Frame Babble 也是 Port_Error 条件，它必须把处于 Enabled 状态的端口迁移到 Disabled 状态、把 PEC 标志置位（‘1’），并生成一个端口状态改变事件（Port Status Change Event）。参见第 4.19.1.1.6 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L496-L499（p180）
4.10.2.4.2 USB3 Protocol A babble condition also exists if on an IN transaction the DPP exceeds the Max Packet Size. If a babble condition is detected the xHC shall set the Babble Detected Error in the Completion Code field of the TRB, generate an Error Event, and halt the endpoint.
4.10.2.4.2 USB3 协议（USB3 Protocol） 若在 IN 事务中 DPP 超出 Max Packet Size，同样存在 babble 条件。若检测到 babble 条件，xHC 必须把该 TRB 的完成码字段置为 Babble Detected Error，生成一个错误事件，并 halt 该端点。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L516-L520（p180）
This event indicates that an overrun of incoming data or an underrun of outgoing data has occurred for this Transfer TRB. This would generally be caused by the host controller not being able to access required data buffers in memory within necessary latency requirements. These conditions are not considered transaction errors, and do not affect the Bus Error Count. When these errors do occur, a Transfer Event TRB will be generated (pointing to the TRB that the error was detected on) with the Completion Status set to Data Buffer Error.
此事件表明该传输 TRB 发生了入向数据溢出（overrun）或出向数据欠载（underrun）。这通常由主机控制器无法在必要的时延要求内访问内存中所需的数据缓冲区引起。这些条件不算事务错误，也不影响总线错误计数。当这些错误确实发生时，会生成一个传输事件 TRB（指向检测到错误的 TRB），其完成状态置为 Data Buffer Error。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L523-L530（p180）
If the Data Buffer Error occurs on a non-isochronous IN, the host controller shall not issue a handshake to the endpoint. This will force the endpoint to resend the same data (and data toggle) in response to the next IN to the endpoint. If the Data Buffer Error occurs on an OUT, the host controller shall corrupt the end of the packet so that it cannot be interpreted by the device as a good data packet. Simply truncating the packet is not considered acceptable. An acceptable implementation option is to 1's complement the CRC bytes and send
若 Data Buffer Error 发生在非等时 IN 上，主机控制器不得向该端点发出握手。这将迫使该端点在下一个针对它的 IN 事务中重发相同的数据（及数据翻转位）。 若 Data Buffer Error 发生在 OUT 上，主机控制器必须破坏包的末尾，使设备无法把它解读为良好的数据包。仅简单地截断包被认为不可接受。一种可接受的实现选项是对 CRC 字节取 1 的补码（按位取反）后发送。USB2 规范的事务翻译器（Transaction Translator）一节还建议了其他选项。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L531-L539（p180）
them. There are other options suggested in the Transaction Translator section of the USB2 spec.
一种可接受的实现选项是对 CRC 字节取 1 的补码（按位取反）后发送。USB2 规范的事务翻译器（Transaction Translator）一节还建议了其他选项。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L545-L546（p181）
This error condition shall only be reported in a Transfer Event due to an error detected on a Transfer TRB. This error will not be reported in any other Event TRB types. Note: A Data Buffer Error may be generated for a USB2 or USB3 transfer.
该错误条件只能在因传输 TRB 上检测到错误而生成的传输事件中报告。此错误不会在任何其他类型的事件 TRB 中报告。 注：USB2 或 USB3 传输都可能产生 Data Buffer Error。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L547-L550（p181）
Interrupts are used by xHCI to report Events generated by the controller. The reporting requires that the xHC hardware that manages the Event Ring, and the host system hardware that the xHCI is communicating over, is operating properly. If a catastrophic system error occurs, it may prevent the xHC from properly completing a TRB in the Event Ring. This means that software could receive an interrupt with an inconsistent Event Ring. If in the process of normal Event TRB processing software suspects a problem, it may examine the Host System Error (HSE) bit in the USBSTS register to determine whether the problem was due to a host controller related catastrophic fault condition. If a catastrophic error occurs during a host system access involving the Host Controller module the Host System Error (HSE) bit in the USBSTS register shall be set to ‘1’. (In a PCI system, conditions that set this bit to ‘1’ include PCI Parity error, PCI Master Abort, and PCI Target Abort.) When this error occurs, the Host Controller shall clear the Run/Stop (R/S) bit in the USBCMD register to prevent further execution of the scheduled TDs.
xHCI 使用中断来报告控制器生成的事件。该报告机制要求管理事件环的 xHC 硬件以及 xHCI 通信所经由的主机系统硬件都正常运行。 若发生灾难性的系统错误，可能使 xHC 无法正确完成事件环中的某个 TRB。这意味着软件收到中断时事件环可能处于不一致状态。若软件在正常的事件 TRB 处理过程中怀疑有问题，它可以检查 USBSTS 寄存器中的 Host System Error（HSE，主机系统错误）位，以确定该问题是否由与主机控制器相关的灾难性故障条件引起。 若在涉及主机控制器模块的主机系统访问期间发生灾难性错误，USBSTS 寄存器中的 Host System Error（HSE）位必须被置为 ‘1’。（在 PCI 系统中，把该位置为 ‘1’ 的条件包括 PCI 奇偶错误（PCI Parity error）、PCI 主设备中止（PCI Master Abort）与 PCI 目标设备中止（PCI Target Abort）。）发生此错误时，主机控制器必须清零 USBCMD 寄存器中的 Run/Stop（R/S）位，以阻止继续执行已调度的 TD。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L553-L568（p181）
The following conditions shall indicate an Event TRB problem: • System software receives an xHC interrupt and a Valid Transfer Event TRB does not point to a Valid source TRB. • System software receives an xHC interrupt and a Valid Transfer Event TRB does not identify an enabled Device Slot. • System software receives an xHC interrupt and a Valid Transfer Event TRB does not identify to an enabled endpoint. • Out of range, incomplete, or inconsistent Event TRB field values. It is recommended that system software check for these conditions.
以下情况表明存在事件 TRB 问题： - 系统软件收到 xHC 中断，而某个有效的传输事件 TRB 未指向有效的源 TRB。 - 系统软件收到 xHC 中断，而某个有效的传输事件 TRB 未标识一个已启用的设备槽位（Device Slot）。 - 系统软件收到 xHC 中断，而某个有效的传输事件 TRB 未标识一个已启用的端点。 - 事件 TRB 字段值超出范围、不完整或不一致。 建议系统软件检查这些条件。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L569-L581（p181）
Host System Error (HSE) may optionally be used to report other internal xHC errors that might jeopardize system level operation or data integrity. It should be assumed, however, that the assertion of HSE should generate a critical system interrupt (for example, NMI or Machine Check) and is, therefore, fatal. Consequently, care should be taken in using HSE to report non-parity or system errors. Both the xHC and software shall assume that system integrity has been compromised when HSE is asserted. Note: Host Controller Error (HCE) should be used to report internal xHC error conditions which may be recovered from by software resetting and reinitialization of the xHC. Refer to section 4.24.1.
Host System Error（HSE）也可以选择性地用于报告其他可能危及系统级操作或数据完整性的 xHC 内部错误。但应当假定 HSE 的置位会产生一个关键系统中断（例如 NMI 或机器检查（Machine Check）），因而是致命的。因此，在用 HSE 报告非奇偶类或系统错误时应谨慎。当 HSE 置位时，xHC 与软件都必须假定系统完整性已被破坏。 注：Host Controller Error（HCE，主机控制器错误）建议用于报告可通过软件复位并重新初始化 xHC 来恢复的 xHC 内部错误条件。参见第 4.24.1 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L597-L606（p182）
The Bus Error Counter is an internal 2-bit down counter that the xHC maintains. This counter determines the number of consecutive Errors allowed while executing a USB Transaction. Section 4.10.2.3 describes how when CErr bus errors are encountered on any packet of a TD, the TD is aborted, the endpoint is Halted and an Error Event will be generated. The xHC is expected to maintain an internal Bus Error Counter for each endpoint, which allows retries and differentiating “soft-errors” from “hard-errors”. The xHC initializes this internal Bus Error Counter to the value defined by the Endpoint Context Error Count (CErr) field on the first transmission of a packet and decrements it when an error is detected, if the Bus Error Counter reaches 0, then a hard-error is generated. If a packet transmission successfully
总线错误计数器（Bus Error Counter）是 xHC 维护的一个内部 2 位递减计数器。该计数器决定执行 USB 事务时允许的连续错误次数。 第 4.10.2.3 节描述了当某个 TD 的任何包上出现 CErr 次总线错误时，该 TD 被中止、端点被置为 Halted 并生成一个错误事件。期望 xHC 为每个端点维护一个内部总线错误计数器，以支持重试并区分“软错误（soft-error）”与“硬错误（hard-error）”。 xHC 在首次传输某个包时把该内部总线错误计数器初始化为端点上下文 Error Count（CErr）字段定义的值，并在检测到错误时递减它；若总线错误计数器到达 0，则产生硬错误。若包传输在总线错误计数器到达 0 之前成功完成，则视为成功，不会产生错误。

The xHC shall not reset the Bus Error Counter if the value at the start of the transaction is 00b.

若包传输在总线错误计数器到达 0 之前成功完成，则视为成功，不会产生错误。

Note: Software shall not program CErr to a value of ‘0’ when the Slot Context Speed field indicates a Full- or Low-speed device. This combination could result in undefined behavior.

989static int xhci_handle_halted_endpoint(struct xhci_hcd *xhci,


990				struct xhci_virt_ep *ep,


991				struct xhci_td *td,


992				enum xhci_ep_reset_type reset_type)


993{


994	struct xhci_port *rhub_port = ep->vdev->rhub_port;


995	unsigned int slot_id = ep->vdev->slot_id;


996	int err;


997


998	/*


999	 * Avoid resetting endpoint if link is inactive or device disconnected.


1000	 * Can cause host hang.


1001	 * Device will be reset to recover an inactive link, so don't do anything


1002	 */


1003	if (rhub_port->link_inactive || !rhub_port->connected) {


1004		ep->ep_state |= EP_DROP_PENDING;


1005		return -ENODEV;


1006	}


1007


1008	/* add td to cancelled list and let reset ep handler take care of it */


1009	if (reset_type == EP_HARD_RESET) {


1010		ep->ep_state |= EP_HARD_CLEAR_TOGGLE;


1011		if (td && list_empty(&td->cancelled_td_list)) {


1012			list_add_tail(&td->cancelled_td_list, &ep->cancelled_td_list);


1013			td->cancel_status = TD_HALTED;


1014		}


1015	}


1016


1017	if (ep->ep_state & EP_HALTED) {


1018		xhci_dbg(xhci, "Reset ep command for ep_index %d already pending\n",


1019			 ep->ep_index);


1020		return 0;


1021	}


1022


1023	err = xhci_reset_halted_ep(xhci, slot_id, ep->ep_index, reset_type);


1024	if (err)


1025		return err;


1026


1027	ep->ep_state |= EP_HALTED;


1028


1029	xhci_ring_cmd_db(xhci);


1030


1031	return 0;


1032}

流程图 · 4.10.2.8 Isoch 端点错误处理算法 · 依据 spec-410.txt L682-L700 + L707-L722
规范原文（本流程图依据 · 逐字机检）
CErr does not apply to Isoch Data Transactions because retries are not performed on Isoch endpoints. Also an Isoch endpoint shall not halt due to a Data Transaction error, but instead shall advance to the next Isoch TD and attempt to execute it during the next ESIT. An Isoch Data Transaction error shall force the generation of a Transfer Event, irrespective of whether the Interrupt-on-Short Packet (ISP) or Interrupt On Completion (IOC) flags are set in the Transfer TRB, where the Transfer Event’s: • TRB Pointer field shall point to the Transfer TRB that the error was detected on, and • TRB Transfer Length field shall indicate the residue of the number of bytes not successfully transferred. If a Timeout, USB2 CRC Error, USB3 DPP Error, or a USB2 Bad PID was detected on an Isoch IN Data Transaction, the Completion Code of the Transfer Event shall be set to USB Transaction Error. If a Babble condition was detected on an Isoch IN Data Transaction, the Completion Code of the Transfer Event shall be set to Babble Error. While advancing to the next Isoch TD:
CErr 不适用于等时数据事务（Isoch Data Transaction），因为等时端点上不执行重试。此外，等时端点不得因数据事务错误而 halt，而必须前进到下一个等时 TD 并尝试在下一个 ESIT 期间执行它。等时数据事务错误必须强制生成一个传输事件，无论该传输 TRB 中是否设置了短包中断（ISP）或完成时中断（IOC）标志，该传输事件的： - 其 TRB Pointer 字段必须指向检测到错误的那个传输 TRB；且 - 其 TRB Transfer Length 字段必须指明未成功传输字节数的残余量。 若在等时 IN 数据事务上检测到超时（Timeout）、USB2 CRC Error、USB3 DPP Error 或 USB2 Bad PID，该传输事件的完成码必须置为 USB Transaction Error。 若在等时 IN 数据事务上检测到 Babble 条件，该传输事件的完成码必须置为 Babble Error。 在前进到下一个等时 TD 的过程中：
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L682-L700（p183）
• If an Event Data TRB is encountered, the xHC shall parse it, that is, if the its IOC flag is set, an Event Data Transfer Event shall be generated with its Completion Code set to the same error value reported by the Transfer Event and TRB Transfer Length field set to the number of bytes successfully transferred. The first Event Data TRB encountered shall be parsed. If subsequent Event Data TRBs are encountered in the process of advancing to the next Isoch TD, the xHC shall parse them if the Parse All Event Data (PAE) flag is set ('1') and shall not parse them if the PAE flag is cleared ('0'). Refer to section 5.3.6 for more information on PAE. • If a Link Data TRB is encountered, the xHC shall parse the Link TRB, that is, if its IOC flag is set, a Transfer Event shall be generated with its Completion Code set to Success. All Link TRBs encountered shall be parsed.
- 若遇到事件数据 TRB，xHC 必须解析它，即：若其 IOC 标志已置位，则必须生成一个事件数据传输事件，其完成码置为该传输事件所报告的同一错误值，且其 TRB Transfer Length 字段置为已成功传输的字节数。遇到的第一个事件数据 TRB 必须被解析。若在前进到下一个等时 TD 的过程中遇到后续的事件数据 TRB，则当解析全部事件数据（PAE）标志置位（‘1’）时 xHC 必须解析它们，PAE 标志清零（‘0’）时则不解析。关于 PAE 的更多信息参见第 5.3.6 节。 - 若遇到 Link Data TRB，xHC 必须解析该 Link TRB，即：若其 IOC 标志已置位，则必须生成一个完成码置为 Success 的传输事件。遇到的所有 Link TRB 都必须被解析。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L707-L722（p184）

commit 3d9eeb336131bc5a174367c384fa00c15c8744fd
Author: Michal Pecio <michal.pecio@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Aug 6 17:21:13 2026 +0300

    usb: xhci: Handle bogus TRB pointers in Missed Service Error events
    
    xHCI 1.0 allowed these pointers to be zero. Some Intel chipsets from the
    era usually set it to zero, but sometimes (apparently) to the next TRB
    after the one referenced by the previous transfer event on the endpoint.
    
    Usually that's indeed the missed TD, but it may also be the last TRB of
    a two-TRB TD already completed with Short Packet on its first TRB. Then
    the driver skips all pending TDs, failing to find a match.
    
    When handling Missed Service Error, scan TD list twice and only really
    skip TDs in the second pass if the first pass found a match. This won't
    catch bogus pointers to wrong TDs, but such a bug would be practically
    impossible to detect automatically and isn't known to exist.

diff --git a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
index 69bd582c7e2b..97a1b53c18ef 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c
@@ -2597,6 +2597,17 @@ static bool xhci_spurious_success_tx_event(struct xhci_hcd *xhci,
 	}
 }
 
+static struct xhci_td *find_td_by_dma(struct xhci_ring *ep_ring, dma_addr_t dma)
+{
+	struct xhci_td *td;
+
+	if (dma)
+		list_for_each_entry(td, &ep_ring->td_list, td_list)
+			if (trb_in_td(td, dma))
+				return td;
+	return NULL;
+}
+
 /*
  * If this function returns an error condition, it means it got a Transfer
  * event with a corrupted Slot ID, Endpoint ID, or TRB DMA address.
@@ -2791,8 +2802,11 @@ static int handle_tx_event(struct xhci_hcd *xhci,
 		xhci_dequeue_td(xhci, td, ep_ring, td->status);
 	}
 
-	/* If the TRB pointer is NULL, missed TDs will be skipped on the next event */
-	if (trb_comp_code == COMP_MISSED_SERVICE_ERROR && !ep_trb_dma)
+	/*
+	 * We don't know how many TDs were missed when ep_trb_dma is zero (as permitted by
+	 * xHCI 1.0) or bogus. Bail out leaving ep->skip set, next event will sort it out.
+	 */
+	if (trb_comp_code == COMP_MISSED_SERVICE_ERROR && !find_td_by_dma(ep_ring, ep_trb_dma))
 		return 0;
 
 	if (list_empty(&ep_ring->td_list)) {

背景（何时 / 谁修 / 为什么是它）

2026 年 8 月，Michal Pecio 提交、Bart Nagel 报告。背景=MSE（Missed Service Error）事件的 TRB Pointer 语义：§4.10.3.2 p186 规定它指向被跳过的 TRB、但「may not reference a TRB that has its IOC flag set」——指针可以不指 IOC TRB；而 xHCI 1.0 （§4.10.3.1 p184 pre-1.1 Note 的镜像面）干脆允许零指针。message 原文实锤 Intel 时代芯片组行为："usually set it to zero, but sometimes (apparently) to the next TRB after the one referenced by the previous transfer event"——多数时候给零、偶尔给一个似是而非（bogus）的指针。

要解决的问题（症状 + 机制）

症状：驱动跳光全部 pending TD。机制：旧判据只挡 NULL（!ep_trb_dma）——bogus 指针恰好指到「已用 Short Packet 完成的双 TRB TD 的末 TRB」时，驱动按指针去找 TD 却找不到匹配（该 TD 已完成出队），message 原文 "the driver skips all pending TDs, failing to find a match"——环上真正待处理的 TD 被整批跳过。

代码逻辑（补丁前 → 后行为对照）

修复=find_td_by_dma 双趟扫描：先把「按 DMA 地址逐 TD 调 trb_in_td 定位」收进独立辅助函数；MSE 分支判据改为「落不进任何 TD 即 bail out leaving ep->skip set」（新注释逐字：zero (as permitted by xHCI 1.0) or bogus）——第一趟没找到匹配就不真跳，留给下一个事件收尾。message 原文："scan TD list twice and only really skip TDs in the second pass if the first pass found a match." 对读注记：下方对读段（L2632-L2646）即基线现行形态——已演进为带 missed_tds 计数的签名（后续提交把「跳多少」也数出来），双趟骨架未变；调用方=4.10.3 卡贴码段 handle_tx_event 的 MSE 分支；分帧走读见 xh1002p（scene=49）。

4.10.3Events 事件（Overrun/Underrun/MSE）机制p184-p187

规范引文（机制主线）

Refer to section 4.17.4 for information on Event to Interrupter mapping.
有关事件到中断器（Interrupter）映射的信息，参见 4.17.4 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L733-L733（p184）
If an Isoch endpoint is Running, the xHC periodically schedules the endpoint as a function of the ESIT. Each ESIT the xHC shall execute one Isoch TD on the endpoint's Transfer Ring. If the Isoch ring is empty when the xHC is ready to perform the transfer, it shall generate a Transfer Event on the Event Ring indicated by the Slot Context Interrupter Target field. An IN Isoch endpoint shall set the Completion Code to Ring Overrun and an OUT Isoch endpoint shall set the Completion Code to Ring Underrun.
若 Isoch 端点处于 Running 状态，xHC 会以 ESIT（端点服务时间间隔，Endpoint Service Interval Time）为依据周期性地调度该端点。在每个 ESIT 中，xHC 必须在该端点的传输环上执行一个 Isoch TD。当 xHC 准备执行传输时若 Isoch 环为空，它必须在由槽位上下文（Slot Context）的 Interrupter Target 字段所指示的事件环上生成一个传输事件（Transfer Event）。IN 方向的 Isoch 端点必须将完成码（Completion Code）置为 Ring Overrun（环过冲），OUT 方向的 Isoch 端点必须将完成码置为 Ring Underrun（环欠载）。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L736-L742（p184）
When a Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition occurs, the TRB referenced by the Dequeue Pointer is not valid. Ring Underrun and Ring Overrun Transfer Events shall clear the TRB Transfer Length field to ‘0’ and set the TRB Pointer field to the address of the invalid TRB (that is, the value of the Dequeue Pointer where the Overrun or Ring Underrun condition was detected). Refer to section 4.11.3.1 for a detailed description of the Transfer Event TRB. The functionality described in this paragraph shall be mandatory for all xHCI 1.1 and xHCI 1.2 compliant xHCs.
当发生环过冲或环欠载条件时，出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）所引用的 TRB 是无效的。环欠载与环过冲传输事件必须将 TRB Transfer Length 字段清为 '0'，并将 TRB Pointer 字段设置为该无效 TRB 的地址（即检测到溢出或环欠载条件时的出队指针值）。有关 Transfer Event TRB 的详细描述，参见 4.11.3.1 节。本段所述功能对所有符合 xHCI 1.1 与 xHCI 1.2 的 xHC 而言必须是强制的。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L743-L750（p184）
Note: Pre-1.1 xHC implementations clear the TRB Pointer field of a Ring Underrun or Ring Overrun Transfer Event TRB to ‘0’.
注：1.1 之前的 xHC 实现会把环欠载或环过冲传输事件 TRB 的 TRB Pointer 字段清为 '0'。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L751-L752（p184）
After a Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition is reported the endpoint shall remain in the Running state and be removed from the Pipe Schedule. The endpoint shall be placed back on the Pipe Schedule the next time system software rings the doorbell for the endpoint.
在环过冲或环欠载条件被上报之后，端点必须保持在 Running 状态，并从 Pipe Schedule（管道调度表）中移除。下一次系统软件为该端点敲响门铃时，端点必须被重新放回 Pipe Schedule。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L759-L762（p185）
A Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition may occur unintentionally if software posts Isoch TDs late, that is, software does not meet the Isochronous Scheduling Threshold (IST) requirement. In this case the xHC detects an empty Transfer Ring for the ESIT, generates a Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun Event, and removes the endpoint from the Pipe Schedule. However, software, not knowing that it is late, rings the endpoint’s doorbell, posting an Isoch TD for the ESIT that just incurred the Over/Underrun condition. The doorbell ring causes the xHC to put the endpoint back on the Pipe Schedule, and in preparation for the next ESIT, the xHC may fetch a TD that software had intended for a previous ESIT. If the SIA flag is set, then the TD (and all subsequent TDs) will be transferred one ESIT late. If the SIA flag is cleared, then the xHC will inspect the TD’s Frame ID, recognize that the TD is not within the current Valid Frame Window36, and generate a Missed Service Error, because the xHC is unable to service the TD within the specified ESIT. After the Missed Service Error the xHC will attempt to “resynchronize” the Isoch pipe. If resynchronization is successful, then subsequent Isoch TDs will be transferred in their correct ESITs. Refer to section 4.10.3.2 for more information on Missed Service Error handling. Refer to section 4.11.2.5.2 for more information on Resynchronization.
如果软件提交 Isoch TD 过迟，即软件未满足等时调度阈值（Isochronous Scheduling Threshold，IST）要求，则可能无意中发生环过冲或环欠载条件。此时 xHC 检测到该 ESIT 的传输环为空，生成环过冲或环欠载事件，并将端点从 Pipe Schedule 中移除。然而，软件并不知道自己迟了，仍会敲响该端点的门铃，为刚发生溢出/欠载条件的那个 ESIT 提交一个 Isoch TD。这次门铃会使 xHC 把端点重新放回 Pipe Schedule，而在为下一个 ESIT 做准备时，xHC 可能取回一个软件原本打算用于先前某个 ESIT 的 TD。若 SIA（Start Isoch ASAP，尽快启动等时）标志被置位，则该 TD（以及其后的所有 TD）将晚一个 ESIT 被传输。若 SIA 标志被清零，则 xHC 会检查该 TD 的 Frame ID，识别出该 TD 不在当前有效帧窗口（Valid Frame Window）36 内，并生成 Missed Service Error（漏服务错误），因为 xHC 无法在指定的 ESIT 内对该 TD 提供服务。在 Missed Service Error 之后，xHC 会尝试对 Isoch 管道进行“重新同步”（resynchronize）。如果重新同步成功，则后续的 Isoch TD 将在各自正确的 ESIT 内被传输。有关 Missed Service Error 处理的更多信息，参见 4.10.3.2 节。有关重新同步（Resynchronization）的更多信息，参见 4.11.2.5.2 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L763-L781（p185）
Software typically posts multiple Isoch TDs with each doorbell ring. If software is very late (for example, multiple ESITs) when it rings the doorbell after an Overrun/Underrun condition, then multiple Isoch TDs may not be within the current Valid Frame Window. In this case, a Missed Service Error shall be generated for each TD skipped in the process of resynchronizing. Refer to section 4.11.2.5 for the definition of Valid Frame Window.
软件通常在每次敲门铃时提交多个 Isoch TD。如果软件在溢出/欠载条件发生后敲门铃时已严重迟到（例如晚了多个 ESIT），那么可能有多个 Isoch TD 不在当前有效帧窗口内。此时，必须为重新同步过程中被跳过的每一个 TD 生成一个 Missed Service Error。有关有效帧窗口的定义，参见 4.11.2.5 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L782-L787（p185）
Note: For Isoch TDs with SIA = '0' that are not scheduled in advance of the Isochronous Scheduling Threshold (IST): • If an Isoch endpoint is Running and Busy, then TDs that are not scheduled in advance of the IST shall result in an Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition, because the Transfer Ring appears empty when the xHC goes to fetch the next TD (refer to section 4.14.2.1.4 for more information on IST). • If an Isoch endpoint is Running and Idle, then TDs that are not scheduled in advance of the IST shall result in a Missed Service Error, because the doorbell is rung too late for the xHC to schedule the TD for the ESIT targeted by the Frame ID (refer to section 4.10.3.2 for more information). Refer to section 4.11.2.5.1 for scheduling ESITs less than 1 ms, that is, Microframe Alignment.
注：对于 SIA = '0' 且未在等时调度阈值（IST）之前提前调度的 Isoch TD： - 若 Isoch 端点处于 Running 且 Busy 状态，则未在 IST 之前提前调度的 TD 将导致环过冲或环欠载条件，因为当 xHC 前去取下一个 TD 时传输环表现为空（有关 IST 的更多信息，参见 4.14.2.1.4 节）。 - 若 Isoch 端点处于 Running 且 Idle 状态，则未在 IST 之前提前调度的 TD 将导致 Missed Service Error，因为门铃敲响得太晚，xHC 已无法把该 TD 调度到 Frame ID 所指向的 ESIT（更多信息参见 4.10.3.2 节）。 关于小于 1 ms 的 ESIT 的调度（即微帧对齐，Microframe Alignment），参见 4.11.2.5.1 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L788-L801（p185）
Note: A late doorbell ring may result in the generation of two Events; a Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition, being followed immediately by a Missed Service Error. The xHC generates a Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition because an Isoch Transfer Ring is empty when it tries to move the data for a scheduled Interval. The Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition also causes the endpoint to transition to the Running Idle state, that is, requiring a doorbell ring to restart it. When the (late) doorbell ring does occur, assuming it posted data buffers for the Interval that generated the Ring Overrun or Ring Underrun condition, the xHC will fetch buffer targeted at an Interval that has already passed and generate a Missed Service Error because it cannot deliver the data associated with an Isoch TD.
注：过迟的门铃可能导致生成两个事件：先是一个环过冲或环欠载条件，紧接着是一个 Missed Service Error。xHC 之所以生成环过冲或环欠载条件，是因为当它试图为某个已调度的 Interval 搬移数据时，Isoch 传输环是空的。环过冲或环欠载条件还会使端点迁移到 Running Idle 状态，也就是说需要一次门铃才能将其重启。当（过迟的）门铃确实敲响时，假设它为产生环过冲或环欠载条件的那个 Interval 提交了数据缓冲，xHC 将取回一个针对已经过去的 Interval 的缓冲，并因无法递交与某个 Isoch TD 相关联的数据而生成 Missed Service Error。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L813-L823（p186）
This error only applies to Isochronous endpoints. A Missed Service Error Completion Code indicates that the xHC was unable to complete the data transfer associated with an Isoch TRB within the ESIT. The cause of the error may be due to an Event Ring full condition, excessive DMA latency when accessing periodic data causing an internal xHC buffer overrun or underrun, etc. The data associated with the TD in error shall be lost, however for the next ESIT the xHC shall advance to the next Isoch TD and attempt to execute it. A Missed Service Error shall utilize the Transfer Event TRB format. The TRB Pointer field of Missed Service Error Transfer Event shall reference the TRB that was missed and its TRB Transfer Length the residue data bytes in the buffer. Since a Missed Service Error forces a Transfer Event, the Event’s TRB Pointer field may not reference a TRB that has its IOC flag set (‘1’) within the skipped Isoch TD.
该错误仅适用于等时（Isochronous）端点。Missed Service Error 完成码表明 xHC 未能在 ESIT 内完成与某个 Isoch TRB 相关联的数据传输。错误的原因可能是事件环满（Event Ring full）条件、访问周期性数据时过大的 DMA 延迟导致 xHC 内部缓冲溢出或欠载，等等。与出错 TD 相关联的数据必须被丢弃，但对于下一个 ESIT，xHC 必须前进到下一个 Isoch TD 并尝试执行它。 Missed Service Error 必须采用 Transfer Event TRB 格式。Missed Service Error 传输事件的 TRB Pointer 字段必须引用被错过的那个 TRB，其 TRB Transfer Length 则为缓冲中残余（residue）的数据字节数。由于 Missed Service Error 会强制产生一个传输事件，该事件的 TRB Pointer 字段可能无法引用被跳过的 Isoch TD 中某个已将 IOC 标志置位（'1'）的 TRB。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L826-L838（p186）
If the conditions that cause a Missed Service Error persist, multiple consecutive Isoch transfers may not be completed. In this case, a Missed Service Error Transfer Event shall be generated for every ESIT missed. The only exception to this rule is if an Event Ring full condition prevents the posting of Missed Service Error Transfer Events. When the Event Ring full condition clears, the xHC shall post a Missed Service Error Transfer Event for the last Isoch TD (of each Transfer Ring) not completed. Note: xHC implementations that do not support the Contiguous Frame ID Capability (CFC) may not generate a Missed Service Error Transfer Event for every ESIT missed.
如果导致 Missed Service Error 的条件持续存在，多个连续的等时传输可能都无法完成。此时，必须为错过的每一个 ESIT 生成一个 Missed Service Error 传输事件。此规则的唯一例外是事件环满条件阻止了 Missed Service Error 传输事件的发布。当事件环满条件解除时，xHC 必须为（每个传输环上）最后一个未完成的 Isoch TD 发布一个 Missed Service Error 传输事件。 注：不支持连续帧 ID 能力（Contiguous Frame ID Capability，CFC）的 xHC 实现可能不会为错过的每一个 ESIT 生成 Missed Service Error 传输事件。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L839-L848（p186）
A Missed Service Error shall not be reported if an Isoch transfer was not completed due to another error condition, for example, USB Transaction Error, and so forth. Refer to section 4.10.3.1 for more information on the relationship of Missed Service Errors to Ring Overrun and Ring Underrun conditions.
如果等时传输是因另一错误条件（例如 USB Transaction Error 等）而未完成，则不得上报 Missed Service Error。 有关 Missed Service Error 与环过冲、环欠载条件之间关系的更多信息，参见 4.10.3.1 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L849-L853（p186）
This error only applies to USB2 protocol endpoints for reporting an error on a split transaction, for example, that the xHC was unable to schedule a required
该错误仅适用于 USB2 协议端点，用于上报拆分事务（split transaction）上的错误，例如 xHC 未能为某个 HS Split Interrupt IN 事务调度所需的 complete-split（完成拆分）事务。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L856-L858（p186）
complete-split transaction of a HS Split Interrupt IN transaction. If a Split Transaction Error is detected, there is the possibility of data loss, and the endpoint shall be halted. Note: Software shall not attempt a Soft Retry to recover from a Split Transaction Error.
该错误仅适用于 USB2 协议端点，用于上报拆分事务（split transaction）上的错误，例如 xHC 未能为某个 HS Split Interrupt IN 事务调度所需的 complete-split（完成拆分）事务。如果检测到拆分事务错误，则存在数据丢失的可能性，且端点必须被置为 halt（停机）。 注：软件不得尝试 Soft Retry（软重试）来从拆分事务错误中恢复。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L864-L868（p187）
A Short Packet Completion Code shall be reported if number of bytes received was less than the TD Transfer Size and the Interrupt-on Short Packet (ISP) or Interrupt on Completion (IOC) flag was set to ‘1’ in the associated Transfer TRB. Refer to section 6.4.5 Table 6-90 for the definition of the Short Packet Completion Code. Refer to section 4.10.1.1 for more information in Short Packet handling. Note: If a Short Packet ends between two TRBs, either of them may report a Short Packet Completion Code.
如果接收到的字节数小于 TD Transfer Size，且相关传输 TRB 中的 Interrupt-on Short Packet（ISP）或 Interrupt on Completion（IOC）标志被置为 '1'，则必须上报短包（Short Packet）完成码。有关短包完成码的定义，参见 6.4.5 节表 6-90。有关短包处理的更多信息，参见 4.10.1.1 节。 注：如果一个短包结束于两个 TRB 之间，则二者中的任何一个都可以上报短包完成码。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L871-L878（p187）

2653static int handle_tx_event(struct xhci_hcd *xhci,


2654			   struct xhci_interrupter *ir,


2655			   struct xhci_transfer_event *event)

2696

2709	case COMP_SHORT_PACKET:


2710		break;

2718			 "Stopped on No-op or Link TRB for slot %u ep %u\n",

2751			  slot_id, ep_index);

2757			  "WARN: HC couldn't access mem fast enough for slot %u ep %u\n",

2760		break;


2761	case COMP_BANDWIDTH_OVERRUN_ERROR:


2762		xhci_warn(xhci,


2763			  "WARN: bandwidth overrun event for slot %u ep %u on endpoint\n",


2764			  slot_id, ep_index);


2765		break;


2766	case COMP_ISOCH_BUFFER_OVERRUN:


2767		xhci_warn(xhci,


2768			  "WARN: buffer overrun event for slot %u ep %u on endpoint",


2769			  slot_id, ep_index);


2770		break;

2773		 * When the Isoch ring is empty, the xHC will generate

2818			  "ERROR Unknown event condition %u for slot %u ep %u , HC probably busted\n",


2819			  trb_comp_code, slot_id, ep_index);

2910			return 0;

2913		 * Skip the Force Stopped Event. The 'ep_trb' of FSE is not in the current


2914		 * TD pointed by 'ep_ring->dequeue' because that the hardware dequeue

2917		 * completion handle will take care the rest.

2924		 * transfer or error on last TRB. Ignore it.

2931		}


2932


2933		/* HC is busted, give up! */

2936				&ep_trb_dma, ep_index, trb_comp_code,


2937				(u64)xhci_trb_virt_to_dma(td->start_seg, td->start_trb),


2938				(u64)xhci_trb_virt_to_dma(td->end_seg, td->end_trb),

2943	ep_ring->old_trb_comp_code = trb_comp_code;


2944


2945	/* Get out if a TD was queued at enqueue after the xrun occurred */

2948

2950


2951	/*


2952	 * No-op TRB could trigger interrupts in a case where a URB was killed


2953	 * and a STALL_ERROR happens right after the endpoint ring stopped.

事件环本体（ERST/EREP/ERDP/满检查）在 4.9.4 事件环管理 卡；本卡聚焦传输侧事件的错误语义（IST 迟到/SIA 分叉/MSE 频率）。

4.10.4IOC Flag 完成中断旗标机制p187-p188

规范引文（机制主线）

The general rule for how the xHC should handle the IOC flag is simple: if the IOC flag is set, then generate an event. There are some exceptions to this rule described in the spec, for example, if the Event Ring is full, but normally this rule should always be applied.
xHC 应如何处理 IOC 标志的一般规则很简单：如果 IOC 标志被置位，就生成一个事件。规范中描述了该规则的一些例外情况，例如事件环已满，但通常这条规则应始终适用。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L881-L884（p187）
If software wants to know when the xHC has completed processing all the TRBs associated with a TD, it must set the IOC flag in the last TRB of TD. The event that the IOC in the last TRB generates informs software that last TRB of the TD is complete, which means that the TD is complete, and that the space on the Transfer Ring that the TD consumed may be reclaimed.
如果软件想知道 xHC 何时完成了与某个 TD 相关联的所有 TRB 的处理，它必须在 TD 的最后一个 TRB 中置 IOC 标志。最后一个 TRB 中的 IOC 所生成的事件会通知软件：该 TD 的最后一个 TRB 已完成，这意味着 TD 已完成，且该 TD 在传输环上占用的空间可以被回收。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L885-L889（p187）
The ISP flag generates an event only if less data was received, than was specified by a TRB. The TRB Transfer Length field of the Transfer Event that a Short Packet condition generates informs software of the exact number of bytes transferred when the condition was detected. Software may also set the BEI flag if it is not interested in generating an interrupt due to a Short Packet Event. And if the ISP flag is set and IOC flag is not set in the last TRB of TD that received a Short Packet, an event shall not be generated if a Short Packet condition does not occur on that TRB, that is, if the buffer defined by the TRB is completely filled.
只有当接收到的数据少于 TRB 所指定的数据量时，ISP 标志才会生成事件。短包条件所产生的传输事件的 TRB Transfer Length 字段会告知软件在该条件被检测到时实际传输的确切字节数。如果软件不希望因短包事件（Short Packet Event）而产生中断，也可以置 BEI 标志。 而如果在接收到短包的 TD 的最后一个 TRB 中 ISP 标志被置位而 IOC 标志未置位，那么当该 TRB 上未发生短包条件时——即该 TRB 所定义的缓冲被完全填满时——不得生成事件。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L890-L899（p187）
In some cases, the xHC response to an error condition may look very similar to a Short Packet condition, because after the xHC generates an event for either condition, the xHC may automatically advance to the next TD. An example of this behavior is when a USB Transaction Error is detected during an Isoch IN transfer, where the Isoch pipe does not stall, but advances to the next Isoch TD in preparation for the next Interval. The error will generate an event, however if the event does not point to last TRB of the Isoch TD and the IOC flag is not set in last TRB of the TD with the error, software will have to wait until the next IOC flag is encountered by the endpoint before it can reclaim the
在某些情况下，xHC 对错误条件的响应可能与短包条件非常相似，因为无论哪种条件，xHC 在生成事件之后都可能会自动前进到下一个 TD。这种行为的一个例子是：在 Isoch IN 传输期间检测到 USB Transaction Error 时，Isoch 管道并不停滞（stall），而是前进到下一个 Isoch TD，为下一个 Interval 做准备。该错误会生成一个事件，但如果该事件未指向该 Isoch TD 的最后一个 TRB，且出错 TD 的最后一个 TRB 中未置 IOC 标志，软件就必须等到端点遇到下一个 IOC 标志后，才能回收那个出错的 Isoch TD。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L900-L909（p187）
Isoch TD that had the error. This may take many milliseconds depending on the size of the Interval and where software set the IOC flags.
这种行为的一个例子是：在 Isoch IN 传输期间检测到 USB Transaction Error 时，Isoch 管道并不停滞（stall），而是前进到下一个 Isoch TD，为下一个 Interval 做准备。该错误会生成一个事件，但如果该事件未指向该 Isoch TD 的最后一个 TRB，且出错 TD 的最后一个 TRB 中未置 IOC 标志，软件就必须等到端点遇到下一个 IOC 标志后，才能回收那个出错的 Isoch TD。这可能耗时数毫秒，具体取决于 Interval 的大小以及软件设置 IOC 标志的位置。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L915-L916（p188）
In summary, software can not only use the IOC flag to report specific TD completions, but it can also be used to provide timely updates of the Dequeue Pointer position so that TRBs can be reclaimed, to reduce error recovery times, or to allow Transfer Rings to grow or shrink as function of system loading or resource changes.
总而言之，软件不仅可以使用 IOC 标志来报告特定 TD 的完成，还可以用它来及时更新出队指针（Dequeue Pointer）的位置，从而回收 TRB、缩短错误恢复时间，或使传输环能够随系统负载或资源变化而增长或收缩。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L917-L921（p188）
Note: An exception is if the PAE flag is cleared (‘0’). In this case when a Short Packet occurs, the IOC flag in the first Event Data TRB encountered generates an Event Data Transfer Event and the IOC flag is ignored in subsequent Event Data TRBs that are encountered in the process of advancing the Dequeue Pointer to the beginning of the next TD. Refer to section 5.3.6 for more information on PAE.
注：一个例外是 PAE 标志被清零（'0'）的情形。此时当短包发生时，所遇到的第一个 Event Data TRB 中的 IOC 标志会生成一个 Event Data 传输事件，而在把出队指针前进到下一个 TD 开头的过程中随后遇到的 Event Data TRB 中的 IOC 标志则被忽略。有关 PAE 的更多信息，参见 5.3.6 节。
—— evidence/spec-410.txt L922-L927（p188）

调用链整段贴码 commit d9008e061539 · 函数整段 · 段内零摘录热行（机制判据见卡内规范引文与流程图）

drivers/usb/host/xhci-ring.c:2263-2303 · finish_td（TD 完成收尾分派） · d9008e061539
2263static void finish_td(struct xhci_hcd *xhci, struct xhci_virt_ep *ep,


2264		      struct xhci_ring *ep_ring, struct xhci_td *td,


2265		      u32 trb_comp_code)


2266{


2267	struct xhci_ep_ctx *ep_ctx;


2268


2269	ep_ctx = xhci_get_ep_ctx(xhci, ep->vdev->out_ctx, ep->ep_index);


2270


2271	switch (trb_comp_code) {


2272	case COMP_STOPPED_LENGTH_INVALID:


2273	case COMP_STOPPED_SHORT_PACKET:


2274	case COMP_STOPPED:


2275		/*


2276		 * The "Stop Endpoint" completion will take care of any


2277		 * stopped TDs. A stopped TD may be restarted, so don't update


2278		 * the ring dequeue pointer or take this TD off any lists yet.


2279		 */


2280		return;


2281	}


2282


2283	if (xhci_halted_host_endpoint(xhci, ep_ctx, trb_comp_code)) {


2284		/*


2285		 * xhci internal endpoint state will go to a "halt" state for


2286		 * any stall, including default control pipe protocol stall.


2287		 * To clear the host side halt we need to issue a reset endpoint


2288		 * command, followed by a set dequeue command to move past the


2289		 * TD.


2290		 * Class drivers clear the device side halt from a functional


2291		 * stall later. Hub TT buffer should only be cleared for FS/LS


2292		 * devices behind HS hubs for functional stalls.


2293		 */


2294		if (!(ep->ep_index == 0 && trb_comp_code == COMP_STALL_ERROR))


2295			xhci_clear_hub_tt_buffer(xhci, td, ep);


2296


2297		xhci_handle_halted_endpoint(xhci, ep, td, EP_HARD_RESET);


2298


2299		return; /* xhci_handle_halted_endpoint marked td cancelled */


2300	}


2301


2302	xhci_dequeue_td(xhci, td, ep_ring, td->status);

All xHC commands are issued by placing the desired Command TRB(s) (Section 6.4.3 Command TRBs) on the Command Ring, then ringing the xHC command Doorbell register, that is, writing the Host Controller Command code to the DB Target field of Doorbell register 0 (refer to Section 5.6 Doorbell Registers).
所有 xHC 命令的下发方式为：将所需的命令 TRB（Command TRB，见 6.4.3 节“命令 TRB”）放置到命令环上，然后敲响 xHC 命令门铃寄存器（Doorbell Register），即把 Host Controller Command 代码写入 0 号门铃寄存器的 DB Target 字段（参见 5.6 节“门铃寄存器（Doorbell Registers）”）。
—— evidence/spec-41.txt L8-L11（p68）

For FS devices, system software should initially read the first 8 bytes of the USB Device Descriptor to retrieve the value of the bMaxPacketSize0 field and determine the actual Max Packet Size for the Default Control Endpoint, by issuing a USB GET_DESCRIPTOR request to the device, update the Default Control Endpoint Context with the actual Max Packet Size and inform the xHC of the context change. Step a describes this operation.
对 FS 设备，系统软件应先读取 USB 设备描述符（Device Descriptor）的前 8 字节，以取得 bMaxPacketSize0 字段的值，从而确定默认控制端点的实际 Max Packet Size（最大包大小）——做法是向设备发出 USB GET_DESCRIPTOR 请求，用实际 Max Packet Size 更新默认控制端点上下文（Default Control Endpoint Context），并把该上下文变更告知 xHC。步骤 a 描述了这一操作。
—— evidence/spec-43.txt L103-L108（p72）

When the device is detached from a Root Hub port, the PORTSC Current Connection Status (CCS) bit shall be cleared to ‘0’ and the Connect Status Change (CSC) bit shall be set to ‘1’. 当设备从根集线器端口 detach（移除）时，PORTSC 的 Current Connection Status（CCS）位必须清零为 ‘0’，Connect Status Change（CSC）位必须置为 ‘1’。若 PSCEG（4.19.2）发生 ‘0’ 到 ‘1’ 的跳变，xHC 必须通过端口状态变化事件（Port Status Change Event）报告该变化。检测到 detach 之后，系统软件必须通过对受影响的槽发出 Disable Slot 命令，禁用与该端口关联的设备槽（Device Slot）。Disable Slot 命令的描述参见第 4.6.4 节。

For Control type endpoints: DCI = (Endpoint Number * 2) + 1.
2. 对于控制类型端点：DCI = (Endpoint Number * 2) + 1。

For Isoch, Interrupt, or Bulk type endpoints the DCI is calculated from the Endpoint Number and Direction with the following formula; DCI = (Endpoint Number * 2) + Direction, where Direction = ‘0’ for OUT endpoints and ‘1’ for IN endpoints.
1. 对于等时（Isoch）、中断或批量类型端点，DCI 由端点号（Endpoint Number）与方向（Direction）按以下公式计算：DCI = (Endpoint Number * 2) + Direction，其中 OUT 端点的 Direction = ‘0’，IN 端点的 Direction = ‘1’。

Enable Slot 命令 TRB 入命令环——Disabled 态唯一允许软件发出的命令（§4.5.3.2 p86）

In this slot state the Device Slot is disabled, that is, the slot’s Doorbell register is disabled and the pointer to the slot’s Output Device Context in the Device Context Base Address Array is invalid. The only command that software is allowed to issue for the slot in this state is the Enable Slot Command.
在此槽状态下，设备槽处于禁用（disabled），即该槽的门铃寄存器被禁用，且设备上下文基址数组中指向该槽输出设备上下文（Output Device Context）的指针无效。软件在此状态下被允许为该槽发出的唯一命令是 Enable Slot 命令（启用槽命令）。
—— evidence/spec-45.txt L284-L287（p86）

敲主机命令门铃：DB Target = Host Controller Command（§4.5 p83）

Ringing the Host Controller Doorbell (Doorbell Register 0) with the DB Target = Host Controller Command, indicates to the xHC that software has defined a command in the Command Ring that it wants executed.
以 DB Target = Host Controller Command 敲响主机控制器门铃（门铃寄存器 0），即向 xHC 表明软件已在命令环（Command Ring）中定义了一条希望执行的命令。
—— evidence/spec-45.txt L82-L84（p83）

等 Enable Slot 完成事件：成功后槽从 Disabled 迁入 Enabled（§4.5.3.2 p86）

—— evidence/spec-45.txt L291-L292（p86）

Slot ID 是软件访问设备上下文基址数组以取回指向设备上下文数据结构的指针、或访问与某设备关联的门铃寄存器时所用的索引。

In this slot state the Device Slot has been allocated to software by the Enable Slot Command, however the Doorbell register for the slot is not enabled and the pointer to the slot’s Output Device Context in the Device Context Base Address Array is invalid. The only commands that software is allowed to issue for a slot in this state are the Address Device and Disable Slot.

to a Device Slot. Each xHC Device Slot is comprised of 3 major components: an entry in the Device Context Base Address Array, a Device Context data structure, and a Doorbell Register in the Doorbell Array.

Internally flag the slot as “available” for subsequent reassignment by an Enable Slot Command. that is, the Device Context Base Address Array entry for the slot is no longer considered valid by the xHC and software can free the Device Context, Transfer Ring, Stream Context Array, etc. data structures associated with the slot.

Note: If the Block Set Address Request (BSR) flag is ‘0’ in the Address Device Command TRB, then the xHC shall select a USB Device Address and issue a SET_ADDRESS request to a USB device as part of an Address Device Command. If the Block Set Address Request (BSR) flag is ‘1’ then the xHC shall not issue a SET_ADDRESS request to a USB device as part of an Address Device Command. In either case, all other operations described in this section for the Address Device Command are performed. The BSR flag may be used
注：如果 Address Device 命令 TRB 中的 BSR 标志为 '0'，则 xHC 必须选择一个 USB 设备地址，并作为 Address Device 命令的一部分向 USB 设备发出 SET_ADDRESS 请求。如果 BSR 标志为 '1'，则 xHC 不得作为 Address Device 命令的一部分向 USB 设备发出 SET_ADDRESS 请求。无论哪种情况，本节所述 Address Device 命令的所有其他操作都会执行。软件可以利用 BSR 标志来兼容那些要求先读取其设备描述符、然后才接收 SET_ADDRESS 请求的旧式 USB 设备。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L437-L443（p98）

System software shall initialize Slot Context and Endpoint Context 0 entries of the Input Context. All other Endpoint Contexts in the Input Context shall be ignored by the xHC during the execution of this command.
系统软件必须初始化输入上下文中的 Slot Context 条目与 Endpoint Context 0 条目。在该命令执行期间，xHC 必须忽略输入上下文中的所有其他 Endpoint Context。

资源预检（xhci_reserve_host_resources）：quirk 主机先估内部资源够不够——对应规范 Resource Error 拒绝语义（内部数据结构/缓冲空间是 xHC 实现定义的度量）。

The xHC shall reject a Configure Endpoint Command with Resource Error if it determines that it does not have enough internal resources (buffer space, etc.) available to service all the endpoints defined in the configuration.
如果 xHC 判定它没有足够的可用内部资源（缓冲空间等）来服务该配置所定义的所有端点，它必须以 Resource Error 拒绝 Configure Endpoint 命令。

The xHC shall reject a Configure Endpoint Command with Bandwidth Error if it determines that the bandwidth required by the configuration is not available.

Configure Endpoint 命令入环：xhci_queue_configure_endpoint 携 Input Context DMA 与 slot_id——规范发行算法的内核落点（TRB Type/Slot ID/ICP/清 0/Cycle=PCS）。

Insert a Configure Endpoint Command on the Command Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Configure Endpoint Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Slot ID = ID of the target Device Slot. o Input Context Pointer = The base address of the Input Context data structure.Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag.
- 在命令环上插入一个 Configure Endpoint 命令，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Configure Endpoint Command（参见表 6-91）。 - Slot ID = 目标设备槽位的 ID。 - Input Context Pointer = 该输入上下文数据结构的基地址。将该命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清为 '0'。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1048-L1058（p108）

复位前的槽状态检查：槽已 Disabled（未 setup）则无需 Reset Device——规范执行算法的前提分支「If the Device Slot is in the Addressed or Configured state」的补集面。

If the Device Slot is in the Addressed or Configured state: o Abort any USB transactions to the Device. o Set the Slot State field of Slot Context to the Default state. o Set the Context Entries field of Slot Context to ‘1’. o Set the USB Device Address field of Slot Context to ‘0’. o For each Endpoint Context of the Device Context (except the Default Control Endpoint): • Set the Endpoint Context EP State field to Disabled.
- 若设备槽位处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态： - 中止发往该设备的任何 USB 事务。 - 将槽上下文的 Slot State 字段置为 Default 状态。 - 将槽上下文的 Context Entries 字段置为 ‘1’。 - 将槽上下文的 USB Device Address 字段置为 ‘0’。 - 对设备上下文（Device Context）的每个端点上下文（默认控制端点除外）： - 将端点上下文的 EP State 字段置为 Disabled。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2404-L2417（p129）

Insert an Reset Device Command on the Command Ring and initialize the following fields: o TRB Type = Reset Device Command (refer to Table 6-91). o Slot ID = The ID of the Device Slot to reset. o Clear all other fields of the command TRB to ‘0’. o Cycle bit = Command Ring’s PCS flag. • Write the Host Controller Doorbell with DB Target = Host Controller Command.
- 在命令环（Command Ring）上插入一个 Reset Device 命令，并初始化以下字段： - TRB Type = Reset Device Command（参见表 6-91）。 - Slot ID = 要复位的设备槽位的 ID。 - 将命令 TRB 的所有其他字段清零为 ‘0’。 - Cycle bit = 命令环的 PCS 标志。 - 写主机控制器门铃寄存器，DB Target = Host Controller Command。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L2388-L2400（p129）

If the Device Slot was in the Addressed or Configured state: • Completion Code = Success (refer to Table 6-90). o else // The Device Slot was not in the Addressed or Configured state • Completion Code = Context State Error.
- 若该设备槽位此前处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态： - Completion Code = Success（参见表 6-90）。 - else // 设备槽位此前不处于 Addressed 或 Configured 状态 - Completion Code = Context State Error。

清理已取消 TD（注释原文：May queue a Set TR Deq cmd）——Reset Endpoint 与 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 的规范配合点（p115 reset-a-pipe 第④步）。

Note: Prior to restarting the Transfer Ring, software may use the Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command to modify the value of the TR Dequeue Pointer field of the Endpoint Context and clear the endpoint state associated with the previously executed packet. If the Reset Endpoint Command is followed with a Set TR Dequeue Pointer Command, the endpoint shall start execution at the beginning of the TRB referenced by the TR Dequeue Pointer the next time the doorbell is rung.
例如，若端点在重试某个 4KB TRB 的第 3 个 1K 包时 halt，那么紧随 Reset Endpoint 命令的一次门铃振铃会使端点重试同一个包，并把数据移入/移出该 TRB 所引用缓冲区内 2KB 偏移处。将 TSP 标志清零为 ‘0’ 会复位端点的数据翻转位/Sequence Number，但它对该端点相关联的其他状态没有其他影响。注：在重启传输环之前，软件可以使用 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令来修改端点上下文的 TR Dequeue Pointer 字段值，并清除与此前执行的包相关联的端点状态。若 Reset Endpoint 命令之后跟随一条 Set TR Dequeue Pointer 命令，则下次门铃振铃时端点必须从 TR Dequeue Pointer 所引用 TRB 的起始处开始执行。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1496-L1502（p115）

完成侧对 COMP_CONTEXT_STATE_ERROR 无处理（竞态假失败的入口）：完成处理器内 1174d44906d5 补了环在跑=重发命令的自愈分支。

A possible race condition may occur if software, thinking an endpoint is in the Running state, issues a Stop Endpoint Command however at the same time the xHC asynchronously transitions the endpoint to the Halted or Error state. In this case, a Context State Error may be generated for the command completion. Software may verify that this case occurred by inspecting the EP State for Halted or Error when a Stop Endpoint Command results in a Context State Error.
若软件以为端点处于 Running 状态而发出 Stop Endpoint 命令，而与此同时 xHC 又异步地将该端点迁移到 Halted 或 Error 状态，则可能发生竞态（race condition）。在这种情况下，命令完成可能生成 Context State Error。当 Stop Endpoint 命令导致 Context State Error 时，软件可以通过检查 EP State 是否为 Halted 或 Error 来核实是否发生了这种情况。
—— evidence/spec-46.txt L1881-L1887（p122）
